    PROCEDURE ReadSheet@4();
    VAR
      ExcelBufferDialogMgt@1003 : Codeunit 5370;
      CellData@1002 : DotNet "'Microsoft.Dynamics.Nav.OpenXml, Version=11.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=31bf3856ad364e35'.Microsoft.Dynamics.Nav.OpenXml.Spreadsheet.CellData";
      Enumerator@1001 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.IEnumerator";
      i@1000 : Integer;
      RowCount@1009 : Integer;
      LastUpdate@1004 : DateTime;
      TmpValue@1000000000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      LastUpdate := CURRENTDATETIME;
      ExcelBufferDialogMgt.Open(Text007);
      DELETEALL(TRUE);
      ExcelBuffLines.DELETEALL;

      Enumerator := XlWrkShtReader.GetEnumerator;
      RowCount := XlWrkShtReader.RowCount;
      WHILE Enumerator.MoveNext DO BEGIN
        CellData := Enumerator.Current;
        TmpValue := '';
        IF CellData.HasValue THEN BEGIN
          TmpValue := CellData.Value;
        END;
        VALIDATE("Row No.",CellData.RowNumber);
        VALIDATE("Column No.",CellData.ColumnNumber);
        ParseCellValue(TmpValue,CellData.Format,CellData.RowNumber,CellData.ColumnNumber);
        INSERT;


        i := i + 1;
        COMMIT;
        IF NOT UpdateProgressDialog(ExcelBufferDialogMgt,LastUpdate,i,RowCount) THEN BEGIN
          QuitExcel;
          ERROR(Text035)
        END;
      END;

      QuitExcel;
      ExcelBufferDialogMgt.Close;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ParseCellValue@40(Value@1000 : Text;FormatString@1001 : Text;RowNo@1000000002 : Integer;ColumnNo@1000000003 : Integer);
    VAR
      Decimal@1004 : Decimal;
      LinesLineNo@1000000001 : Integer;
      j@1000000000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // The format contains only en-US number separators, this is an OpenXML standard requirement
      // The algorithm sieves the data based on formatting as follows (the steps must run in this order)
      // 1. FormatString = '@' -> Text
      // 2. FormatString.Contains(':') -> Time
      // 3. FormatString.ContainsOneOf('y', 'm', 'd') && FormatString.DoesNotContain('Red') -> Date
      // 4. anything else -> Decimal

      NumberFormat := COPYSTR(FormatString,1,30);

      IF (FormatString = '@') OR (Value = '') THEN BEGIN
        "Cell Type" := "Cell Type"::Text;
        Lines := FALSE;
        IF STRLEN(Value) <= 250 THEN
          "Cell Value as Text" := Value
        ELSE BEGIN
          "Cell Value as Text" := '';
          Lines := TRUE;
          LinesLineNo := 10000;
          j := 0;
          WHILE j <= 32767 DO BEGIN
            IF COPYSTR(Value,j+1,250) <> '' THEN BEGIN
              ExcelBuffLines.INIT;
              ExcelBuffLines."Row No." := RowNo;
              ExcelBuffLines."Column No." := ColumnNo;
              ExcelBuffLines."Line No." := LinesLineNo;
              ExcelBuffLines.Value := COPYSTR(Value,j+1,250);
              ExcelBuffLines.INSERT(TRUE);
            END;
            LinesLineNo += 10000;
            j+= 250;
          END;
        END;
        EXIT;
      END;

      EVALUATE(Decimal,Value);
      IF STRPOS(FormatString,':') <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        // Excel Time is stored in OADate format
        "Cell Type" := "Cell Type"::Time;
        "Cell Value as Text" := FORMAT(DT2TIME(ConvertDateTimeDecimalToDateTime(Decimal)));
        EXIT;
      END;

      IF ((STRPOS(FormatString,'y') <> 0) OR
          (STRPOS(FormatString,'m') <> 0) OR
          (STRPOS(FormatString,'d') <> 0)) AND
         (STRPOS(FormatString,'Red') = 0)
      THEN BEGIN
        "Cell Type" := "Cell Type"::Date;
        "Cell Value as Text" := FORMAT(DT2DATE(ConvertDateTimeDecimalToDateTime(Decimal)));
        EXIT;
      END;

      "Cell Type" := "Cell Type"::Number;
      "Cell Value as Text" := FORMAT(ROUND(Decimal,0.000001),0,1);
    END;

    PROCEDURE SelectSheetsName@6(FileName@1000 : Text) : Text[250];
    VAR
      TempNameValueBuffer@1009 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      SheetNames@1008 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.ArrayList";
      SheetName@1002 : Text[250];
      SelectedSheetName@1007 : Text[250];
      i@1001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF FileName = '' THEN
        ERROR(Text001);

      XlWrkBkReader := XlWrkBkReader.Open(FileName);

      SelectedSheetName := '';
      SheetNames := SheetNames.ArrayList(XlWrkBkReader.SheetNames);
      IF NOT ISNULL(SheetNames) THEN BEGIN
        FOR i := 0 TO SheetNames.Count - 1 DO BEGIN
          SheetName := SheetNames.Item(i);
          IF SheetName <> '' THEN BEGIN
            TempNameValueBuffer.INIT;
            TempNameValueBuffer.ID := i;
            TempNameValueBuffer.Name := FORMAT(i + 1);
            TempNameValueBuffer.Value := SheetName;
            TempNameValueBuffer.INSERT;
          END;
        END;
        IF NOT TempNameValueBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN
          IF TempNameValueBuffer.COUNT = 1 THEN
            SelectedSheetName := TempNameValueBuffer.Value
          ELSE BEGIN
            TempNameValueBuffer.FINDFIRST;
            IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(PAGE::"Name/Value Lookup",TempNameValueBuffer) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN
              SelectedSheetName := TempNameValueBuffer.Value;
          END;
      END;

      QuitExcel;
      EXIT(SelectedSheetName);
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetExcelReference@10(Which@1000 : Integer) : Text[250];
    BEGIN
      CASE Which OF
        1:
          EXIT(Text013);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: &B is the Excel code to turn bold printing on or off for customized Header/Footer.
        2:
          EXIT(Text014);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: &D is the Excel code to print the current date in customized Header/Footer.
        3:
          EXIT(Text015);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: &P is the Excel code to print the page number in customized Header/Footer.
        4:
          EXIT('$');
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: $ is the Excel code for absolute reference to cells.
        5:
          EXIT(Text016);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: A1 is the Excel reference of the first cell.
        6:
          EXIT(Text017);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: SUMIF is the name of the Excel function used to summarize values according to some conditions.
        7:
          EXIT(Text018);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: The #N/A Excel error value occurs when a value is not available to a function or formula.
        8:
          EXIT(Text019);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: GLAcc is used to define an Excel range name. You must refer to Excel rules to change this term.
        9:
          EXIT(Text020);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: Period is used to define an Excel range name. You must refer to Excel rules to change this term.
        10:
          EXIT(Text021);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: Budget is used to define an Excel worksheet name. You must refer to Excel rules to change this term.
        11:
          EXIT(Text022);
        // DO NOT TRANSLATE: CostAcc is used to define an Excel range name. You must refer to Excel rules to change this term.
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ExportBudgetFilterToFormula@11(VAR ExcelBuf@1000 : Record 370) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExcelBufFormula@1001 : TEMPORARY Record 370;
      FirstRow@1002 : Integer;
      LastRow@1003 : Integer;
      HasFormulaError@1005 : Boolean;
      ThisCellHasFormulaError@1006 : Boolean;
      ExcelBufFormula2@1004 : TEMPORARY Record 370;
    BEGIN
      ExcelBuf.SETFILTER(Formula,'<>%1','');
      IF ExcelBuf.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          ExcelBufFormula := ExcelBuf;
          ExcelBufFormula.INSERT;
        UNTIL ExcelBuf.NEXT = 0;
      ExcelBuf.RESET;

      WITH ExcelBufFormula DO
        IF FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            ThisCellHasFormulaError := FALSE;
            ExcelBuf.SETRANGE("Column No.",1);
            ExcelBuf.SETFILTER("Row No.",'<>%1',"Row No.");
            ExcelBuf.SETFILTER("Cell Value as Text",Formula);
            ExcelBufFormula2 := ExcelBufFormula;
            IF ExcelBuf.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                IF NOT GET(ExcelBuf."Row No.","Column No.") THEN
                  ExcelBuf.MARK(TRUE);
              UNTIL ExcelBuf.NEXT = 0;
            ExcelBufFormula := ExcelBufFormula2;
            ClearFormula;
            ExcelBuf.SETRANGE("Cell Value as Text");
            ExcelBuf.SETRANGE("Row No.");
            IF ExcelBuf.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                IF ExcelBuf.MARK THEN BEGIN
                  LastRow := ExcelBuf."Row No.";
                  IF FirstRow = 0 THEN
                    FirstRow := LastRow;
                END ELSE
                  IF FirstRow <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                    IF FirstRow = LastRow THEN
                      ThisCellHasFormulaError := AddToFormula(xlColID + FORMAT(FirstRow))
                    ELSE
                      ThisCellHasFormulaError :=
                        AddToFormula('SUM(' + xlColID + FORMAT(FirstRow) + ':' + xlColID + FORMAT(LastRow) + ')');
                    FirstRow := 0;
                    IF ThisCellHasFormulaError THEN
                      SetFormula(ExcelBuf.GetExcelReference(7));
                  END;
              UNTIL ThisCellHasFormulaError OR (ExcelBuf.NEXT = 0);

            IF NOT ThisCellHasFormulaError AND (FirstRow <> 0) THEN BEGIN
              IF FirstRow = LastRow THEN
                ThisCellHasFormulaError := AddToFormula(xlColID + FORMAT(FirstRow))
              ELSE
                ThisCellHasFormulaError :=
                  AddToFormula('SUM(' + xlColID + FORMAT(FirstRow) + ':' + xlColID + FORMAT(LastRow) + ')');
              FirstRow := 0;
              IF ThisCellHasFormulaError THEN
                SetFormula(ExcelBuf.GetExcelReference(7));
            END;

            ExcelBuf.RESET;
            ExcelBuf.GET("Row No.","Column No.");
            ExcelBuf.SetFormula(GetFormula);
            ExcelBuf.MODIFY;
            HasFormulaError := HasFormulaError OR ThisCellHasFormulaError;
          UNTIL NEXT = 0;

      EXIT(HasFormulaError);
    END;

    PROCEDURE AddToFormula@12(Text@1001 : Text[30]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      Overflow@1002 : Boolean;
      LongFormula@1000 : Text[1000];
    BEGIN
      LongFormula := GetFormula;
      IF LongFormula = '' THEN
        LongFormula := '=';
      IF LongFormula <> '=' THEN
        IF STRLEN(LongFormula) + 1 > MAXSTRLEN(LongFormula) THEN
          Overflow := TRUE
        ELSE
          LongFormula := LongFormula + '+';
      IF STRLEN(LongFormula) + STRLEN(Text) > MAXSTRLEN(LongFormula) THEN
        Overflow := TRUE
      ELSE
        SetFormula(LongFormula + Text);
      EXIT(Overflow);
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetFormula@13() : Text[1000];
    BEGIN
      EXIT(Formula + Formula2 + Formula3 + Formula4);
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetFormula@22(LongFormula@1000 : Text[1000]);
    BEGIN
      ClearFormula;
      IF LongFormula = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      Formula := COPYSTR(LongFormula,1,MAXSTRLEN(Formula));
      IF STRLEN(LongFormula) > MAXSTRLEN(Formula) THEN
        Formula2 := COPYSTR(LongFormula,MAXSTRLEN(Formula) + 1,MAXSTRLEN(Formula2));
      IF STRLEN(LongFormula) > MAXSTRLEN(Formula) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula2) THEN
        Formula3 := COPYSTR(LongFormula,MAXSTRLEN(Formula) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula2) + 1,MAXSTRLEN(Formula3));
      IF STRLEN(LongFormula) > MAXSTRLEN(Formula) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula2) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula3) THEN
        Formula4 := COPYSTR(LongFormula,MAXSTRLEN(Formula) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula2) + MAXSTRLEN(Formula3) + 1,MAXSTRLEN(Formula4));
    END;

    PROCEDURE ClearFormula@18();
    BEGIN
      Formula := '';
      Formula2 := '';
      Formula3 := '';
      Formula4 := '';
    END;

    PROCEDURE NewRow@14();
    BEGIN
      CurrentRow := CurrentRow + 1;
      IF CurrentRow > LatestRow THEN
        LatestRow := CurrentRow;
      CurrentCol := 0;
      IF CurrentCol > LatestCol THEN
        LatestCol := CurrentCol;
    END;

    PROCEDURE AddColumn@16(Value@1000 : Variant;IsFormula@1001 : Boolean;CommentText@1002 : Text[1000];IsBold@1003 : Boolean;IsItalics@1004 : Boolean;IsUnderline@1005 : Boolean;NumFormat@1006 : Text[30];CellType@1007 : Option);
    VAR
      LinesLineNo@5447300 : Integer;
      j@5447301 : Integer;
      Boolean@1000000000 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF CurrentRow < 1 THEN
        NewRow;

      CurrentCol := CurrentCol + 1;
      IF CurrentCol > LatestCol THEN
        LatestCol := CurrentCol;

      IF GET(CurrentRow,CurrentCol) THEN BEGIN
        IF IsFormula THEN
          SetFormula(FORMAT(Value))
        ELSE BEGIN
          IF STRLEN(FORMAT(Value)) > 250 THEN BEGIN
            "Cell Value as Text" := '';
            Lines := TRUE;
            LinesLineNo := 10000;
            j := 0;
            WHILE j <= 32767 DO BEGIN
              IF COPYSTR(FORMAT(Value),j+1,250) <> '' THEN BEGIN
                CLEAR(ExcelBuffLines);
                ExcelBuffLines.INIT;
                ExcelBuffLines."Row No." := CurrentRow;
                ExcelBuffLines."Column No." := CurrentCol;
                ExcelBuffLines."Line No." := LinesLineNo;
                ExcelBuffLines.Value := COPYSTR(FORMAT(Value),j+1,250);
                ExcelBuffLines.INSERT(TRUE);
              END;
              LinesLineNo += 10000;
              j+= 250;
            END;
            COMMIT;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            IF Value.ISBOOLEAN THEN BEGIN
              Boolean := Value;
              IF Boolean = TRUE THEN
                "Cell Value as Text" := 'Ja'
              ELSE
                "Cell Value as Text" := 'Nein';
            END ELSE
              "Cell Value as Text" := FORMAT(Value);
          END;
        END;
        Comment := CommentText;
        Bold := IsBold;
        Italic := IsItalics;
        Underline := IsUnderline;
        NumberFormat := NumFormat;
        "Cell Type" := CellType;
        MODIFY(TRUE);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        INIT;
        VALIDATE("Row No.",CurrentRow);
        VALIDATE("Column No.",CurrentCol);
        IF IsFormula THEN
          SetFormula(FORMAT(Value))
        ELSE BEGIN
          IF STRLEN(FORMAT(Value)) > 250 THEN BEGIN
            "Cell Value as Text" := '';
            Lines := TRUE;
            LinesLineNo := 10000;
            j := 0;
            WHILE j <= 32767 DO BEGIN
              IF COPYSTR(FORMAT(Value),j+1,250) <> '' THEN BEGIN
                ExcelBuffLines.INIT;
                ExcelBuffLines."Row No." := CurrentRow;
                ExcelBuffLines."Column No." := CurrentCol;
                ExcelBuffLines."Line No." := LinesLineNo;
                ExcelBuffLines.Value := COPYSTR(FORMAT(Value),j+1,250);
                ExcelBuffLines.INSERT(TRUE);
              END;
              LinesLineNo += 10000;
              j+= 250;
            END;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            IF Value.ISBOOLEAN THEN BEGIN
              Boolean := Value;
              IF Boolean = TRUE THEN
                "Cell Value as Text" := 'Ja'
              ELSE
                "Cell Value as Text" := 'Nein';
            END ELSE
              "Cell Value as Text" := FORMAT(Value);
          END;
        END;
        Comment := CommentText;
        Bold := IsBold;
        Italic := IsItalics;
        Underline := IsUnderline;
        NumberFormat := NumFormat;
        "Cell Type" := CellType;
        INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE AddInfoColumn@24(Value@1006 : Variant;IsFormula@1005 : Boolean;CommentText@1004 : Text[1000];IsBold@1003 : Boolean;IsItalics@1002 : Boolean;IsUnderline@1001 : Boolean;NumFormat@1000 : Text[30];CellType@1007 : Option);

    PROCEDURE UTgetGlobalValue@35(globalVariable@1001 : Text[30];VAR value@1000 : Variant);
    BEGIN
      CASE globalVariable OF
        'CurrentRow':
          value := CurrentRow;
        'CurrentCol':
          value := CurrentCol;
        'RangeStartXlRow':
          value := RangeStartXlRow;
        'RangeStartXlCol':
          value := RangeStartXlCol;
        'RangeEndXlRow':
          value := RangeEndXlRow;
        'RangeEndXlCol':
          value := RangeEndXlCol;
        'XlWrkSht':
          value := XlWrkShtWriter;
        'ExcelFile':
          value := FileNameServer;
        'XlWrkBkWriter':
          value := XlWrkBkWriter;
        ELSE
          ERROR(Text038,globalVariable);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE QuitExcel@29();
    BEGIN
      // Close and clear the OpenXml book
      CloseBook;

      // Clear the worksheet automation
      IF NOT ISNULL(XlWrkSht) THEN
        CLEAR(XlWrkSht);

      // Clear the workbook automation
      IF NOT ISNULL(XlWrkBk) THEN
        CLEAR(XlWrkBk);

      // Clear and quit the Excel application automation
      IF NOT ISNULL(XlApp) THEN BEGIN
        XlHelper.CallQuit(XlApp);
        CLEAR(XlApp);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE OpenExcel@31();
    VAR
      FileNameClient@1000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF OpenUsingDocumentService('') THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT PreOpenExcel THEN
        EXIT;

      // rename the Temporary filename into a more UI friendly name in a new subdirectory
      FileNameClient := FileManagement.DownloadTempFile(FileNameServer);
      FileNameClient := FileManagement.MoveAndRenameClientFile(FileNameClient,GetFriendlyFilename,FORMAT(CREATEGUID));

      XlWrkBk := XlHelper.CallOpen(XlApp,FileNameClient);

      PostOpenExcel;
    END;

    PROCEDURE DownloadAndOpenExcel@34();
    VAR
      ClientFilename@1000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      ClientFilename := GetFriendlyFilename;

      IF FileManagement.CanRunDotNetOnClient THEN BEGIN
        ClientFilename := FileManagement.SaveFileDialog('Save file','',Text034);
        IF ClientFilename = '' THEN
          EXIT;
        IF FileManagement.GetExtension(ClientFilename) = '' THEN
          ClientFilename += ExcelFileExtensionTok;
      END;

      OverwriteAndOpenExistingExcel(ClientFilename);
    END;

    PROCEDURE OverwriteAndOpenExistingExcel@15(FileName@1000 : Text);
    BEGIN
      IF FileName = '' THEN
        ERROR(Text001);

      IF OpenUsingDocumentService(FileName) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT PreOpenExcel THEN
        EXIT;

      FileManagement.DownloadToFile(FileNameServer,FileName);
      XlWrkBk := XlHelper.CallOpen(XlApp,FileName);

      PostOpenExcel;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OpenUsingDocumentService@21(FileName@1000 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      DocumentServiceMgt@1005 : Codeunit 9510;
      FileMgt@1004 : Codeunit 419;
      PathHelper@1003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.IO.Path";
      DialogWindow@1002 : Dialog;
      DocumentUrl@1001 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS(FileNameServer) THEN
        ERROR(Text003,FileNameServer);

      // if document service is configured we save the generated document to SharePoint and open it from there.
      IF DocumentServiceMgt.IsConfigured THEN BEGIN
        IF FileName = '' THEN
          FileName := 'Book.' + PathHelper.ChangeExtension(PathHelper.GetRandomFileName,'xlsx')
        ELSE BEGIN
          // if file is not applicable for the service it can not be opened using the document service.
          IF NOT DocumentServiceMgt.IsServiceUri(FileName) THEN
            EXIT(FALSE);

          FileName := FileMgt.GetFileName(FileName);
        END;

        DialogWindow.OPEN(STRSUBSTNO(SavingDocumentMsg,FileName));
        DocumentUrl := DocumentServiceMgt.SaveFile(FileNameServer,FileName,TRUE);
        DocumentServiceMgt.OpenDocument(DocumentUrl);
        DialogWindow.CLOSE;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PreOpenExcel@7() : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS(FileNameServer) THEN
        ERROR(Text003,FileNameServer);

      // Download file, if none RTC it should return a filename, and use client automation instead.
      IF NOT FileManagement.CanRunDotNetOnClient THEN BEGIN
        IF NOT FileManagement.DownloadHandler(FileNameServer,Text040,'',Text034,GetFriendlyFilename) THEN
          ERROR(Text001);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      XlApp := XlApp.ApplicationClass;
      IF ISNULL(XlApp) THEN
        ERROR(Text000);

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PostOpenExcel@8();
    BEGIN
      XlWrkBk := XlApp.ActiveWorkbook;

      IF ISNULL(XlWrkBk) THEN
        ERROR(Text036);

      // autofit all columns on all worksheets
      XlHelper.AutoFitColumnsInAllWorksheets(XlWrkBk);

      // activate the previous saved sheet name in the workbook
      XlHelper.ActivateSheet(XlWrkBk,ActiveSheetName);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateBookAndOpenExcel@32(FileName@1004 : Text;SheetName@1000 : Text[250];ReportHeader@1003 : Text;CompanyName2@1002 : Text;UserID2@1001 : Text);
    BEGIN
      CreateBook(FileName,SheetName);
      WriteSheet(ReportHeader,CompanyName2,UserID2);
      CloseBook;
      OpenExcel;
      GiveUserControl;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateProgressDialog@36(VAR ExcelBufferDialogManagement@1000 : Codeunit 5370;VAR LastUpdate@1001 : DateTime;CurrentCount@1002 : Integer;TotalCount@1004 : Integer) : Boolean;
    VAR
      CurrentTime@1003 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      // Refresh at 100%, and every second in between 0% to 100%
      // Duration is measured in miliseconds -> 1 sec = 1000 ms
      CurrentTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
      IF (CurrentCount = TotalCount) OR (CurrentTime - LastUpdate >= 1000) THEN BEGIN
        LastUpdate := CurrentTime;
        ExcelBufferDialogManagement.SetProgress(ROUND(CurrentCount / TotalCount * 10000,1));
        IF NOT ExcelBufferDialogManagement.RUN THEN
          EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE)
    END;

OBJECT Table 5447341 Webshop Subscription Seq. Step
{

    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnInsert=VAR
               Error001@1000000000 : TextConst 'DEU=Es kann kein Fixdatum in einem Sequenz-Schritt f�r ein Abonnement mit Start-Typ "Neue Sequenz beginnen" angegeben werden.;ENU=It is not possible to set a fix date in a sequence-step for a subscription with start type "Start new sequence"';

               WebshopSubscriptionHeader.GET("Subscription Code");

                  ERROR(Error001);

    PROCEDURE ApplyActiveCampaignsToSalesOrder@1000000000(OrderNo@1000000000 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@1000000004 : Record 37;
      WebshopCampaignHeader@1000000002 : Record 5447345;
      WebshopCampaignElement@1000000003 : Record 5447346;
      SalesLineItemsTmp@1000000006 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      SalesLineCondItemsTmp@1000000005 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      SalesLineActItemsTmp@1000000013 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      ItemFullfillmentFactors@1000000007 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2";
      CampaignApplication@1000000008 : Record 5447347;
      ExistingApplicationHandlingDialog@1000000009 : Dialog;
      ExistingApplicationHandlingQuestion@1000000010 : TextConst 'DEU=Die anwendbare Kampagne mit dem Code %1 wurde bereits auf diese Verkaufsbestellung angewandt.\Wie soll mit der Kampagne verfahren werden?;ENU=The applicable Campaign with Code %1 has already been applied to this Sales Order.\How should the Campaign be handled?';
      ExistingApplicationHandlingOptions@1000000011 : TextConst 'DEU=�berspringen,Ein weiteres Mal anwenden,R�ckg�ngig machen und neu anwenden;ENU=Skip,Apply a further time,Revert and apply anew';
      SelectedHandlingOption@1000000012 : Integer;
      NoOfAppliedCampaigns@1000000014 : Integer;
      ExitMessage@1000000015 : TextConst 'DEU=Die folgenden Kampagnen sind nun auf die Verkaufsbestellung angewandt:\%1;ENU=The following Campaigns are now applied to the Sales Order:\%1';
      DateFilter1@1000000016 : TextConst 'ENU="''''|<=%1"';
      DateFilter2@1000000017 : TextConst 'ENU="''''|>=%1"';
      CampaignString@1000000018 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo) THEN BEGIN

        NoOfAppliedCampaigns := 0;
        ItemFullfillmentFactors := ItemFullfillmentFactors.Dictionary;

        WebshopCampaignHeader.SETRANGE(Active,TRUE);
        WebshopCampaignHeader.SETFILTER("Active from Date",DateFilter1,WORKDATE);
        WebshopCampaignHeader.SETFILTER("Active to Date",DateFilter2,WORKDATE);
        WebshopCampaignHeader.SETFILTER("Active from Time",DateFilter1,TIME);
        WebshopCampaignHeader.SETFILTER("Active to Time",DateFilter2,TIME);
        IF WebshopCampaignHeader.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          // Make Tmp Copy of Item Sales Lines for Campaign Condition/Action-Item Evaluation
          // Do inside loop because applications of campaigns need to get the itemset
          // as previously modified by other campaigns in the loop
          SalesLineItemsTmp.RESET;
          SalesLineItemsTmp.DELETEALL(FALSE);
          SalesLine.RESET;
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
          SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
          IF SalesLine.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
            SalesLineItemsTmp := SalesLine;
            SalesLineItemsTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
          UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

          IF SalesLineItemsTmp.COUNT > 0 THEN BEGIN
            // Check if Campaign was already applied to Sales Order when GUIALLOWED
            // Let user select Skipping, Applying a further time, and Reverting before applying again
            // Pre-Select "Skip" if campaign is not multiply applicable, "Apply a further time" otherwise
            IF WebshopCampaignHeader."Multiply applicable" THEN
              SelectedHandlingOption := 2
            ELSE
              SelectedHandlingOption := 1;
            IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
              CampaignApplication.RESET;
              CampaignApplication.SETRANGE("Campaign Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
              CampaignApplication.SETRANGE("Order No.",SalesHeader."No.");
              IF (NOT CampaignApplication.ISEMPTY) AND WebshopCampaignHeader."Multiply applicable" THEN
                SelectedHandlingOption := DIALOG.STRMENU(ExistingApplicationHandlingOptions,SelectedHandlingOption,STRSUBSTNO(ExistingApplicationHandlingQuestion,WebshopCampaignHeader.Code));
            END;
            IF CampaignApplication.ISEMPTY OR (SelectedHandlingOption > 1) THEN BEGIN // 1 = Skip
              IF SelectedHandlingOption = 3 THEN // 3 = Revert before applying
                  CampaignApplication.UnapplyCampaignAdjustmentForSalesOrder(SalesHeader,WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
              SalesLineCondItemsTmp.RESET;
              SalesLineCondItemsTmp.DELETEALL(FALSE);
              ItemFullfillmentFactors.Clear;
              IF DoesCampaignApplyToSalesOrder(WebshopCampaignHeader,SalesHeader,SalesLineCondItemsTmp,ItemFullfillmentFactors) THEN BEGIN
                FilterSalesOrderLinesIntoTmpByCampaignElements(SalesLineItemsTmp,SalesLineActItemsTmp,WebshopCampaignHeader,1); // 1 = Action
                COMMIT;
                ApplyCampaignToSalesOrder(SalesHeader,WebshopCampaignHeader,SalesLineCondItemsTmp,SalesLineActItemsTmp,ItemFullfillmentFactors);
              END;
            END;
          END;
        UNTIL WebshopCampaignHeader.NEXT = 0;
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          CampaignApplication.RESET;
          CampaignApplication.SETRANGE("Order No.",OrderNo);
          IF CampaignApplication.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
            IF WebshopCampaignHeader.GET(CampaignApplication."Campaign Code") AND (STRPOS(CampaignString,WebshopCampaignHeader.Description) = 0) THEN BEGIN
              IF  CampaignString <> '' THEN
                CampaignString += '\';
              CampaignString += ' - ' + WebshopCampaignHeader.Description;
            END;
          UNTIL CampaignApplication.NEXT = 0;
          MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(ExitMessage,CampaignString));
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DoesCampaignApplyToSalesOrder@1000000001(WebshopCampaignHeader@1000000002 : Record 5447345;SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36;VAR SalesLineCondItemsTmp@1000000004 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR ItemFullfillmentFactors@1000000008 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2") IsApplicable : Boolean;

      Error001@1000000001 : TextConst 'DEU=Es muss extakt ein Webshop Kampagnen Kopf als Parameter an die Funktion\DoesCampaignHeaderApplyToSalesOrder �bergeben werden!;ENU=Exactly one Webshop Campaign Header record must be passed\to the function DoesCampaignHeaderApplyToSalesOrder!';

      SalesLine@1000000007 : Record 37;
      CompiledErrorMessage@1000000006 : Text;
      HasError@1000000009 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      //  Pass a non-filtered, empty temporary Sales Line Record Variable as
      //  the value of SalesLineCondItemsTmp. If the function returns true,
      //  the variable will contain the filtered condition items of the Sales Order.

      CompiledErrorMessage := '';
      IF NOT WebshopCampaignHeader.GET(WebshopCampaignHeader.Code) THEN BEGIN
        HasError := TRUE;
        CompiledErrorMessage += Error001;
      END;
      IF NOT SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF HasError THEN
          CompiledErrorMessage += '\';
        CompiledErrorMessage += Error002;
        HasError := TRUE;
      END;
      IF NOT SalesLineCondItemsTmp.ISTEMPORARY THEN BEGIN
        IF HasError THEN
         CompiledErrorMessage += '\';
        CompiledErrorMessage += Error003;
        HasError := TRUE;
      END;
      IF HasError THEN
        ERROR(CompiledErrorMessage);

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);

        (WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. No. diff. Items GTE" = 0) AND (WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Basket Total GTE" = 0)) THEN
        IsApplicable := TRUE;

      IF NOT WebshopCampaignHeader.Active THEN
        IsApplicable := FALSE
      ELSE IF ((WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Basket Total GTE" > 0) AND IsItemSalesLineTotalAmntGTE(SalesLine,WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Basket Total GTE",ItemFullfillmentFactors)) OR
        ((WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. No. diff. Items GTE" > 0) AND IsNoOfDistSalesLineCondItemsGTE(SalesLineCondItemsTmp,WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. No. diff. Items GTE",ItemFullfillmentFactors)) OR

        ((WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Qty. Single Item GTE" > 0) AND IsAnySalesLineCondItemQtyGTE(SalesLineCondItemsTmp,WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Qty. Single Item GTE",ItemFullfillmentFactors)) OR
        ((WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Sum Amnt. All Items GTE" > 0) AND IsItemSalesLineTotalAmntGTE(SalesLineCondItemsTmp,WebshopCampaignHeader."Cond. Sum Amnt. All Items GTE",ItemFullfillmentFactors)) OR

      WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
      WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
      IF WebshopCampaignElement.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
        IF WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude" = WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"0" THEN BEGIN
          HasIncludes := TRUE;
          IF WebshopCampaignElement."Item No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
            HasItemIncludes := TRUE;
            HasItemConditions := TRUE;
          END ELSE IF WebshopCampaignElement."Category Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            HasCategoryIncludes := TRUE;
            HasCategoryConditions := TRUE;
          END;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          HasExcludes := TRUE;
          IF WebshopCampaignElement."Item No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
            HasItemExcludes := TRUE;
            HasItemConditions := TRUE;
          END ELSE IF WebshopCampaignElement."Category Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            HasCategoryExcludes := TRUE;
            HasCategoryConditions := TRUE;
          END;
        END;
      UNTIL WebshopCampaignElement.NEXT = 0;

      // Prepare Category checks if necessary
      IF HasCategoryConditions THEN BEGIN

        WebshopShop.RESET;
        DefaultDialogOptionNo := 1;
        IF WebshopCampaignHeader."Shop Code" = '' THEN BEGIN
          SelectedDialogOptionNo := 1;
          IF (WebshopShop.COUNT > 1) AND GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            i := 1;
            IF WebshopShop.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF i <> 1 THEN
                ShopDialogOptionsString += ',';
              ShopDialogOptionsString += STRSUBSTNO(ShopDialogOptionsTemplate,WebshopShop.Code,WebshopShop.Description);
              IF WebshopShop.Code = WebshopSetup."Default Shop Code" THEN
                DefaultDialogOptionNo := i;
              i += 1;
            UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;
            SelectedDialogOptionNo := DIALOG.STRMENU(ShopDialogOptionsString,DefaultDialogOptionNo,ShopDialogText);
          END;
          IF SelectedDialogOptionNo = 1 THEN BEGIN
            WebshopShop.FINDFIRST;
            ShopCode := WebshopShop.Code;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopShop.RESET;
            i := 1;
            IF WebshopShop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              i += 1;
            UNTIL (i = SelectedDialogOptionNo) OR (WebshopShop.NEXT = 0);
            ShopCode := WebshopShop.Code;
          END
        END ELSE
          ShopCode := WebshopCampaignHeader."Shop Code";

        WebshopLanguage.RESET;
        WebshopLanguage.SETRANGE("Shop Code",ShopCode);
        DefaultDialogOptionNo := 1;
        IF WebshopCampaignHeader."Language Code" = '' THEN BEGIN
          SelectedDialogOptionNo := 1;
          IF (WebshopLanguage.COUNT > 1) AND GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            i := 1;
            IF WebshopLanguage.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF i <> 1 THEN
                LanguageDialogOptionsString += ',';
              LanguageDialogOptionsString += WebshopLanguage.Code;
              IF WebshopLanguage.Code = WebshopShop."Default Language Code" THEN
                DefaultDialogOptionNo := i;
              i += 1;
            UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;
            SelectedDialogOptionNo := DIALOG.STRMENU(ShopDialogOptionsString,DefaultDialogOptionNo,ShopDialogText);
          END;
          IF SelectedDialogOptionNo = 1 THEN BEGIN
            WebshopLanguage.FINDFIRST;
            LanguageCode := WebshopLanguage.Code;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopLanguage.RESET;
            WebshopLanguage.SETRANGE("Shop Code",ShopCode);
            i := 1;
            IF WebshopLanguage.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              i += 1;
            UNTIL (i = SelectedDialogOptionNo) OR (WebshopLanguage.NEXT = 0);
            LanguageCode := WebshopLanguage.Code;
          END;
        END ELSE
          LanguageCode := WebshopCampaignHeader."Language Code";

        WebshopItemCategory.SetItemCategoriesWithAncestors(ShopCode,LanguageCode,ItemNo,ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp);

      END;


      //  If there are no inclusive conditions
      //  Item will match per default
      //  If there are inclusive conditions
      //  The default is no match

      IF NOT HasIncludes THEN BEGIN

        Matches := TRUE;
        IF HasItemExcludes THEN BEGIN
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"1");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          IF VariantCode <> '' THEN
            WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",VariantCode);
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := FALSE
        END;

        IF HasCategoryExcludes  AND ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"1");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp."Line No.");
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := FALSE
        UNTIL ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.NEXT = 0;

      END ELSE BEGIN

        Matches := FALSE;

        IF HasItemIncludes THEN BEGIN
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"0");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := TRUE
        END;

        IF HasCategoryIncludes AND ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"0");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp."Line No.");
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := TRUE
        UNTIL ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.NEXT = 0;
        ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.RESET;

        IF HasItemExcludes THEN BEGIN
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"1");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          IF VariantCode <> '' THEN
            WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",VariantCode);
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := FALSE
        END;

        IF HasCategoryExcludes  AND ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          WebshopCampaignElement.RESET;
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link-to Header Code",WebshopCampaignHeader.Code);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",ElementType);
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Include / Exclude",WebshopCampaignElement."Include / Exclude"::"1");
          WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp."Line No.");
          IF NOT WebshopCampaignElement.ISEMPTY THEN
            Matches := FALSE
        UNTIL ItemCategoriesWithAncestorsTmp.NEXT = 0;

      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ApplyCampaignDiscountToSalesOrder@1000000017(WebshopCampaign@1000000003 : Record 5447345;SalesOrder@1000000002 : Record 36;VAR FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp@1000000001 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR FilteredActItemOrderSalesLinesTmp@1000000004 : TEMPORARY Record 37;ItemFullfillmentFactors@1000000000 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2");
    VAR
      OrderSalesLine@1000000005 : Record 37;
      DiscountApplicationTarget@1000000009 : 'None,CurrCondItem,AllCondItem,LeastExpCondItem,AllActItem,Basket';
      InitialDiscountValue@1000000010 : Decimal;
      FinalDiscountValue@1000000018 : Decimal;
      DiscountType@1000000011 : 'Amount,Percent';
      DictvalueVariant@1000000008 : Variant;
      ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor@1000000007 : Decimal;
      WebshopCampaignElement@1000000006 : Record 5447346;
      ErrorString@1000000012 : Text;
      Error001@1000000017 : TextConst 'DEU=WebshopCampaign muss ein eindeutiger Kampagnen-Kopf sein.;ENU=WebshopCampaign must be a unique Campaign Header.';
      Error002@1000000016 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Kampagne muss Betrags- oder Prozentrabatt als Aktion haben.;ENU=The Campaign must have an amount- or percent-discount action.';
      Error003@1000000015 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein eindeutiger Verkaufskopf sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a unique Sales Header.';
      Error004@1000000014 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein Verkaufsauftrag sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a Sales Order.';
      Error005@1000000013 : TextConst 'DEU=Verkaufsauftrag darf nicht den Status "Freigegeben" haben.;ENU=Sales Order must not have the status "Released".';
      DictionaryValue@1000000020 : Variant;
      DictionaryKey@1000000019 : Variant;
      SalesLineCopy@1000000021 : Record 37;
      InsertModify@1000000022 : 'Insert,Modify';
      QtyToDiscount@1000000023 : Decimal;
      LineDiscPercent@1000000024 : Decimal;
      NewLineAmount@1000000025 : Decimal;
      FilterBySet@1000000026 : RecordRef;
      OrderSalesLineTmp@1000000027 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      LeastExpCondItemLineNo@1000000028 : Integer;
      LeastExptCondItemUnitPrice@1000000029 : Decimal;
      CampaignApplicationLine@1000000030 : Record 5447347;
      PrevQty@1000000031 : Decimal;
      NewQty@1000000032 : Decimal;
      PrevLineDiscountPercent@1000000033 : Decimal;
      NewLineDiscountPercent@1000000034 : Decimal;
      PrevLineDiscountAmount@1000000035 : Decimal;
      NewLineDiscountAmount@1000000036 : Decimal;
      PrevLineAmnt@1000000037 : Decimal;
      LineNoFieldRef@1000000038 : FieldRef;
      CurrLineNo@1000000039 : Integer;
      PrevUnitPrice@1000000040 : Decimal;
      NewUnitPrice@1000000041 : Decimal;
      NewAdjustmentLineNo@1000000042 : Integer;
      LinesInserted@1000000043 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF (NOT WebshopCampaign.GET(WebshopCampaign.Code)) THEN
        ErrorString += Error001;
      IF (NOT((WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt." > 0) OR (WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent" > 0))) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error002;
      END;
      IF (NOT SalesOrder.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.")) OR (NOT(SalesOrder."Document Type" = SalesOrder."Document Type"::Order)) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error003;
      END;
      IF (SalesOrder.Status = SalesOrder.Status::Released) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error005;
      END;
      IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
        ERROR(ErrorString);


      IF (WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt." > 0) THEN BEGIN
        DiscountType := DiscountType::Amount;
        InitialDiscountValue := WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt.";
        CASE WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt. applies to" OF
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt. applies to"::CurrCondItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::CurrCondItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt. applies to"::AllCondItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::AllCondItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt. applies to"::AllActItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::AllActItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Amnt. applies to"::Basket:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::Basket;
        END;
      END ELSE IF (WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent" > 0) THEN BEGIN
        DiscountType := DiscountType::Percent;
        InitialDiscountValue := WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent";
        CASE WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to" OF
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to"::CurrCondItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::CurrCondItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to"::AllCondItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::AllCondItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to"::LeastExpCondItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::LeastExpCondItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to"::AllActItem:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::AllActItem;
          WebshopCampaign."Discount Percent applies to"::Basket:
            DiscountApplicationTarget := DiscountApplicationTarget::Basket;
        END;
      END;

      OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesOrder."Document Type");
      OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesOrder."No.");
      OrderSalesLine.LOCKTABLE;

      CASE DiscountApplicationTarget OF
        DiscountApplicationTarget::AllCondItem:
          FilterBySet.GETTABLE(FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp);
        DiscountApplicationTarget::CurrCondItem:
          BEGIN
            IF (NOT FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.GET(FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Document Type",FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Document No.",FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Line No.")) AND
              (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.COUNT > 0) THEN
              FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.FINDLAST;
            IF FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.GET(FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Document Type",FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Document No.",FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Line No.") THEN
              IF (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.Type = FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.Type::Item) AND (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.Quantity > 0) THEN BEGIN
                OrderSalesLineTmp := FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp;
                OrderSalesLineTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
                FilterBySet.GETTABLE(OrderSalesLineTmp);
              END;
          END;
        DiscountApplicationTarget::LeastExpCondItem:
          BEGIN
            IF FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price" > 0) AND ((FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price" < LeastExptCondItemUnitPrice) OR (LeastExptCondItemUnitPrice = 0)) THEN BEGIN
                LeastExpCondItemLineNo := FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Line No.";
                LeastExptCondItemUnitPrice := FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price";
              END;
            UNTIL FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.NEXT = 0;
            IF FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.",LeastExpCondItemLineNo) AND (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.Quantity > 0) THEN BEGIN
              OrderSalesLineTmp := FilteredActItemOrderSalesLinesTmp;
              OrderSalesLineTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
              FilterBySet.GETTABLE(OrderSalesLineTmp);
            END;
          END;
        DiscountApplicationTarget::AllActItem:
          FilterBySet.GETTABLE(FilteredActItemOrderSalesLinesTmp);
        DiscountApplicationTarget::Basket:
          BEGIN
            IF OrderSalesLine.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF (OrderSalesLine.Type = OrderSalesLine.Type::Item) AND (OrderSalesLine.Quantity > 0) THEN BEGIN
                OrderSalesLineTmp := OrderSalesLine;
                OrderSalesLineTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
              END;
            UNTIL OrderSalesLine.NEXT = 0;
            FilterBySet.GETTABLE(OrderSalesLineTmp);
          END;
      END;

      LinesInserted := 0;
      //FilterBySet.ASCENDING(FALSE);
      IF (FilterBySet.NUMBER > 0) AND FilterBySet.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
        LineNoFieldRef := FilterBySet.FIELD(4);// 4 = Line No.
        CurrLineNo := LineNoFieldRef.VALUE;
        CurrLineNo += (LinesInserted * 10000);
        IF OrderSalesLine.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.",CurrLineNo) THEN BEGIN
          DictionaryKey := OrderSalesLine."No.";
          IF (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Basket Total GTE" > 0) OR
            (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Sum Amnt. All Items GTE" > 0) OR
            (WebshopCampaign."Cond. No. diff. Items GTE" > 0) OR
            (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Total Item Qty. GTE" > 0) THEN
            DictionaryKey := AllItemsFullfillmentKey;

          CLEAR(DictionaryValue);
          IF ItemFullfillmentFactors.TryGetValue(DictionaryKey,DictionaryValue) AND (DictionaryValue.ISDECIMAL OR DictionaryValue.ISINTEGER) THEN
            ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor := ROUND(DictionaryValue);
          IF ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor < 1 THEN // So we don't multiply by 0
            ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor := 1;

          InsertModify := InsertModify::Modify;
          QtyToDiscount := OrderSalesLine.Quantity;
          PrevLineAmnt := OrderSalesLine."Line Amount";
          NewLineAmount := PrevLineAmnt;
          PrevLineDiscountAmount := OrderSalesLine."Line Discount Amount";
          NewLineDiscountAmount := PrevLineDiscountAmount;
          PrevLineDiscountPercent := OrderSalesLine."Line Discount %";
          NewLineDiscountPercent := PrevLineDiscountPercent;
          PrevUnitPrice := OrderSalesLine."Unit Price";
          NewUnitPrice := PrevUnitPrice;
          PrevQty := OrderSalesLine.Quantity;
          NewQty := PrevQty;


          // Split SalesLine if Discount applies to Qty smaller than Line's Qty
          IF (WebshopCampaign."Discount applies to Qty. (max)" > 0) AND (WebshopCampaign."Discount applies to Qty. (max)" < OrderSalesLine.Quantity) THEN BEGIN
            SalesLineCopy := OrderSalesLine;
            MoveDownAllSalesLinesAfterLineNoByNLines(SalesOrder,OrderSalesLine."Line No.",1);
            LinesInserted += 1;
            OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,(OrderSalesLine.Quantity - WebshopCampaign."Discount applies to Qty. (max)"));
            OrderSalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);

            CampaignApplicationLine.InsertNewAdjustmentLine(WebshopCampaign.Code,SalesOrder."No.",OrderSalesLine."Line No.",SalesLineCopy.Quantity,OrderSalesLine.Quantity,0,0,0,0,0,0);

            NewQty := WebshopCampaign."Discount applies to Qty. (max)";
            OrderSalesLine.INIT;
            OrderSalesLine := SalesLineCopy;
            OrderSalesLine."Line No." += 10000; // Default distance
            OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,NewQty);
            InsertModify := InsertModify::Insert;
            QtyToDiscount := NewQty;
            PrevLineDiscountAmount := OrderSalesLine."Line Discount Amount";
            PrevLineDiscountPercent := OrderSalesLine."Line Discount %";
            PrevLineAmnt := OrderSalesLine."Line Amount";
            PrevQty := 0;
          END;

          CASE DiscountType OF
            DiscountType::Amount:
              BEGIN
                FinalDiscountValue := InitialDiscountValue * QtyToDiscount;
                IF WebshopCampaign."Multiply applicable" THEN
                  FinalDiscountValue := InitialDiscountValue * ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor;
                NewLineAmount := PrevLineAmnt - ABS(FinalDiscountValue);
                IF NewLineAmount < 0 THEN
                  NewLineAmount := 0;
                NewUnitPrice := NewLineAmount / OrderSalesLine.Quantity;
                OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",NewUnitPrice);
                OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Amount",NewLineAmount);
              END;
            DiscountType::Percent:
              BEGIN
                FinalDiscountValue := InitialDiscountValue;
                IF WebshopCampaign."Multiply applicable" THEN
                  FinalDiscountValue := InitialDiscountValue * ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor;
                PrevLineDiscountPercent := OrderSalesLine."Line Discount %";
                NewLineDiscountPercent := FinalDiscountValue + PrevLineDiscountPercent;
                IF NewLineDiscountPercent > 100 THEN
                  NewLineDiscountPercent := 100;
                OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount %",NewLineDiscountPercent);
                NewLineAmount := OrderSalesLine."Line Amount";
              END;
          END;
          IF InsertModify = InsertModify::Insert THEN
            OrderSalesLine.INSERT(TRUE)
          ELSE
            OrderSalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);

          IF PrevQty = NewQty THEN BEGIN
            PrevQty := 0;
            NewQty := 0;
          END;
          IF PrevLineAmnt = NewLineAmount THEN BEGIN
            PrevLineAmnt := 0;
            NewLineAmount := 0;
          END;
          IF PrevLineDiscountPercent = NewLineDiscountPercent THEN BEGIN
            PrevLineDiscountPercent := 0;
            NewLineDiscountPercent := 0;
          END;
          IF PrevUnitPrice = NewUnitPrice THEN BEGIN
            PrevUnitPrice := 0;
            NewUnitPrice := 0;
          END;

          CampaignApplicationLine.InsertNewAdjustmentLine(WebshopCampaign.Code,SalesOrder."No.",OrderSalesLine."Line No.",PrevQty,NewQty,PrevLineAmnt,NewLineAmount,PrevLineDiscountPercent,NewLineDiscountPercent,PrevUnitPrice,NewUnitPrice);

        END;
      UNTIL FilterBySet.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE AddCampaignFreeItemsToSalesOrder@1000000015(WebshopCampaign@1000000000 : Record 5447345;SalesOrder@1000000002 : Record 36;VAR FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp@1000000001 : TEMPORARY Record 37;ItemFullfillmentFactors@1000000003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2");
    VAR

      ActionApplicationTarget@1000000008 : 'None,CurrCondItem,AllCondItem,LeastExpCondItem,AllActItem,Basket';
      DictvalueVariant@1000000007 : Variant;
      ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor@1000000006 : Decimal;
      WebshopCampaignElement@1000000005 : Record 5447346;
      ErrorString@1000000009 : Text;
      Error001@1000000014 : TextConst 'DEU=WebshopCampaign muss ein eindeutiger Kampagnen-Kopf sein.;ENU=WebshopCampaign must be a unique Campaign Header.';
      Error002@1000000013 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Kampagne muss vom Typ kostenloser Artikel sein.;ENU=The Campaign must be of the Free Item type.';
      Error003@1000000012 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein eindeutiger Verkaufskopf sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a unique Sales Header.';
      Error004@1000000011 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein Verkaufsauftrag sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a Sales Order.';
      Item@1000000016 : Record 27;
      ItemTmp@1000000015 : TEMPORARY Record 27;
      LeastExpCondItemNo@1000000017 : Code[20];
      LeastExpCondItemUnitPrice@1000000018 : Decimal;
      NoOfLinesToInsert@1000000019 : Integer;
      NewSalesLineNo@1000000020 : Integer;
      DictionaryKey@1000000021 : Variant;
      DictionaryValue@1000000022 : Variant;
      Error005@1000000023 : TextConst 'DEU=Verkaufsauftrag darf nicht den Status "Freigegeben" haben.;ENU=Sales Order must not have the status "Released".';
      CampaignApplicationLine@1000000010 : Record 5447347;
      NewQty@1000000024 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      IF (NOT WebshopCampaign.GET(WebshopCampaign.Code)) THEN
        ErrorString += Error001;
      IF NOT (WebshopCampaign."Qty. Free Item" > 0) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error002;
      END;
      IF (NOT SalesOrder.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.")) OR (NOT(SalesOrder."Document Type" = SalesOrder."Document Type"::Order)) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error003;
      END;
      IF (SalesOrder.Status = SalesOrder.Status::Released) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error005;
      END;
      IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
        ERROR(ErrorString);

      CASE WebshopCampaign."Type Free Item" OF
        WebshopCampaign."Type Free Item"::" ":
          BEGIN
            IF FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.FINDLAST AND Item.GET(FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."No.")THEN BEGIN
              ItemTmp := Item;
              ItemTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
            END;
          END;
        WebshopCampaign."Type Free Item"::LeastExpCondItem:
          BEGIN
            // Only included Items, don't resolve categories
            WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE("Link Type",WebshopCampaignElement."Link Type"::Action);
            WebshopCampaignElement.SETRANGE(Type,WebshopCampaignElement.Type::"0");
            IF WebshopCampaignElement.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF Item.GET(WebshopCampaignElement."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
                ItemTmp := Item;
                ItemTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
              END;
            UNTIL WebshopCampaignElement.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        WebshopCampaign."Type Free Item"::CurrConditem:
          BEGIN
            IF FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF (FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price" > 0) AND ((FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price" < LeastExpCondItemUnitPrice) OR (LeastExpCondItemUnitPrice = 0)) THEN BEGIN
                LeastExpCondItemNo := FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."No.";
                LeastExpCondItemUnitPrice := FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp."Unit Price";
              END;
            UNTIL FilteredCondItemOrderSalesLinesTmp.NEXT = 0;
            IF Item.GET(LeastExpCondItemNo) THEN BEGIN
              ItemTmp := Item;
              ItemTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
            END;
          END;
      END;


      NoOfLinesToInsert := ItemTmp.COUNT;
      OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesOrder."Document Type");
      OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesOrder."No.");
      OrderSalesLine.LOCKTABLE;
      OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,OrderSalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF OrderSalesLine.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        NewSalesLineNo := OrderSalesLine."Line No." + 10000; // Default distance
        MoveDownAllSalesLinesAfterLineNoByNLines(SalesOrder,OrderSalesLine."Line No.",NoOfLinesToInsert);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        OrderSalesLine.RESET;
        OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesOrder."Document Type");
        OrderSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesOrder."No.");
        IF OrderSalesLine.FINDLAST THEN
          NewSalesLineNo := OrderSalesLine."Line No." + 10000
        ELSE
          NewSalesLineNo := 10000;
      END;


      IF ItemTmp.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
        DictionaryKey := OrderSalesLine."No.";
        IF (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Basket Total GTE" > 0) OR
          (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Sum Amnt. All Items GTE" > 0) OR
          (WebshopCampaign."Cond. No. diff. Items GTE" > 0) OR
          (WebshopCampaign."Cond. Total Item Qty. GTE" > 0) THEN
          DictionaryKey := AllItemsFullfillmentKey;

        IF WebshopCampaign."Multiply applicable" AND ItemFullfillmentFactors.TryGetValue(DictionaryKey,DictionaryValue) AND (DictionaryValue.ISDECIMAL OR DictionaryValue.ISINTEGER) THEN
          ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor := ROUND(DictionaryValue);

        IF ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor < 1 THEN // So we don't multiply by 0
          ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor := 1;

        NewQty := WebshopCampaign."Qty. Free Item" * ABS(ItemCriteriaFullfillmentFactor);

        OrderSalesLine.INIT;
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",SalesOrder."Document Type");
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesOrder."No.");
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Line No.",NewSalesLineNo);
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,OrderSalesLine.Type::Item);
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",ItemTmp."No.");
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",0);
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,NewQty);
        OrderSalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Amount",0);
        OrderSalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);

        CampaignApplicationLine.InsertNewAdjustmentLine(WebshopCampaign.Code,SalesOrder."No.",OrderSalesLine."Line No.",0,NewQty,0,0,0,0,0,0);

        NewSalesLineNo += 10000;
      UNTIL ItemTmp.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE MoveDownAllSalesLinesAfterLineNoByNLines@1000000006(SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36;MoveAllAfterLineNo@1000000002 : Integer;MoveByNSteps@1000000003 : Integer);
    VAR
      SalesLine@1000000001 : Record 37;
      ErrorString@1000000004 : Text;
      Error001@1000000005 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein eindeutiger Verkaufskopf sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a unique Sales Header.';
      Error002@1000000006 : TextConst 'DEU=SalesHeader muss ein Verkaufsauftrag sein.;ENU=SalesHeader must be a Sales Order.';
      IntToAddToLineNo@1000000008 : Integer;
      Error003@1000000009 : TextConst 'DEU=Verkaufsauftrag darf nicht den Status "Freigegeben" haben.;ENU=Sales Order must not have the status "Released".';
      SalesLineTmp@1000000007 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
    BEGIN
      IF (NOT SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.")) THEN
        ErrorString += Error001;
      IF (NOT(SalesHeader."Document Type" = SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order)) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error002;
      END;
      IF (SalesHeader.Status = SalesHeader.Status::Released) THEN BEGIN
        IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
          ErrorString += '\';
        ErrorString += Error003;
      END;
      IF ErrorString <> '' THEN
        ERROR(ErrorString);

      IntToAddToLineNo := 10000 * MoveByNSteps;

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.LOCKTABLE;
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Line No.",'>%1',MoveAllAfterLineNo);
      SalesLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Document No.","Line No.");
      SalesLine.ASCENDING(FALSE);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET(TRUE,TRUE) THEN REPEAT
        SalesLineTmp := SalesLine;
        SalesLineTmp.INSERT(FALSE);
        SalesLine.DELETE(TRUE);
        SalesLine := SalesLineTmp;
        SalesLine."Line No." += IntToAddToLineNo;
        SalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---

        Change ApplyDiscount Functions so it loops by filtered temp rec, but applies to physical table
    }

    PROCEDURE GetName@1000000000() Name : Text[80];
    VAR
      Setup@1000000006 : Record 5447300;
      CampaignHeader@1000000000 : Record 5447345;
      Shop@1000000004 : Record 5447301;
      ShopCode@1000000001 : Code[20];
      ItemShopCode@1000000002 : Code[20];
      CategoryShopCode@1000000003 : Code[20];
      LanguageCode@1000000005 : Code[10];
      Item@1000000007 : Record 5447304;
      Category@1000000008 : Record 5447303;
      ItemVariant@1000000009 : Record 5401;
    BEGIN
      Name := '';
      Setup.GET;
      CampaignHeader.GET("Link-to Header Code");

      IF CampaignHeader."Shop Code" <> '' THEN
        Shop.GET(CampaignHeader."Shop Code")
      ELSE
        Shop.GET(Setup."Default Shop Code");

      ShopCode := Shop.Code;
      ItemShopCode := Shop.Code;
      CategoryShopCode := Shop.Code;

      IF Shop."Use Items from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
        ItemShopCode := Shop."Use Items from Shop Code";

      IF Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
        CategoryShopCode := Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code";

      IF CampaignHeader."Language Code" <> '' THEN
        LanguageCode := CampaignHeader."Language Code"
      ELSE
        LanguageCode := Shop."Default Language Code";

      //Artikel
      IF (Type = Type::"0") AND Item.GET(ItemShopCode,LanguageCode,"Item No.") THEN BEGIN
        Name := Item.Description;
        IF ("Item Variant Code" <> '') AND (ItemVariant.GET("Item No.","Item Variant Code")) THEN
          Name += ' ' + ItemVariant.Description;
      //Kategorie
      END ELSE IF (Type = Type::"1") AND (Category.GET(CategoryShopCode,LanguageCode,"Category Line No.")) THEN BEGIN
        Name := Category.Name;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UnapplyCampaignAdjustmentLineForSalesOrder@1000000008(AdjustmentLine@1000000000 : Record 5447347;SalesOrder@1000000001 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesLine@1000000002 : Record 37;
      Error001@1000000003 : TextConst 'DEU=Der �bergebene Sales Header Record muss dem in der Adjustment Zeile angegebenen eindeutigen Verkaufsauftrag entsprechen!;ENU=The passed Sales Header Record must match the unique Sales Order specified in the Adjustment Line!';
      SalesLineTmp@1000000011 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      SignFactor@1000000004 : Integer;
      RevQtyAdjustment@1000000005 : Decimal;
      NewQty@1000000009 : Decimal;
      RevLineAmntAdjustment@1000000006 : Decimal;
      RevLineDiscPercentAdjustment@1000000007 : Decimal;
      RevUnitPriceAdjustment@1000000008 : Decimal;
      Deleted@1000000010 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF (SalesOrder."Document Type" = SalesOrder."Document Type"::Order) AND
        SalesOrder.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.") AND
        (SalesOrder."No." = AdjustmentLine."Order No.") AND
        SalesLine.GET(SalesOrder."Document Type",SalesOrder."No.",AdjustmentLine."Line No.") THEN BEGIN
          SalesLineTmp := SalesLine;
          Deleted := FALSE;
          SalesLine.LOCKTABLE;

          IF AdjustmentLine."Previous Qty." <> AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Qty." THEN BEGIN
            RevQtyAdjustment := AdjustmentLine."Previous Qty." - AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Qty.";
            NewQty := SalesLine.Quantity + RevQtyAdjustment;
            IF (NewQty <= 0) THEN BEGIN
              SalesLine.DELETE(TRUE);
              Deleted := TRUE;
            END ELSE
              SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLineTmp.Quantity + RevQtyAdjustment);
          END;

          IF (NOT Deleted) AND (AdjustmentLine."Previous Line Disc. %" <> AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Line Disc. %") THEN BEGIN
            RevLineDiscPercentAdjustment := AdjustmentLine."Previous Line Disc. %" - AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Line Disc. %";
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount %",SalesLineTmp."Line Discount %" + RevLineDiscPercentAdjustment);
          END;

          IF (NOT Deleted) AND (AdjustmentLine."Previous Unit Price" <> AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Unit Price") THEN BEGIN
            RevUnitPriceAdjustment := AdjustmentLine."Previous Unit Price" - AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Unit Price";
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",SalesLineTmp."Unit Price" + RevUnitPriceAdjustment);
          END;

          IF (NOT Deleted) AND (AdjustmentLine."Previous Line Amnt." <> AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Line Amnt.") THEN BEGIN
            RevLineAmntAdjustment := AdjustmentLine."Previous Line Amnt." - AdjustmentLine."Adjusted Line Amnt.";
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Amount",SalesLineTmp."Line Amount" + RevLineAmntAdjustment);
          END;

          IF (NOT Deleted) THEN
            SalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
      END ELSE
       ERROR(Error001);
    END;

      AddInTable@1000000005 : Record 2000000069;
      AddInNameVar@1000000006 : Text[250];
      AddInVersionVar@1000000007 : Text[250];
      AddInTokenVar@1000000008 : Text[250];
      AddInNameTmp@1000000010 : Text[250];
    BEGIN
      WITH Asmbl DO BEGIN
        MemStream := MemStream.MemoryStream();
        COPYSTREAM(MemStream,InStr);
        Asm := Asm.Load(MemStream.ToArray());

        IF Name = '' THEN BEGIN
          "Assembly Name" := Asm.FullName;
        END ELSE
          "Assembly Name" := Name;

        //SL Save Assembly Details
        AddInNameTmp := Asm.FullName;
        Seperator := ',';
        AddInNameVar := Token(AddInNameTmp,Seperator);
        HelperName := Token(AddInNameTmp,Seperator);
        Seperator := '=';
        AddInVersionVar := Token(HelperName,Seperator);
        AddInVersionVar := Token(HelperName,Seperator);

        Seperator := ',';
        HelperName := Token(AddInNameTmp,Seperator);
        HelperName := Token(AddInNameTmp,Seperator);
        Seperator := '=';
        AddInTokenVar := Token(HelperName,Seperator);
        AddInTokenVar := Token(HelperName,Seperator);

        IF InstallAddIn THEN BEGIN
          IF NOT AddInTable.GET(AddInNameVar,AddInTokenVar,AddInVersionVar) THEN BEGIN
            AddInTable.INIT;
            AddInTable."Add-in Name" := AddInNameVar;
            AddInTable."Public Key Token" := AddInTokenVar;
            AddInTable.Version := AddInVersionVar;
            AddInTable.INSERT;
          END;
        END;

        AddInName := AddInNameVar;
        AddInToken := AddInTokenVar;
        AddInVersion := AddInVersionVar;

        Assembly.CREATEOUTSTREAM(OutStr);
        MemStream.Seek(0,0);
        COPYSTREAM(OutStr,MemStream);

        IF INSERT() THEN
          MODIFY();
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Token@1000000002(VAR Text@1000000000 : Text[1024];Separator@1000000001 : Text[1]) Token : Text[1024];
    VAR
      Pos@1000000003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Pos := STRPOS(Text,Separator);
      IF Pos > 0 THEN BEGIN
      Token := COPYSTR(Text,1,Pos-1);
      IF Pos+1 <= STRLEN(Text) THEN
      Text := COPYSTR(Text,Pos+1)
      ELSE
      Text := '';
      END ELSE BEGIN
      Token := Text;
      Text := '';
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }

OBJECT Report 5447307 Webshop Create Cross-Links
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=28.07.17;
    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    CaptionML=[DEU=Webshop Crosslinkverkn�pfungen erstellen;
               ENU=Webshop Create Cross-Links];
    ProcessingOnly=Yes;
  }
  DATASET
  {
    { 1000000000;;DataItem;                  ;
               DataItemTable=Table5447304;
               DataItemTableView=SORTING(Shop Code,Language Code,Item No.)
                                 ORDER(Ascending)
                                 WHERE(Is Active=CONST(Yes));
               OnAfterGetRecord=BEGIN
                                  // Passende Artikel verkn�pfen (Zufall)
                                  IF NoOfFitItems > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                    WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                    WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
                                    WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Is Active",TRUE);
                                    WebshopItem.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',"Item No.");
                                    NoOfItem := WebshopItem.COUNT;
                                    FOR i := 1 TO NoOfFitItems DO BEGIN
                                      IF WebshopItem.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                                        IF WebshopItem.NEXT(RANDOM(NoOfItem)) > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                          IF NOT WebshopItemLink.GET(WebshopItemLink.Type::"Fit. Item","Shop Code","Item No.",WebshopItem."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
                                            WebshopItemLink.INIT;
                                            WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE(Type,WebshopItemLink.Type::"Fit. Item");
                                            WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                            WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Item No.","Item No.");
                                            WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Linked Item No.",WebshopItem."Item No.");
                                            WebshopItemLink.INSERT(TRUE);
                                            FitCounter += 1;
                                          END;
                                        END;
                                      END;
                                    END;
                                  END;

                                  // Alternative Artikel verkn�pfen (Zufall aus gleicher Kategorie)
                                  IF NoOfALtItems > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                    CategoryLineNo := 0;
                                    IF "Webshop Item"."Main Category Line No." <> 0 THEN
                                      IF WebshopItemCategory.GET("Shop Code","Language Code","Item No.","Shop Code","Language Code","Main Category Line No.") THEN
                                        CategoryLineNo := WebshopItemCategory."Category Line No.";
                                    IF CategoryLineNo = 0 THEN BEGIN
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Language Code","Language Code");
                                      IF WebshopItemCategory.FINDFIRST THEN
                                        CategoryLineNo := WebshopItemCategory."Category Line No.";
                                    END;
                                    IF CategoryLineNo <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',"Item No.");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Language Code","Language Code");
                                      WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",CategoryLineNo);
                                      NoOfItem := WebshopItemCategory.COUNT;
                                      FOR i := 1 TO NoOfALtItems DO BEGIN
                                        IF WebshopItemCategory.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                                          IF WebshopItemCategory.NEXT(RANDOM(NoOfItem)) > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                            IF NOT WebshopItemLink.GET(WebshopItemLink.Type::"Alt. Item","Shop Code","Item No.",WebshopItemCategory."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
                                              WebshopItemLink.INIT;
                                              WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE(Type,WebshopItemLink.Type::"Alt. Item");
                                              WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
                                              WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Item No.","Item No.");
                                              WebshopItemLink.VALIDATE("Linked Item No.",WebshopItemCategory."Item No.");
                                              WebshopItemLink.INSERT(TRUE);
                                              AltCounter +=1;
                                            END;
                                          END;
                                        END;
                                      END;
                                    END;
                                  END;
                                END;

               OnPostDataItem=BEGIN
                                MESSAGE(Text001,FitCounter,AltCounter);
                              END;

               ReqFilterFields=Shop Code,Language Code,Item No.,Is Active }

  }
  REQUESTPAGE

OBJECT Report 5447310 Webshop Data Import
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=26.02.18;
    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    ProcessingOnly=Yes;
    OnPreReport=VAR
                  X@1102153000 : Integer;
                BEGIN
                  ExcelBuf.LOCKTABLE;
                  ExcelBuf.OpenBook(ServerFileName,SheetName);
                  ExcelBuf.ReadSheet;
                  GetLastRowandColumn;

                  IF (AddNavItems) AND (NavItemNoSeries = '') THEN
                    IF HasLinesWithoutItemNo THEN
                      ERROR(Text008);

                  WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text009);
                  WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(SheetName,TotalRows-2);
                  WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(SheetName,TotalRows-2);

                  IF ImportType = ImportType::category THEN BEGIN
                    CategoryInitialised := FALSE;
                    FOR X := 3 TO TotalRows DO BEGIN
                      InsertCategoryData(X);
                      WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
                    END;
                  END;

                  IF ImportType = ImportType::item THEN BEGIN
                    FOR X := 3 TO TotalRows DO BEGIN
                      InsertItemData(X);
                      WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
                    END;
                  END;

                  WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorClose();

                  ExcelBuf.RESET;
                  ExcelBuf.SETRANGE("Import failed",TRUE);
                  IF ExcelBuf.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                    IF FaildImportRows = '' THEN
                      FaildImportRows := ''
                    ELSE
                      FaildImportRows := ', ' + FORMAT(ExcelBuf."Row No.");
                  UNTIL ExcelBuf.NEXT = 0;

                  IF FaildImportRows = '' THEN
                    MESSAGE(Text007)
                  ELSE
                    MESSAGE(Text011);

                  ExcelBuf.RESET;
                  //ExcelBuf.DELETEALL;
                END;

  }
  DATASET
  {
  }

                  LineValue += ExcelLines.Value;
