    PROCEDURE GetItemLink@1000000074(WebshopItem@1000000000 : Record 5447304) Link : Text[250];
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      Shop@1000000002 : Record 5447301;
      Language@1000000004 : Record 5447302;
      Customer@1000000003 : Record 18;
      CustomerNo@1000000005 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      // Link auf einen Webshopartikel erzeugen

      WITH WebshopItem DO BEGIN
        Shop.GET("Shop Code");
        Language.GET("Shop Code","Language Code");
        Shop.TESTFIELD("Webshop URL");
        IF (Shop."Shop Type" = Shop."Shop Type"::b2b) OR (Shop."Shop Type" = Shop."Shop Type"::salesperson) THEN BEGIN
          Shop.TESTFIELD("Default Customer No. Login");
          Customer.GET(Shop."Default Customer No. Login");
          Customer.TESTFIELD("Has Webshop Login");
          CustomerNo := Customer."No.";
        END;
        WebshopItem.TESTFIELD("Date Last Updated");
        WebshopItem.TESTFIELD("Is Active");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'company',COMPANYNAME);
        AddVar(CurrRec,'shop_code',"Shop Code");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'language_code',"Language Code");
        IF CustomerNo <> '' THEN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'customer_no',CustomerNo);
        AddVar(CurrRec,'item_no',"Item No.");
        Link := Shop."Webshop URL" + '/' + WebshopItem."Item Slug" + GetRequest('get_item_link',CurrRec);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertSalesLine@1000000041(SalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 36;VAR SalesLine@1000000009 : Record 37;Typ@1000000003 : 'Text,Item,G/L Account,Resource,Charge';No@1000000005 : Code[20];VariantCode@1000000007 : Code[10];Quantity@1000000006 : Decimal;UnitPrice@1000000008 : Decimal;Description@1000000002 : Text[50];IsCouponItem@1000000010 : Boolean;LineDiscount@1000000011 : Decimal;UnitOfMeasureCode@1000000012 : Code[10];ToShip@1000000013 : Boolean;ToInvoice@1000000014 : Boolean;CouponCode@1000000016 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      LastSalesLine@1000000000 : Record 37;
      NewLineNo@1000000004 : Integer;
      TransferExtendedText@1000000015 : Codeunit 378;
    BEGIN
      // Einf�gen einer Verkaufszeile

      LastSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      LastSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      IF LastSalesLine.FINDLAST THEN
        NewLineNo := LastSalesLine."Line No." + 10000
      ELSE
        NewLineNo := 10000;

      SalesLine.INIT;
      SalesLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line No.",NewLineNo);
      SalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);

      CASE Typ OF
        Typ::Text: BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::" ");
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",No);
          IF Description <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,Description);
          IF TransferExtendedText.SalesCheckIfAnyExtText(SalesLine,TRUE) THEN
            TransferExtendedText.InsertSalesExtText(SalesLine);
        END;
        Typ::Item: BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",No);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",UnitOfMeasureCode);
          IF Description <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,Description);
          IF VariantCode <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",VariantCode);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,Quantity);
          //MB 2015.10.30 - Kampagnenmodul - Immer Wert aus Web nehmen
          //MB 2018.01.18 - Abomodul - UnitPrice ziehen lassen wenn kein Abo oder UnitPrice gesetzt
          IF (NOT(SalesHeader."Webshop Subscription Code" <> '')) OR (UnitPrice <> 0) THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice);
          IF IsCouponItem=TRUE THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount %",100)
          ELSE IF LineDiscount > 0 THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount %",LineDiscount);
          IF ToInvoice THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice" := Quantity;
          IF ToShip THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Ship" := Quantity;
        END;
        Typ::"G/L Account": BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::"G/L Account");
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",No);
          IF Description <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,Description);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,Quantity);
          IF UnitPrice <> 0 THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice);
          IF ToInvoice THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice" := Quantity;
          IF ToShip THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Ship" := Quantity;
        END;
        Typ::Resource: BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Resource);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",No);
          IF Description <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,Description);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,Quantity);
          IF UnitPrice <> 0 THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice);
          IF ToInvoice THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice" := Quantity;
          IF ToShip THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Ship" := Quantity;
        END;
        Typ::Charge: BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::"Charge (Item)");
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",No);
          IF Description <> '' THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,Description);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,Quantity);
          IF UnitPrice <> 0 THEN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice);
          IF ToInvoice THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice" := Quantity;
          IF ToShip THEN
            SalesLine."Qty. to Ship" := Quantity;
        END;
      END;

      SalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalculateOnlineDiscount@1000000052(SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      Shop@1000000002 : Record 5447301;
      ShopLanguage@1000000006 : Record 5447302;
      SalesLine@1000000001 : Record 37;
      StandardText@1000000003 : Record 7;
      OnlineDiscountAmount@1000000004 : Decimal;
      OrderAmount@1000000005 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // Online-Rabatt berechnen
      {
      OnlineDiscountAmount := 0;
      OrderAmount := 0;
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      IF Shop.GET(SalesHeader."Webshop Shop Code") THEN BEGIN
        IF ShopLanguage.GET(SalesHeader."Webshop Shop Code",SalesHeader."Webshop Language Code") THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
          IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            IF SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice" <> 0 THEN
              OrderAmount += SalesLine."Line Amount" / SalesLine.Quantity * SalesLine."Qty. to Invoice";
          UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
          SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::"G/L Account");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",Shop."Online Discount");
          SalesLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>0');
          StandardText.GET(ShopLanguage."Online Discount Text");
          OnlineDiscountAmount := -ROUND(OrderAmount/100*Shop."Weborder Typ");
          IF SalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Description,STRSUBSTNO(StandardText.Description,Shop."Weborder Typ"));
            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);
            SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",OnlineDiscountAmount);
            SalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            IF Shop."Weborder Typ" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              InsertSalesLine(SalesHeader,SalesLine,2,Shop."Online Discount",1,OnlineDiscountAmount,
                              STRSUBSTNO(StandardText.Description,Shop."Weborder Typ"));
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      }
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetWebshopItemModified@1000000061(ItemNo@1000000000 : Code[20];UpdateAllWebshopItem@1000000006 : Boolean;UpdateParentItem@1000000004 : Boolean;UpdateVariants@1000000005 : Boolean);
    VAR
      WebshopItem@1000000001 : Record 5447304;
      WebshopItemLink@1000000002 : Record 5447308;
      WebshopItem2@1000000003 : Record 5447304;
      WebshopItem3@1000000007 : Record 5447304;
    BEGIN
      // �nderungsdatum f�r Artikelaktualisierung setzten

      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);

      IF NOT UpdateAllWebshopItem THEN BEGIN
        IF WebshopItem.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code",WebshopItem."Shop Code");
          WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Language Code",WebshopItem."Language Code");
        END;
      END;

      IF WebshopItem.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
        WebshopItem3.GET(WebshopItem."Shop Code",WebshopItem."Language Code",WebshopItem."Item No.");
        WebshopItem3."Date Last Modified" := CURRENTDATETIME();
        WebshopItem3."User Last Modification" := USERID;
        WebshopItem3.MODIFY(FALSE);

        // Zugeh�rige Varianten Aktualisieren
        IF UpdateVariants THEN BEGIN
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Item No.",WebshopItem."Item No.");
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code",WebshopItem."Shop Code");
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE(Type,WebshopItemLink.Type::Variant);
          IF WebshopItemLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            WebshopItem2.SETRANGE("Shop Code",WebshopItemLink."Shop Code");
            WebshopItem2.SETRANGE("Item No.",WebshopItemLink."Linked Item No.");
            IF WebshopItem2.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              WebshopItem2."Date Last Modified" := CURRENTDATETIME();
              WebshopItem2."User Last Modification" := USERID;
              WebshopItem2.MODIFY;
            UNTIL WebshopItem2.NEXT = 0;
          UNTIL WebshopItemLink.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        // Zugeh�rigen Mutterartikel aktualisieren
        IF UpdateParentItem THEN BEGIN
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Item No.");
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE(Type,WebshopItemLink.Type::Variant);
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code",WebshopItem."Shop Code");
          WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Linked Item No.",WebshopItem."Item No.");
          IF WebshopItemLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            WebshopItem2.SETRANGE("Shop Code",WebshopItemLink."Shop Code");
            WebshopItem2.SETRANGE("Item No.",WebshopItemLink."Item No.");
            IF WebshopItem2.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              WebshopItem2."Date Last Modified" := CURRENTDATETIME();
              WebshopItem2."User Last Modification" := USERID;
              WebshopItem2.MODIFY;
            UNTIL WebshopItem2.NEXT = 0;
          UNTIL WebshopItemLink.NEXT = 0;
        END;

      UNTIL WebshopItem.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetNextWorkday@1000000021(Date@1000000001 : Date;Direction@1000000000 : '>,<') NewDate : Date;
    VAR
      DateFormulaString@1000000002 : Text[10];
      CompanyInfo@1000000003 : Record 79;
      CalendarManagement@1000000004 : Codeunit 7600;
      NonWorkday@1000000005 : Boolean;
      DateDscr@1000000006 : Text[30];
      DateFormula@1000000007 : DateFormula;
    BEGIN
      //Gibt n�chsten oder letzen Werktag von Referenzdatum aus zur�ck
      NewDate := Date;

      IF Direction = Direction::">" THEN
        DateFormulaString := '<+1D>'
      ELSE
        DateFormulaString := '<-1D>';

      EVALUATE(DateFormula,DateFormulaString);

      CompanyInfo.GET;
      NonWorkday := CalendarManagement.CheckDateStatus(CompanyInfo."Base Calendar Code",NewDate,DateDscr);
      WHILE NonWorkday DO BEGIN
        NewDate := CALCDATE(DateFormula,NewDate);
        NonWorkday := CalendarManagement.CheckDateStatus(CompanyInfo."Base Calendar Code",NewDate,DateDscr);
      END;
      EXIT(NewDate);
    END;

    PROCEDURE StateIndicatorOpen@1000000014(Title@1000 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      MaxTextLength@1001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(MainTableCount);
        NoOfMainTable := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord2 := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord3 := 0;
        NoOfRecords := 0;
        RecordNo := 0;
        NewProgress := 0;
        OldProgress := 0;
        NewProgress2 := 0;
        OldProgress2 := 0;
        NextRecordNo := 0;
        Title := DELCHR(Title,'>',' .');
        Title := DELCHR(Title,'<',' ');
        IF Title = '' THEN
          Title := Text55000;
        MaxTextLength := STRLEN(Text55001);
        IF STRLEN(Text55002) > MaxTextLength THEN
          MaxTextLength := STRLEN(Text55002);
        IF STRLEN(Text55003) > MaxTextLength THEN
          MaxTextLength := STRLEN(Text55003);
        IF STRLEN(Text55004) > MaxTextLength THEN
          MaxTextLength := STRLEN(Text55004);
        Window.OPEN(
          Title +'...\\' +
          PADSTR(Text55001,MaxTextLength,' ') + '  @1@@@@@@@@@@@@@\' +
          PADSTR(Text55002,MaxTextLength,' ') + '  #2#######################\' +
          PADSTR(Text55003,MaxTextLength,' ') + '  #3######\' +
          PADSTR(Text55004,MaxTextLength,' ') + '  @4@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE StateIndicatorNewTable@75(TableCaption@1000 : Text[250];RecordCount@1001 : Integer);
    VAR
      i@1002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        IF MainRecord THEN BEGIN
          NoOfMainRecord2 := NoOfMainRecord2 + NoOfMainRecord3;
          MainRecord := FALSE;
        END;
        Window.UPDATE(2,TableCaption);
        Window.UPDATE(3,RecordCount);
        Window.UPDATE(4,0);
        OldProgress := 0;
        RecordNo := 0;
        NoOfRecords := RecordCount;
        NextRecordNo := 0;
        IF (NoOfMainRecord <> 0) AND (RecordCount <> 0) THEN
          FOR i := 1 TO NoOfMainTable DO
            IF MainTableCaption[i] = TableCaption THEN BEGIN
              MainRecord := TRUE;
              NoOfMainRecord3 := MainTableCount[i];
              MainTableCaption[i] := '';
              EXIT;
            END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE StateIndicatorUpdate@76();
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        IF RecordNo >= NoOfRecords THEN
          EXIT;
        RecordNo := RecordNo + 1;
        IF RecordNo < NextRecordNo THEN
          EXIT;
        NextRecordNo := NextRecordNo + ROUND(NoOfRecords / 100,1);
        NewProgress := ROUND(RecordNo / NoOfRecords * 100,1);
        IF NewProgress <> OldProgress THEN BEGIN
          OldProgress := NewProgress;
          Window.UPDATE(4,NewProgress * 100);
          IF MainRecord THEN BEGIN
            NewProgress2 := ROUND((NoOfMainRecord2 + RecordNo) / NoOfMainRecord * 100,1);
            IF (NewProgress2 > OldProgress2) AND (NewProgress2 <= 100) THEN BEGIN
              OldProgress2 := NewProgress2;
              Window.UPDATE(1,NewProgress2 * 100);
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE StateIndicatorRegisterTable@77(TableCaption@1000 : Text[250];RecordCount@1001 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        NoOfMainTable := NoOfMainTable + 1;
        MainTableCaption[NoOfMainTable] := TableCaption;
        MainTableCount[NoOfMainTable] := RecordCount;
        NoOfMainRecord := NoOfMainRecord + RecordCount;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE StateIndicatorClose@1();
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        Window.CLOSE;
        CLEAR(MainTableCount);
        NoOfMainTable := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord2 := 0;
        NoOfMainRecord3 := 0;
        NoOfRecords := 0;
        RecordNo := 0;
        NewProgress := 0;
        OldProgress := 0;
        NewProgress2 := 0;
        OldProgress2 := 0;
        NextRecordNo := 0;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE Explode@1000000042(VAR TextRecord@1000000000 : Text;Delimiter@1000000003 : Text[30]) TextField : Text;
    VAR
      Pos@1000000001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Pos := STRPOS(TextRecord,Delimiter);
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        TextField := (COPYSTR(TextRecord,1,Pos-1));
        TextRecord := (COPYSTR(TextRecord,Pos+STRLEN(Delimiter)));
      END ELSE BEGIN
        TextField := TextRecord;
        TextRecord := '';
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ExplodeByLenght@1000000024(VAR TextRecord@1000000000 : Text;Pos@1000000003 : Integer) TextField : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF Pos < STRLEN(TextRecord) THEN BEGIN
        TextField := (COPYSTR(TextRecord,1,Pos-1));
        TextRecord := (COPYSTR(TextRecord,Pos));
      END ELSE BEGIN
        TextField := TextRecord;
        TextRecord := '';
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE URLEncode@1000000003(ASCIIText@1000000000 : Text) HTTPText : Text;
    VAR
      Char@1000000001 : Char;
      CharInt@1000000002 : Integer;
      i@1000000003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(HTTPText);
      //ASCIIText := ConvertText(ASCIIText,TRUE);
      FOR i := 1 TO STRLEN(ASCIIText) DO BEGIN
        Char := ASCIIText[i];
        CharInt := Char;
        HTTPText := HTTPText + URLEncodeCharset(CharInt);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ConvertText@12(Text@1001 : Text;DosToWindows@1004 : Boolean) ConvertedText : Text;
    VAR
      Ascii@1003 : Text[191];
      Ansi@1000 : Text[191];
    BEGIN
      InitCharAscii(Ascii);
      InitCharAnsi(Ansi);

      IF DosToWindows THEN
        ConvertedText := CONVERTSTR(Text,Ascii,Ansi)
      ELSE
        ConvertedText := CONVERTSTR(Text,Ansi,Ascii);
    END;

    PROCEDURE Base64EncodeStream@1112400001(VAR inStr@1112400000 : InStream;VAR outStr@1112400001 : OutStream);
    VAR
      b@1112400002 : Binary[3];
      nRead@1112400003 : Integer;
      c@1112400004 : ARRAY [4] OF Char;
      nWritten@1112400005 : Integer;
      txt64Chars@1112400006 : Text[64];
    BEGIN
      {
      txt64Chars := 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
      txt64Chars += 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
      txt64Chars += '0123456789+/';

      WHILE NOT inStr.EOS DO BEGIN
        // read up to 3 bytes...
        nRead := inStr.READ(b);

        // zero out bytes not read...
        IF nRead < 3 THEN
          b[3] := 0;
        IF nRead < 2 THEN
          b[2] := 0;

        // c[1] is high 6 bits of b[1]...
        c[1] := b[1] DIV 4;

        // c[2] is low 2 bits of b[1] and high 4 bits of b[2]...
        c[2] := ((b[1] MOD 4) * 16) + (b[2] DIV 16);

        // c[3] is low 4 bits of b[2] and high 2 bits of b[3]...
        c[3] := ((b[2] MOD 16) * 4) + (b[3] DIV 64);

        // c[4] is low 6 bits of b[3]...
        c[4] := b[3] MOD 64;

        // convert c[1..4] to the Base64Encoded char...
        //c[1] := txt64Chars[c[1] + 1];
        //c[2] := txt64Chars[c[2] + 1];
        //IF nRead > 1 THEN
        //  c[3] := txt64Chars[c[3] + 1]
        //ELSE
        //  c[3] := '=';
        //IF nRead > 2 THEN
        //  c[4] := txt64Chars[c[4] + 1]
        //ELSE
        //  c[4] := '=';

        // write 'em out...
        outStr.WRITE(c[1]);
        outStr.WRITE(c[2]);
        outStr.WRITE(c[3]);
        outStr.WRITE(c[4]);
        nWritten += 1;

        // write a cr/lf every 72 chars...
        IF nWritten = 18 THEN BEGIN
          c[1] := 13;
          outStr.WRITE(c[1]);
          c[1] := 10;
          outStr.WRITE(c[1]);
          nWritten := 0;
        END;
      END;

      // write the trailing cr/lf...
      IF nWritten <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        c[1] := 13;
        outStr.WRITE(c[1]);
        c[1] := 10;
        outStr.WRITE(c[1]);
      END;
      }
    END;

    PROCEDURE Base64DecodeStream@1112400002(VAR inStr@1112400001 : InStream;VAR outStr@1112400000 : OutStream);
    VAR
      b@1112400002 : Binary[3];
      c@1112400003 : ARRAY [4] OF Char;
      idxChar@1112400004 : Integer;
      inPos@1112400005 : Integer;
      nEqualSigns@1112400006 : Integer;
      txt64Chars@1112400007 : Text[64];
      Text000@1112400008 : TextConst 'DEU=Ung�ltiges Zeichen "%1" an Position %2 festgestellt.;ENU=Invalid character ''''%1'''' encountered at position %2.';
      Text001@1112400009 : TextConst 'DEU=Unerwarteten End-Of-Stream an Position %1 festgestellt.;ENU=Unexpected end-of-stream encountered at position %1.';
    BEGIN
      {
      txt64Chars := 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
      txt64Chars += 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
      txt64Chars += '0123456789+/';

      inPos := 0;
      WHILE NOT inStr.EOS DO BEGIN
        // read 1st char (ignore leading white space)...
        inStr.READ(c[1],1);
        inPos += 1;
        WHILE (c[1] IN [9, 10, 13, 32]) AND (NOT inStr.EOS) DO BEGIN
          inStr.READ(c[1],1);
          inPos += 1;
        END;

        IF NOT inStr.EOS THEN BEGIN
          // check 1st char...
          idxChar := STRPOS(txt64Chars, FORMAT(c[1]));
          IF idxChar = 0 THEN
            ERROR(Text000, FORMAT(c[1]), inPos);
          c[1] := idxChar - 1;

          // get/check 2nd char...
          inStr.READ(c[2],1);
          inPos += 1;
          idxChar := STRPOS(txt64Chars, FORMAT(c[2]));
          IF idxChar = 0 THEN
            ERROR(Text000, FORMAT(c[2]), inPos);
          c[2] := idxChar - 1;

          // get/check 3rd char...
          IF inStr.EOS THEN
            ERROR(Text001, inPos);
          inStr.READ(c[3],1);
          inPos += 1;
          nEqualSigns := 0;
          IF c[3] = '=' THEN BEGIN
            c[3] := 0;
            nEqualSigns += 1;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            idxChar := STRPOS(txt64Chars, FORMAT(c[3]));
            IF idxChar = 0 THEN
              ERROR(Text000, FORMAT(c[3]), inPos);
            c[3] := idxChar - 1;
          END;

          // get/check 4th char...
          IF inStr.EOS THEN
            ERROR(Text001, inPos);
          inStr.READ(c[4],1);
          inPos += 1;
          IF (nEqualSigns > 0) AND (c[4] <> '=') THEN
            ERROR(Text000, FORMAT(c[4]), inPos);
          IF c[4] = '=' THEN BEGIN
            c[4] := 0;
            nEqualSigns += 1;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            idxChar := STRPOS(txt64Chars, FORMAT(c[4]));
            IF idxChar = 0 THEN
              ERROR(Text000, FORMAT(c[4]), inPos);
            c[4] := idxChar - 1;
          END;

          // b[1] is c[1] and bits(5,6) of c[2]...
          b[1] := (c[1] * 4) + (c[2] DIV 16);
          outStr.WRITE(b[1]);

          // b[2] is low 4 bits of c[2] and bits(3..6) of c[3]...
          IF nEqualSigns < 2 THEN BEGIN
            b[2] := ((c[2] MOD 16) * 16) + (c[3] DIV 4);
            outStr.WRITE(b[2]);
          END;

          // b[3] is low 2 bits of c[3] and the 6 bits in c[4]...
          IF nEqualSigns = 0 THEN BEGIN
            b[3] := ((c[3] MOD 4) * 64) + c[4];
            outStr.WRITE(b[3]);
          END;
        END;
      END;
      }
    END;

    PROCEDURE EncodeFF@1108800000(Text@1108800000 : Text[1024]) : Text[1024];
    VAR
      I@1108800001 : Integer;
      J@1108800003 : Integer;
      NewText@1108800002 : Text[1024];
    BEGIN
      FOR I := 1 TO STRLEN(Text) DO
        IF I MOD 2 <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          J += 1;
          NewText[J] := 255 - Text[I];
        END;
      FOR I := STRLEN(Text) DOWNTO 2 DO
        IF I MOD 2 = 0 THEN BEGIN
          J += 1;
          NewText[J] := 255 - Text[I];
        END;
      EXIT(NewText);
    END;

    PROCEDURE FilterChars@1000000022(Text@1000000000 : Text[250]) ReturnText : Text[250];
    BEGIN

    END;

    PROCEDURE GenerateItemSlug@5447300(String@5447300 : Text[250]) ItemSlug : Text[250];
    VAR
      txtCharsToKeep@5447301 : Text;
    BEGIN
      ItemSlug := LOWERCASE(String);
      ItemSlug := URLEncodeReadable(ItemSlug);
      txtCharsToKeep := 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890+-';
      ItemSlug := DELCHR(ItemSlug,'=',DELCHR(ItemSlug,'=',txtCharsToKeep));
      ItemSlug := COPYSTR(ItemSlug,1,250);
    END;

    PROCEDURE WebshopRandomize@1000000012() Seed : Integer;
    VAR
      bigseed@1000000000 : BigInteger;
    BEGIN
      //generiert auf Basis von GUID-Werten einen Seed zwischen 1 und 2.147.483.646.
      //bigseed ist vom Typ BigInteger
      EVALUATE(bigseed, COPYSTR(DELCHR(CREATEGUID(),'=','{}-ABCDEF'),1,10));
      Seed:= (bigseed MOD 2147483646) +1;
    END;

    PROCEDURE WebshopRandom@1000000016(Seed@1000000000 : Integer;Number@1000000001 : Integer) Rand : Integer;
    VAR
      a@1000000002 : Integer;
      m@1000000003 : Integer;
      q@1000000004 : Integer;
      r@1000000005 : Integer;
      hi@1000000006 : Integer;
      lo@1000000007 : Integer;
      test@1000000008 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      //......................................................................................................
      //Code: Minimal Standard Pseudozufallszahlengenerator (linearer Kongruenzgenerator)
      //Quelle: Steve K. Park and Keith W. Miller "Random Number Generators: Good ones are hard to find", 1988
      //Sprache: Navision C/AL (modifiziert von winfy)
      //Limit: nur f�r 32 Bit signed Integer geeignet, erzeugt Pseudozufallszahlen von 1 bis Parameter "Number"
      //......................................................................................................

      //Definitionen
      //a,m,q,r sind Variablen/Konstanten vom Typ Integer
      //test, hi, lo sind Variablen vom Typ Integer
      //Seed als �bergabeparameter vom Typ Integer

      //Initialisierung der Werte
      a := 16807; //alternativ a:= 48271;
      m := 2147483647;
      q := 127773; //alternativ q:= 44488;
      r := 2836; //alternativ r:= 3399

      //alternative "gute" Werte (L'Ecuyer)
      //a := 39373;
      //m := 2147483647;
      //q := 54542;
      //r := 1481;

      //Pseudozufallszahl berechnen
      hi := Seed DIV q;
      lo := Seed MOD q;
      test := a * lo - r * hi;

      //positiven Wertebereich sicherstellen
      IF test > 0 THEN Seed := test
        ELSE Seed := test + m;

      //Ergebnis im Bereich 1 bis Number erzeugen
      IF (Number > 0) THEN EXIT((Seed MOD Number) + 1)
        ELSE EXIT(1); //alternativ EXIT(0) oder Fehlermeldung
    END;

    PROCEDURE UploadAttachmentTest@1000000023();
    VAR
      InputFile@1000000000 : File;
      ConvertedFile@1000000001 : File;
      InputFileInStr@1000000002 : InStream;
      ConvertedFileOutStr@1000000004 : OutStream;
      ConvertedFileInStr@1000000003 : InStream;
      Data@1000000005 : Text[1024];
      i@1000000006 : Integer;
      TempData@1000000007 : Text[600];
      FileRecord@1000000009 : Text[1024];
      XMLHeader@1000000012 : Text[1024];
      TempFilePath@1000000011 : Text[200];
      LongText@1000000013 : Text;
      Int@1000000014 : Integer;
      Convert@1000000015 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Convert";
      ClientFile@1000000016 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.IO.File";
      Filename@1000000008 : Text[200];
      ServerFileName@1000000010 : Text[200];
    BEGIN
      // Datei in tempor�res Webverzeichnis laden
      {
      InputFile.OPEN(Filename);
      InputFile.CREATEINSTREAM(InputFileInStr);
      ConvertedFile.CREATETEMPFILE;
      ConvertedFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(ConvertedFileOutStr);
      Base64EncodeStream(InputFileInStr,ConvertedFileOutStr);
      ConvertedFile.CREATEINSTREAM(ConvertedFileInStr);

      CLEAR(FileRecord);
      AddVar(FileRecord,'filename',ServerFileName);
      AddVar(FileRecord,'action','create');
      SendRequest('upload_attachment',FileRecord);

      WHILE NOT (ConvertedFileInStr.EOS) DO BEGIN
        CLEAR(FileRecord);
        CLEAR(Data);
        FOR i := 1 TO 8 DO BEGIN
          ConvertedFileInStr.READTEXT(TempData);
          Data += TempData;
        END;
        AddVar(FileRecord,'filename',ServerFileName);
        AddVar(FileRecord,'action','write');
        AddVar(FileRecord,'filedata',Data);
        SendRequest('upload_attachment',FileRecord);
      END;

      CLEAR(FileRecord);
      AddVar(FileRecord,'filename',ServerFileName);
      AddVar(FileRecord,'action','convert');
      SendRequest('upload_attachment',FileRecord);
      }

      // Neue Funktion von TH implementiert: FK 19.06.2012
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      //InputFile.OPEN(Filename);
      //InputFile.CREATEINSTREAM(InputFileInStr);

      TempFilePath := 'C:\tmp\attachment_test.xml';
      Filename := 'C:\tmp\testimage.jpg';
      ServerFileName := 'testimage_uploaded.jpg';
      ConvertedFile.CREATE(TempFilePath);

      ConvertedFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(ConvertedFileOutStr);

      ConvertedFileOutStr.WRITETEXT('<?xml version="1.0" ?><file><pass>'+WebshopSetup."Server Synch. Password"+'</pass>');
      ConvertedFileOutStr.WRITETEXT('<action>write</action>');
      ConvertedFileOutStr.WRITETEXT('<filename>'+ServerFileName+'</filename>' + '<filedata>');

      //Base64EncodeStream(InputFileInStr,ConvertedFileOutStr);
      LongText := Convert.ToBase64String(ClientFile.ReadAllBytes(Filename));
      ConvertedFileOutStr.WRITETEXT(LongText);
      ConvertedFileOutStr.WRITETEXT('</filedata></file>');

      ConvertedFile.CREATEINSTREAM(ConvertedFileInStr);
      ConvertedFile.CLOSE;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ExportAllTablesWithFields@1000000026(StartNoVersionRange@1000000001 : Integer;EndNoVersionRange@1000000004 : Integer;VersionString@1000000008 : Text;Filepath@1000000005 : Text);
    VAR
      Field@1000000003 : Record 2000000041;
      TableMetadata@1000000002 : Record 2000000136;
      Object@1000000000 : Record 2000000001;
      Error001@1000000006 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Datei im Pfad [%1] existiert bereits. Bitte geben Sie einen Pfad an, an dem eine neue Datei erzeugt werden kann.;ENU=The file at [%1] already exists. Please specify a path at which a new file can be created.';
      Error002@1000000007 : TextConst 'DEU=Konnte keine Datei am Pfad [%1] erzeugen. Ist der Pfad von der ausf�hrenden Maschine erreichbar und beschreibbar?;ENU=Could not create a file at path [%1]. Is the path reachable and writable from the executing machine?';
      File@1000000012 : File;
      SystemIOFile@1000000009 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.IO.File";
      StreamWriter@1000000010 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.IO.StreamWriter";
      Encoding@1000000011 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Text.Encoding";
      OutStream@1000000013 : OutStream;
      TableIncluded@1000000014 : Boolean;
      PageMetadata@1000000018 : Record 2000000138;
      i@1000000015 : Integer;
      j@1000000016 : Integer;
      SuccessMsg@1000000017 : TextConst 'DEU=Es wurden %1 Felder in %2 Tabellen exportiert.;ENU=%1 fields in %2 tables were exported.';
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS(Filepath) THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(Error001,Filepath));

      IF NOT File.CREATE(Filepath,TEXTENCODING::UTF8) THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(Error002,Filepath));

      File.CREATEOUTSTREAM(OutStream);
      StreamWriter := StreamWriter.StreamWriter(OutStream,Encoding.Unicode);
      Object.SETRANGE(Type,Object.Type::Table);
      Object.SETFILTER("Version List",'%1','@*'+VersionString+'*');
      IF Object.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
        i += 1;
        TableIncluded := FALSE;
        Field.RESET;
        Field.SETRANGE(TableNo,Object.ID);

        IF (Object.ID < StartNoVersionRange) OR (Object.ID > EndNoVersionRange) THEN
          Field.SETFILTER("No.",'%1..%2',StartNoVersionRange,(EndNoVersionRange - 1));

        IF Field.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          j += 1;
          TableIncluded := TRUE;
          StreamWriter.WriteLine(
            'Table ' + FORMAT(Field.TableNo) +
            ' Field ' + FORMAT(Field."No.") + ' - ' +
            Field.FieldName +
            ' TableRel: ' + FORMAT(Field.RelationTableNo) +
            '| FieldRel: ' + FORMAT(Field.RelationFieldNo));
        UNTIL Field.NEXT = 0;
        IF TableIncluded THEN
          StreamWriter.WriteLine('');
      UNTIL Object.NEXT = 0;
      StreamWriter.Close;
      File.CLOSE;
      MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(SuccessMsg,j,i));
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetCouponValidByCategory@1000000028(CouponLine@1000000000 : Record 5447472;SalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 36;VAR CouponIsValid@1000000005 : Boolean);
    VAR
      CategoryItemFound@1000000007 : Boolean;
      CategoryLineNoSet@1000000006 : Boolean;
      MatchFound@1000000008 : Boolean;
      WebshopItemCategory@1000000004 : Record 5447305;
      WebshopCategory@1000000003 : Record 5447303;
      WebshopCouponLine@1000000002 : Record 5447329;
      SalesLine@1000000009 : Record 37;
      AvailableAmount@1000000010 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      AvailableAmount := 0;
      CategoryLineNoSet := FALSE;
      CLEAR(SalesLine);
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        CategoryItemFound := FALSE;

        WebshopCouponLine.SETRANGE(Code,CouponLine.Code);
        WebshopCouponLine.SETRANGE("Coupon Code",CouponLine."Coupon Code");
        IF WebshopCouponLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          IF WebshopCouponLine."Category Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            CategoryLineNoSet := TRUE;
            CLEAR(WebshopItemCategory);
            WebshopItemCategory.RESET;
            CLEAR(WebshopCategory);
            WebshopCategory.RESET;

            WebshopItemCategory.SetItemCategoriesWithAncestors(WebshopCouponLine."Shop Code",WebshopCouponLine."Language Code",SalesLine."No.",WebshopCategory);
            IF WebshopCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              IF WebshopCategory."Line No." = WebshopCouponLine."Category Line No." THEN BEGIN
                CategoryItemFound := TRUE;
                AvailableAmount += SalesLine."Line Amount";
              END;
            UNTIL (CategoryItemFound) OR (WebshopCategory.NEXT = 0);
            IF NOT CategoryItemFound THEN
              CategoryLineNoSet := FALSE;
          END;
        UNTIL (CategoryItemFound) OR (WebshopCouponLine.NEXT = 0);
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF (AvailableAmount > 0) AND (CategoryLineNoSet) THEN BEGIN
        CouponIsValid := TRUE;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF (CategoryLineNoSet) THEN
          CouponIsValid := FALSE;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetNewCouponValueByCategory@1000000027(CouponLine@1000000000 : Record 5447472;SalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 36;SalesLine@1000000002 : Record 37;VAR CouponValue@1000000005 : Decimal);
    VAR
      AvailableAmount@1000000006 : Decimal;
      CategoryItemFound@1000000009 : Boolean;
      CategoryLineNoSet@1000000004 : Boolean;
      WebshopItemCategory@1000000008 : Record 5447305;
      WebshopCategory@1000000007 : Record 5447303;
      WebshopCouponLine@1000000003 : Record 5447329;
    BEGIN
      AvailableAmount := 0;
      CategoryLineNoSet := FALSE;
      CLEAR(SalesLine);
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        CategoryItemFound := FALSE;

        WebshopCouponLine.SETRANGE(Code,CouponLine.Code);
        WebshopCouponLine.SETRANGE("Coupon Code",CouponLine."Coupon Code");
        IF WebshopCouponLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          IF WebshopCouponLine."Category Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            CategoryLineNoSet := TRUE;
            CLEAR(WebshopItemCategory);
            WebshopItemCategory.RESET;
            CLEAR(WebshopCategory);
            WebshopCategory.RESET;

            WebshopItemCategory.SetItemCategoriesWithAncestors(WebshopCouponLine."Shop Code",WebshopCouponLine."Language Code",SalesLine."No.",WebshopCategory);
            IF WebshopCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              IF WebshopCategory."Line No." = WebshopCouponLine."Category Line No." THEN BEGIN
                CategoryItemFound := TRUE;
                AvailableAmount += SalesLine."Line Amount";
              END;
            UNTIL (CategoryItemFound) OR (WebshopCategory.NEXT = 0);
            IF NOT CategoryItemFound THEN
              CategoryLineNoSet := FALSE;
          END;
        UNTIL (CategoryItemFound) OR (WebshopCouponLine.NEXT = 0);


      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF (AvailableAmount > 0) AND (CategoryLineNoSet) THEN BEGIN
        CouponValue := AvailableAmount / 100 * CouponLine.Percentage;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF (CategoryLineNoSet) THEN
          CouponValue := 0;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- MysydeShop - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllWebshopSetup@1000000063(CountRecords@1000000000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeUpdateAllWebshopSetup(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopSetup DO BEGIN
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT);
            UpdateWebshopSetup;
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllWebshopSetup(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateWebshopSetup@1000000039();
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000000 : Text[1024];
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
      ShippingOptionsSetup@1000000002 : Record 5447450;
    BEGIN
      // Webshop-Setup �bertragen

      WebshopSetup.GET;
      GeneralLedgerSetup.GET;
      ShippingOptionsSetup.GET;

      OnBeforeUpdateWebshopSetup(IsHandled,WebshopSetup,GeneralLedgerSetup,ShippingOptionsSetup);

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_setup');
        AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[nas_email_text_module]',WebshopSetup."NAS Error E-Mail Text");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[nas_email_recipient]',WebshopSetup."NAS Error E-Mail Recipient");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[nas_email_recipient_2]',WebshopSetup."NAS Error E-Mail Recipient 2");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[nas_email_sender]',WebshopSetup."NAS Error E-Mail Sender Addr.");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[default_currency_code]',GeneralLedgerSetup."LCY Code");
        ShippingOptionsSetup.CALCFIELDS("Default Priority");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'data[default_shipping_class_priority]',ShippingOptionsSetup."Default Priority");
        WebshopManagement.AddDTVar(CurrRec,'data[last_datetime_nav_updated]',WebshopSetup."Time Last Full Update");

        IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
          WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('update',CurrRec,FALSE,gSendNow)
        ELSE
          WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateWebshopSetup(IsHandled,WebshopSetup,GeneralLedgerSetup,ShippingOptionsSetup);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllShop@1000000049(CountRecords@1000000000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      Shop@1000000003 : Record 5447301;
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeUpdateAllShop(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      // Alle Webshops �bertragen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH Shop DO BEGIN
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT);
            DeleteAllShop(FALSE);
            IF FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateShop(Shop);
              WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
            UNTIL NEXT = 0;
            DeleteAllShop(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllShop(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

              WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);
              FirstLine := FALSE;
            UNTIL EbayAuthToken = '';
          END;

          CLEAR(CurrRec);

          // Zugeh�rige Merkmale aktualisieren (Sprach�bergreifend)
          AttributeLink.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeLink.Type::Shop);
          AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code",Code);
          IF AttributeLink.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
            UpdateAttributeLink(AttributeLink);
          UNTIL AttributeLink.NEXT = 0;

          CouponGroups.SETFILTER(Code,"Coupon Group Filter");
          IF CouponGroups.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            UpdateShopCouponGroup(CouponGroups,Shop);
          UNTIL CouponGroups.NEXT = 0;

           //Google Merchant Funktions aufruf
          IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            IF (WebshopSetup."Update Google Merchant Center") AND ("Google FTP URL" <> '') THEN
              UpdateGoogleMerchant(Code);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateShop(IsHandled,ParameterShop);
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteAllShop@1000000042(ConfirmDelete@1000000001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000000 : Text[1024];

    BEGIN

        AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_shop');

      END;

      OnAfterDeleteAllShop(ConfirmDelete,IsHandled);
    END;

          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[address_doctor_password]',"Address Validation Password");
          IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
            WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('update',CurrRec,FALSE,gSendNow)
          ELSE
            WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);

          // Zugeh�rige W�hrungen �bertragen
          IF "Currency Filter" <> '' THEN BEGIN
            Currency.SETFILTER(Code,"Currency Filter");

              UpdateCurrency("Shop Code",Code,Currency);
            UNTIL Currency.NEXT = 0;
            DeleteCurrency("Shop Code",Code,TRUE);
          END;

        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateLanguage(IsHandled,ParameterWebshopLanguage);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckItemPlaceholderImage@1000000071(WebshopLanguage@1000000000 : Record 5447302) Ok : Boolean;
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      GetRec@1000000004 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;
      IsHandled@1000000002 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCheckItemPlaceholderImage(IsHandled,WebshopLanguage);

      // Platzhalter Artikelbild pr�fen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopLanguage DO BEGIN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_language');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'field','item_placeholder_image');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[code]',Code);
          GetRec := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('check_field_content',CurrRec);
          IF GetRec = '' THEN
            Ok := FALSE
          ELSE IF GetRec = '100' THEN
            Ok := TRUE
          ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN
                LogFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
                LogFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
                IF NOT FILE.EXISTS(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN BEGIN
                 IF NOT LogFile.CREATE(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error001);
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                    ERROR(Error002);
                END;
                LogFile.SEEK(LogFile.LEN);
                LogFile.WRITE(GetRec);
                LogFile.CLOSE;
                IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
                  MESSAGE(GetRec);
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;
          IF "Item Placeholder Image" <> Ok THEN BEGIN
            "Item Placeholder Image" := Ok;
            MODIFY;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterCheckItemPlaceholderImage(IsHandled,WebshopLanguage);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllCountry@1000000003(CountRecords@1000000000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      WebshopCountry@1000000003 : Record 5447310;
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeUpdateAllCountry(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      // Alle L�ndereinstellungen �bertragen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopCountry DO BEGIN
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT);

            DeleteAllCustomerTemplate(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllCountry(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckPaymentOption@1000000210(WebshopPaymentOption@1000000000 : Record 5447312) OK : Boolean;
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      GetRec@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;
      IsHandled@1000000003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCheckPaymentOption(IsHandled,WebshopPaymentOption);

      // PaymentOption Content auf Inhalt �berpr�fen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopPaymentOption DO BEGIN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_payment_option');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'field','content');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[language_code]',"Language Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[line_no]',"Line No.");
          GetRec := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('check_field_content',CurrRec);
          IF GetRec = '' THEN
            OK := FALSE
          ELSE IF GetRec = '100' THEN
            OK := TRUE
          ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN
                LogFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
                LogFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
                IF NOT FILE.EXISTS(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN BEGIN
                 IF NOT LogFile.CREATE(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error001);
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                    ERROR(Error002);
                END;
                LogFile.SEEK(LogFile.LEN);
                LogFile.WRITE(GetRec);
                LogFile.CLOSE;
                IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
                  MESSAGE(GetRec);
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;

          IF OK <> "Has Description" THEN BEGIN
            "Has Description" := OK;
            MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterCheckPaymentOption(IsHandled,WebshopPaymentOption);
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetAndSaveLastSolrUpdateDT@1000000148();
    VAR
      GetRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      ResultText@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      ResultDateTime@1000000003 : DateTime;
      WebshopSetup@1000000000 : Record 5447300;
      IsHandled@1000000004 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeGetAndSaveLastSolrUpdateDT(IsHandled);

      //Letzte Datum-Uhrzeit Solr-Update abholen und speichern

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        ResultText := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('get_solr_update_datetime',GetRec);
        IF ResultText = '0' THEN
          ResultDateTime := 0DT
        ELSE
          EVALUATE(ResultDateTime,ResultText);
        WebshopSetup.GET;
        WebshopSetup."Last Update Item-Search" := ResultDateTime;
        WebshopSetup.MODIFY(FALSE);
      END;

      OnAfterGetAndSaveLastSolrUpdateDT(IsHandled);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllShippingOptions@1000000230(CountRecords@1000000002 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ShippingOption@1000000000 : Record 5447453;
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // Alle Versandarten �bertragen
      OnBeforeUpdateAllShippingOptions(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH ShippingOption DO BEGIN
          SETRANGE("Is Active",TRUE);
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT);
            DeleteAllShippingOptions(FALSE);
            IF FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateShippingOption(ShippingOption);
              WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
            UNTIL NEXT = 0;
            DeleteAllShippingOptions(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllShippingOptions(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateShippingOption@1000000219(ParameterShippingOption@1000000000 : Record 5447453);
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000003 : Text[1024];
      IsHandled@1000000007 : Boolean;
      ShippingOption@1000000001 : Record 5447453;
      ShippingOptionsSetup@1000000002 : Record 5447450;
      ShippingZones@1000000004 : Record 5447454;
      ShippingOptionTranslation@1000000006 : Record 5447456;
      WebshopShippingOptionLink@1000000005 : Record 5447311;
    BEGIN
      // Einzelene Versandart �bertragen
      OnBeforeUpdateShippingOption(IsHandled,ParameterShippingOption);

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        ShippingOptionsSetup.GET;

        WITH ShippingOption DO BEGIN
          GET(ParameterShippingOption."Shipping Group Code",ParameterShippingOption."Line No.");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_shipping_option');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);

          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shipping_group_code]',"Shipping Group Code");

          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[line_no]',"Line No.");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[shipping_agent_code]',"Shipping Agent Code");

          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[weight_from]',"Weight from");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[weight_to]',"Weight to");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[amount_from]',"Amount from");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[amount_to]',"Amount to");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[shipping_cost]',"Shipping Cost");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[exemption]',Exemption);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[description]',Description);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[sorting]',Sorting);

          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[shipping_class_code]',"Shipping Class Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[valid_from]',"Valid from");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[valid_to]',"Valid to");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'data[shipping_zone_code]',"Shipping Zone Code");

          WebshopShippingOptionLink.SETRANGE("Shipping Group Code","Shipping Group Code");
          WebshopShippingOptionLink.SETRANGE("Line No.","Line No.");
          IF WebshopShippingOptionLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            UpdateWebshopShippingLink(WebshopShippingOptionLink);
          UNTIL WebshopShippingOptionLink.NEXT = 0;

          ShippingZones.SETRANGE(Code,"Shipping Zone Code");
          IF ShippingZones.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            UpdateShippingZone(ShippingZones);
          UNTIL ShippingZones.NEXT = 0;

          ShippingOptionTranslation.SETRANGE("Shipping Croup Code","Shipping Group Code");
          ShippingOptionTranslation.SETRANGE("Shipping Option Line No.","Line No.");
          IF ShippingOptionTranslation.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            UpdateShippingOptionTranslation(ShippingOptionTranslation);
          UNTIL ShippingOptionTranslation.NEXT = 0;

          IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
            WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('update',CurrRec,FALSE,gSendNow)
          ELSE
            WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateShippingOption(IsHandled,ParameterShippingOption);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckShippingOption@1000000209(ShippingOption@1000000000 : Record 5447453) OK : Boolean;
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      GetRec@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;
      IsHandled@1000000003 : Boolean;
      WebshopShippingOptionLink@1000000004 : Record 5447311;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCheckShippingOption(IsHandled,ShippingOption);

      // ShippingOption Content auf Inhalt �berpr�fen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN

        WITH ShippingOption DO BEGIN
          WebshopShippingOptionLink.SETRANGE("Shipping Group Code","Shipping Group Code");
          WebshopShippingOptionLink.SETRANGE("Line No.","Line No.");
          IF WebshopShippingOptionLink.FINDFIRST THEN;

          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_shipping_option');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'field','content');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shipping_group_code]',"Shipping Group Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[line_no]',"Line No.");
          GetRec := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('check_field_content',CurrRec);
          IF GetRec = '' THEN
            OK := FALSE
          ELSE IF GetRec = '100' THEN
            OK := TRUE
          ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN
                LogFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
                LogFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
                IF NOT FILE.EXISTS(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN BEGIN
                 IF NOT LogFile.CREATE(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error001);
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                    ERROR(Error002);
                END;
                LogFile.SEEK(LogFile.LEN);
                LogFile.WRITE(GetRec);
                LogFile.CLOSE;
                IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
                  MESSAGE(GetRec);
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;

          IF OK <> "Has Description" THEN BEGIN
            "Has Description" := OK;
            MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterCheckShippingOption(IsHandled,ShippingOption);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllWebshopItem@1000000009(CountRecords@1000000002 : Boolean);
    VAR
      WebshopItem@1000000000 : Record 5447304;
      IsHandled@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeUpdateAllWebshopItem(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      // Alle Webshop-Artikel �bertragen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopItem DO BEGIN
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(TABLECAPTION,COUNT);
            IF FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              IF ("Date Last Updated" < "Date Last Modified") OR ("Date Last Updated" = 0DT) THEN
                UpdateWebshopItem(WebshopItem);
              WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
            UNTIL NEXT = 0;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllWebshopItem(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateWebshopItemManually@1000000065(WebshopItem@1000000000 : Record 5447304);
    VAR
      Language@1000000002 : Record 8;
      UnitOfMeasure@1000000003 : Record 204;
      UnitOfMeasureTranslation@1000000010 : Record 5402;
      WebshopVarianType@1000000004 : Record 5447302;
      WebshopItemRecord@1000000001 : Text[1024];

      WebshopItemLink@1000000007 : Record 5447308;
      Item@1000000008 : Record 27;
      SalesPrice@1000000009 : Record 7002;
      WebshopItemCategory@1000000011 : Record 5447305;
      WebshopCategory@1000000012 : Record 5447303;
      ParamKeys@1000000014 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
      ParamValues@1000000013 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
      WebshopItemCustomize@1000000015 : Record 5447348;
      IsHandled@1000000016 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeUpdateWebshopItemManually(WebshopItem,IsHandled);

      // Einzelnen Webshop-Artikel mit zugeh�rigen Kategorien �bertragen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopItem DO BEGIN
          UpdateWebshopItem(WebshopItem);
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF WebshopItemCategory.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
            IF WebshopCategory.GET("Shop Code","Language Code",WebshopItemCategory."Category Line No.") THEN BEGIN
              UpdateCategory(WebshopCategory);
              UpdateWebshopItemCategory(WebshopItemCategory);
            END;
          UNTIL WebshopItemCategory.NEXT = 0;
          WebshopItemCustomize.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
          WebshopItemCustomize.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
          WebshopItemCustomize.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF WebshopItemCustomize.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
            UpdateItemCustomizations(WebshopItemCustomize);
          UNTIL WebshopItemCustomize.NEXT = 0;
          WebshopMarketplaceManagement.UpdateMarketplaceItem(WebshopItem);
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateWebshopItemManually(WebshopItem,IsHandled);
    END;

              ELSE
                AddVar(CurrRec,'data[multiplier]','1');

            AddVar(CurrRec,'data[net_weight]',Item."Net Weight");

            AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");

            ELSE

            WebshopShop.GET("Shop Code");
            CLEAR(CurrRec);
            AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_item');
            AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
            AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
            AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[language_code]',"Language Code");
            AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_no]',"Item No.");
            CASE "Ebay Item Condition" OF
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"1000": ItemCondition := 1000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"1500": ItemCondition := 1500;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"1750": ItemCondition := 1750;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"2000": ItemCondition := 2000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"2500": ItemCondition := 2500;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"3000": ItemCondition := 3000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"4000": ItemCondition := 4000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"5000": ItemCondition := 5000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"6000": ItemCondition := 6000;
              "Ebay Item Condition"::"7000": ItemCondition := 7000;
            END;

            AddVar(CurrRec,'data[item_condition]',ItemCondition);
            AddVar(CurrRec,'data[item_location_zip]',WebshopShop."Item Loc. Post Code");
            IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN BEGIN
              IF "Marketplace Ebay Item Template" <> '' THEN
                AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_ebay_item_template]',"Marketplace Ebay Item Template")
              ELSE
                AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_ebay_item_template]',Language."Marketplace Ebay Item Template")
            END;

            IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
              WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('update',CurrRec,FALSE,gSendNow)
            ELSE
              WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);

            UpdateWebshopItemMarketplace(WebshopItem,TRUE,TRUE,TRUE,TRUE);

            // Aktualisierungsdatum setzten
            "Last Updated Inventory" := WebshopInventory('');
            "Date Last Updated" := CURRENTDATETIME;
            MODIFY(FALSE);

            // Zugeh�rige Bilder, Videos und Dateien aktualisieren
            WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
            WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
            WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            IF WebshopItemFile.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateWebshopItemFile(WebshopItemFile);
            UNTIL WebshopItemFile.NEXT = 0;

            // Zugeh�rige Beschreibung aktualisieren
            WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
            WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
            WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE(Type,WebshopItemDescription.Type::Description);
            IF WebshopItemDescription.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateWebshopItemDescription(WebshopItemDescription);
            UNTIL WebshopItemDescription.NEXT = 0;

            // Zugeh�rige Kommentare aktualisieren
            WebshopItemComment.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
            WebshopItemComment.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
            WebshopItemComment.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            IF WebshopItemComment.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateWebshopItemComment(WebshopItemComment);
            UNTIL WebshopItemComment.NEXT = 0;

            // Nur aktualisieren wenn in den letzten 30 Sekunden keine gleiche Artikelnr. im gleichen Shop �bertragen wurde
            TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
            TempWebshopItem.SETFILTER("Date Last Updated",'>%1',CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,DT2TIME("Date Last Updated")-30000));
            IF TempWebshopItem.COUNT <= 1 THEN BEGIN

              // Zugeh�rige Verkn�pfungen aktualisieren (Sprach�bergreifend)
              WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE(Type);
              WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
              WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
              IF WebshopItemLink.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
                UpdateWebshopItemLink(WebshopItemLink);
              UNTIL WebshopItemLink.NEXT = 0;

              // Zugeh�rige Merkmale aktualisieren (Sprach�bergreifend)
              AttributeLink.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeLink.Type::Item);
              AttributeLink.SETRANGE("No.","Item No.");
              IF AttributeLink.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
                UpdateAttributeLink(AttributeLink);
                //Zugeh�rige �bersetzungen �bertragen
                AttributeTranslation.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeTranslation.Type::"Attribute Link");
                AttributeTranslation.SETRANGE("Attribute Link No.",AttributeLink."No.");
                IF AttributeTranslation.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                  UpdateAttributeTranslation(AttributeTranslation);
                UNTIL AttributeTranslation.NEXT = 0;
              UNTIL AttributeLink.NEXT = 0;

            END;

            // Nur aktualisieren wenn in den letzten 30 Sekunden keine gleiche Artikelnr. �bertragen wurde
            TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code");
            TempWebshopItem.SETFILTER("Date Last Updated",'>%1',CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,DT2TIME("Date Last Updated")-30000));
            IF TempWebshopItem.COUNT <= 1 THEN BEGIN

              // Zugeh�rige Referenzen aktualisieren (Shop- und Sprach�bergreifend)
              ItemCrossReference.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
              ItemCrossReference.SETFILTER("Cross-Reference Type",'<>%1',ItemCrossReference."Cross-Reference Type"::Vendor);
              DeleteItemCrossReference("Item No.",FALSE);
              IF ItemCrossReference.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
                UpdateItemCrossReference(ItemCrossReference);
              UNTIL ItemCrossReference.NEXT = 0;
              DeleteItemCrossReference("Item No.",TRUE);

              // Zugeh�rige Artikelvarianten aktualisieren (Shop- und Sprach�bergreifend)
              WebshopSetup.GET;
              IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Variants" THEN BEGIN
                ItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
                ItemVariant.SETRANGE("Is Webshop Active",TRUE);
                DeleteItemVariant("Item No.",FALSE);
                IF ItemVariant.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
                  UpdateItemVariant(ItemVariant);
                UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
                DeleteItemVariant("Item No.",TRUE);
              END;

              // Zugeh�rige Varianten�bersetzungen aktualisieren (Shop- und Sprach�bergreifend)
              ItemVariantTranslation.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
              ItemVariantTranslation.SETFILTER("Variant Code",'<>%1','');
              DeleteItemVariantTranslation("Item No.",FALSE);
              IF ItemVariantTranslation.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
                UpdateItemVariantTranslation(ItemVariantTranslation);
              UNTIL ItemVariantTranslation.NEXT = 0;
              DeleteItemVariantTranslation("Item No.",TRUE);

              // Zugeh�rige Preise aktualisieren (Shop- und Sprach�bergreifend)
              UpdateSalesPrice("Item No.");

            END;

            //Artikelindividualisierung
            WebshopItemCustomizations.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            WebshopItemCustomizations.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
            WebshopItemCustomizations.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
            DeleteItemCustomization("Shop Code","Language Code","Item No.",FALSE);
            IF WebshopItemCustomizations.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              UpdateItemCustomizations(WebshopItemCustomizations);
            UNTIL WebshopItemCustomizations.NEXT = 0;
            DeleteItemCustomization("Shop Code","Language Code","Item No.",TRUE);

            COMMIT;

          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateWebshopItem(IsHandled,ParameterWebshopItem);
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteWebshopItem@1000000020(WebshopItem@1000000000 : Record 5447304);
    VAR
      Language@1000000002 : Record 8;
      UnitOfMeasure@1000000003 : Record 204;
      WebshopVarianType@1000000004 : Record 5447302;
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      WebshopItemFile@1000000005 : Record 5447307;
      WebshopItemDescription@1000000006 : Record 5447306;
      WebshopItemLink@1000000007 : Record 5447308;
      TempWebshopItem@1000000008 : Record 5447304;
      WebshopItemCategory@1000000009 : Record 5447305;
      IsHandled@1000000010 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeDeleteWebshopItem(IsHandled,WebshopItem);

      // Einzelnen Webshop-Artikel l�schen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopItem DO BEGIN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_item');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[language_code]',"Language Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[item_no]',"Item No.");
          IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
            WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('instant_delete',CurrRec,FALSE,TRUE)
          ELSE
            WebshopManagement.SendRequest('instant_delete',CurrRec);


          // Zugeh�rige Kategorien l�schen
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
          WebshopItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          WebshopItemCategory.SetInWebshopItemDelete(TRUE);
          IF WebshopItemCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            WebshopItemCategory.DELETE(TRUE);
          UNTIL WebshopItemCategory.NEXT = 0;

          // Zugeh�rige Bilder, Videos und Dateien l�schen
          WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
          WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
          WebshopItemFile.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF WebshopItemFile.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            WebshopItemFile.DELETE(TRUE);
          UNTIL WebshopItemFile.NEXT = 0;

          // Zugeh�rige Beschreibung l�schen
          WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
          WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
          WebshopItemDescription.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF WebshopItemDescription.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            WebshopItemDescription.DELETE(TRUE);
          UNTIL WebshopItemDescription.NEXT = 0;

          // Nur l�schen wenn kein anderer Artikel zu Artikelnr. und Shopcode vorhanden ist
          TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
          TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF TempWebshopItem.COUNT <= 1 THEN BEGIN

            // Zugeh�rige Verkn�pfungen l�schen (wenn kein anderer Webshopartikel zu Artikelnummer vorhanden)
            WebshopItemLink.SetDeleteItem(TRUE);
            WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
            WebshopItemLink.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
            IF WebshopItemLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              WebshopItemLink.DELETE(TRUE);
            UNTIL WebshopItemLink.NEXT = 0;

          END;

          // Nur l�schen wenn kein anderer Artikel zu Artikelnr. vorhanden ist
          TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code");
          TempWebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          IF TempWebshopItem.COUNT <= 1 THEN BEGIN

            // Zugeh�rige Referenzen l�schen
            DeleteItemCrossReference("Item No.",FALSE);
            DeleteItemCrossReference("Item No.",TRUE);

            // Zugeh�rige Varianten l�schen
            DeleteItemVariant("Item No.",FALSE);
            DeleteItemVariant("Item No.",TRUE);

            // Zugeh�rige Varianten�bersetzungen l�schen
            DeleteItemVariantTranslation("Item No.",FALSE);
            DeleteItemVariantTranslation("Item No.",TRUE);

            // Zugeh�rige Preise l�schen (wenn kein anderer Webshopartikel zu Artikelnummer vorhanden)
            DeleteSalesPricePerItem(FALSE,"Item No.");
            DeleteSalesPricePerItem(TRUE,"Item No.");

          END;

        END;
      END;

      OnAfterDeleteWebshopItem(IsHandled,WebshopItem);
    END;

            IF ParaUpdatePrice THEN
              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_update_price]',TRUE);

            AddVar(CurrRec,'data[active]',WebshopItem."Active on Marketplace");

            IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN
              WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('update',CurrRec,FALSE,gSendNow)
            ELSE
              WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',CurrRec);

          UNTIL WebshopLanguage.NEXT = 0;
        UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;

        CLEAR(WebshopShop);
        WebshopShop.RESET;
        IF WebshopShop.GET(WebshopItem."Shop Code") THEN BEGIN
          IF WebshopShop."Shop Type" = WebshopShop."Shop Type"::marketplace THEN BEGIN
            WebshopLanguage.SETRANGE(WebshopLanguage."Shop Code",WebshopShop.Code);
            IF WebshopLanguage.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              CLEAR(CurrRec);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_marketplace_item_update');
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',WebshopShop.Code);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[language_code]',WebshopLanguage.Code);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_shop_code]',WebshopItem."Shop Code");
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_language_code]',WebshopItem."Language Code");
              AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_no]',WebshopItem."Item No.");

              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_update]',TRUE);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_update_images]',TRUE);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_update_price]',TRUE);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[marketplace_update_inventory]',TRUE);
              AddVar(CurrRec,'data[active]',WebshopItem."Active on Marketplace");

              IF WebshopSetup."Use Update Buffer" THEN

              ELSE

            UNTIL WebshopLanguage.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateWebshopItemMarketplace(IsHandled,ParaWebshopItem,ParaUpdate,ParaUpdateImages,ParaUpdatePrice,ParaUpdateInventory);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckWebshopItemDescription@1000000017(WebshopItemDescription@1000000000 : Record 5447306) OK : Boolean;
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      GetRec@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;
      IsHandled@1000000003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCheckWebshopItemDescription(IsHandled,WebshopItemDescription);

      // Inhalt von Webshop Artikelbeschreibung pr�fen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH WebshopItemDescription DO BEGIN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_item_description');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'field','content');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[language_code]',"Language Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_no]',"Item No.");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[line_no]',"Line No.");
          GetRec := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('check_field_content',CurrRec);
          IF GetRec = '' THEN
            OK := FALSE
          ELSE IF GetRec = '100' THEN
            OK := TRUE
          ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN
                LogFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
                LogFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
                IF NOT FILE.EXISTS(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN BEGIN
                 IF NOT LogFile.CREATE(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error001);
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                    ERROR(Error002);
                END;
                LogFile.SEEK(LogFile.LEN);
                LogFile.WRITE(GetRec);
                LogFile.CLOSE;
                IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
                  MESSAGE(GetRec);
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;

          IF OK <> Content THEN BEGIN
            Content := OK;
            MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterCheckWebshopItemDescription(IsHandled,WebshopItemDescription);
    END;

      GetRec@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;
      IsHandled@1000000003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCheckWebshopItemFile(IsHandled,WebshopItemFile);

      // Einzelne Webshop Artikeldatei pr�fen
      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WebshopSetup.GET;
        WITH WebshopItemFile DO BEGIN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'table','shop_item_file');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'field','filename');
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[company]',COMPANYNAME);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[shop_code]',"Shop Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[language_code]',"Language Code");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[item_no]',"Item No.");
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[type]',Type);
          AddVar(CurrRec,'primary[line_no]',"Line No.");
          GetRec := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('check_field_content',CurrRec);
          IF GetRec = '' THEN
            Ok := FALSE
          ELSE IF GetRec = '100' THEN
            Ok := TRUE
          ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN
                LogFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
                LogFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
                IF NOT EXISTS(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN BEGIN
                 IF NOT LogFile.CREATE(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error001);
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                    ERROR(Error002);
                END;
                LogFile.SEEK(LogFile.LEN);
                LogFile.WRITE(GetRec);
                LogFile.CLOSE;
                IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
                  MESSAGE(GetRec);
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;

          IF Ok <> File THEN BEGIN
            File := Ok;
            MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterCheckWebshopItemFile(IsHandled,WebshopItemFile);
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllItemVariantInventory@1000000079(CountRecords@1000000002 : Boolean);

      ItemVariant@1000000003 : Record 5401;

      OnBeforeUpdateAllItemVariantInventory(CountRecords,IsHandled);

      // Lagerbestand f�r alle Webshop-Artikelvarianten �bertragen

      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        WITH ItemVariant DO BEGIN
          ItemVariant.SETRANGE("Is Webshop Active",TRUE);
          IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(Text001 + TABLECAPTION,ItemVariant.COUNT)
          END ELSE BEGIN
            WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(Text001 + TABLECAPTION,ItemVariant.COUNT);
            IF FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
              WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
              IF WebshopItem.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                IF WebshopItem.WebshopInventory(Code) <> "Last Updated Webshop Inventory" THEN
                  UpdateItemVariant(ItemVariant);
                END;
              WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
            UNTIL NEXT = 0;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      OnAfterUpdateAllItemVariantInventory(CountRecords,IsHandled);
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetAllItemComments@1000000117(CountRecords@1000000000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      Text001@1000000001 : TextConst 'DEU=Bestellungen abrufen;ENU=Fetch orders';
      NoOfOrder@1000000002 : Integer;
      CurrRec@1000000003 : Text[1024];
      LogFile@1002 : File;
      LogResponse@1001 : Text;
      GetResponseText@1000 : Text;

          ELSE BEGIN
            IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN

              END ELSE BEGIN
                IF NOT LogFile.OPEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path") THEN
                  ERROR(Error002);
              END;

              LogFile.WRITE(GetResponseText);
              LogFile.CLOSE;
              IF GUIALLOWED AND WebshopSetup."Show Errors as Messages" THEN
