    PROCEDURE SendReqToMySQL@1000000124(Action@1000000000 : Text;CurrRec@1000000001 : Text) Query : Text;
    VAR
      RegexMatch@1000000002 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match";
      RegexInput@1000000003 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex";
      RegexPattern@1000000004 : Text;
      TableName@1000000005 : Text;
      DataName@1000000006 : Text;
      DataValue@1000000007 : Text;
      Counter@1000000008 : Integer;
      Error001@1000000009 : TextConst 'DEU=Kein Tabellenname angegeben.;ENU=No table name specified.';
      Error002@1000000010 : TextConst 'DEU=Keine Daten-Felder angegeben.;ENU=No data-fields specified.';
    BEGIN
      IF Action='update' THEN BEGIN
        RegexPattern := 'table\=[^\&]+';
        RegexMatch := RegexInput.Match(CurrRec,RegexPattern);
        IF RegexMatch.Success THEN BEGIN
          TableName := COPYSTR(RegexMatch.Value(),7);
          TableName := DELSTR(TableName,STRPOS(TableName,']'));
          Query := 'UPDATE `'+TableName+'`';
        END ELSE
          ERROR(Error001);

        RegexPattern := 'data\[[^\]]+\]\=[^\&]+';
        RegexMatch := RegexInput.Match(CurrRec,RegexPattern);
        IF RegexMatch.Success THEN BEGIN
          Counter := 0;
          WHILE (RegexMatch.Success) DO BEGIN
            CLEAR(DataName);
            CLEAR(DataValue);
            DataName := COPYSTR(RegexMatch.Value(),6);
            DataName := DELSTR(DataName,STRPOS(DataName,']'));
            DataValue := COPYSTR(RegexMatch.Value(),(6+STRLEN(DataName)+2));
            IF Counter=0 THEN
              Query += WebshopManagement.URLEncode(' SET `'+DataName+'`=''')+DataValue+WebshopManagement.URLEncode('''')
            ELSE
              Query += WebshopManagement.URLEncode(',`'+DataName+'`=''')+DataValue+WebshopManagement.URLEncode('''');
            RegexMatch := RegexMatch.NextMatch();
          END;
        END ELSE
          ERROR(Error002);

        RegexPattern := 'primary\[[^\]]+\]\=[^\&]+';
        RegexMatch := RegexInput.Match(CurrRec,RegexPattern);
        WHILE (RegexMatch.Success) DO BEGIN

        END;
      END ELSE IF Action='delete' THEN BEGIN

      END ELSE IF Action='instant_delete' THEN BEGIN

      END;
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 5447303 Webshop Update All Data
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=28.02.18;
    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=472;
    OnRun=BEGIN
            // Webshop Gesamtakualisierung Aufruf f�r Projektwarteschlange
            EVALUATE(ParameterPriority,"Parameter String");
            IF ParameterPriority = 'reset' THEN
              ResetJobQueue
            ELSE
              UpdateAllData();
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      WebshopSetup@1000000001 : Record 5447300;
      Text001@1000000005 : TextConst 'DEU=Webshop Gesamtaktualisierung;ENU=Webshop complete update';
      Text002@1000000002 : TextConst 'DEU=Webshop kundenspezifische Gesamtaktualisierung;ENU=Webshop customized complete update';
      WebshopManagement@1000000003 : Codeunit 5447300;
      WebshopUpdateManagement@1000000000 : Codeunit 5447301;
      CustWebshopUpdateManagement@1000000004 : Codeunit 5447302;
      WebshopMarketplaceUpdate@1000000011 : Codeunit 5447312;
      CountRecords@1000000007 : Boolean;
      i@1000000006 : Integer;
      WebshopUpdateBuffer@1000000008 : Record 5447314;
      JobQueueEntry@1000000010 : Record 472;
      ParameterPriority@1000000009 : Text[250];
      Text003@1000000012 : TextConst 'DEU=Bitte Verbindungsadresse eintragen;ENU=Please fill out the http address';

    PROCEDURE UpdateAllData@1000000049();
    BEGIN
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      IF WebshopSetup."Server Synch. Endpoint URL" <> '' THEN BEGIN

        WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('','',TRUE,FALSE);

        // Kundenspezifische Aktualisierung Gesamtdaten
        CustWebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text002);
        CountRecords := TRUE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
          CustUpdate;
          CountRecords := FALSE;
        END;
        CustWebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorClose();


        // Allgemeine Aktualisierung Gesamtdaten
        WebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text001);
        CountRecords := TRUE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
          Update;
          CountRecords := FALSE;
        END;
        WebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorClose();

        // Marketplace Aktualisierung Gesamtdaten
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplaces" THEN BEGIN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.StateIndicatorOpen(Text001);
          CountRecords := TRUE;
          FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
            MarketplaceUpdate;
            CountRecords := FALSE;
          END;
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.StateIndicatorClose();
        END;

        // Datum Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten in Webshop-Setup setzten
        WebshopSetup."Time Last Full Update" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
          WebshopSetup."Time Last Auto Full Update" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        WebshopSetup.MODIFY;

        WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('','',TRUE,FALSE);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          ERROR(Text003);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE Update@1000000002();
    BEGIN
      // Allgemeine Aktualisierung
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopSetup(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllShop(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllLanguage(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllCountry(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllPaymentOptions(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllVATPostingSetup(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllShippingClasses(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllShippingOptions(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Process Coupons" THEN BEGIN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllCouponLine(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllCouponHeader(CountRecords);
      END;
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Items" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopItem(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Customizations" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllItemCustomizations(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Webshop Categories" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllCategory(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Webshop Categories" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopItemCategory(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Active Customers" OR WebshopSetup."Update All Customers" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllCustomer(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Salespeople" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesperson(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Sales Line Discounts" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesLineDiscount(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Invoice Discounts" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllInvoiceDiscount(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Sales Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesOrder(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Invoices" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesInvoiceHeader(CountRecords);
      IF (WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Shipments") AND (NOT WebshopSetup."Confirm Marketplace Orders") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesShipmentHeader(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Cr. Memos" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesCrMemoHeader(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Return Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllReturnOrders(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Attributes" THEN BEGIN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllAttribute(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllAttributeOption(CountRecords);
      END;
      IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Subscription Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllSubscriptionCustomerLink(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Subscriptions" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSubscriptionHeader(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Subscr. Seq. Steps" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSubscSeqStep(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Subscr. Item Links" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSubscItemLink(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Subscr. Cust. Links" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdAllSubscCustLink(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Permissions" THEN BEGIN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllPermissionGroup(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllPermGroupLink(CountRecords);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CustUpdate@1000000003();
    BEGIN
      // Kundenspezifische Aktualisierung
    END;

    PROCEDURE MarketplaceUpdate@1000000001();
    BEGIN
      // Marketplace aktualisierung
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplaces" THEN BEGIN
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplace Items" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplaceItems(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplace Prices" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplacePrice(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplace Inventory" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplaceInventory(CountRecords);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ResetJobQueue@1000000000();
    BEGIN
      JobQueueEntry.SETFILTER("Object ID to Run",'5447303');
      JobQueueEntry.SETFILTER(Status,'%1',JobQueueEntry.Status::Error);
      IF JobQueueEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        JobQueueEntry.SetStatus(JobQueueEntry.Status::Ready);
        JobQueueEntry.MODIFY(TRUE);
        COMMIT;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }

OBJECT Codeunit 5447304 Webshop Update Dynamic Data
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=18.06.18;
    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=472;
    OnRun=BEGIN
            // Start der Aktualisierung �ber Projektwartschlange
            EVALUATE(ParameterPriority,"Parameter String");
            IF ParameterPriority = 'reset' THEN
              ResetJobQueue
            ELSE
              UpdateDynamicData(ParameterPriority);
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      WebshopSetup@1000000000 : Record 5447300;
      WebshopManagement@1000000002 : Codeunit 5447300;
      WebshopUpdateManagement@1000000001 : Codeunit 5447301;
      CustWebshopUpdateManagement@1000000005 : Codeunit 5447302;
      WebshopMarketplaceUpdate@1000000011 : Codeunit 5447312;
      CountRecords@1000000004 : Boolean;
      i@1000000003 : Integer;
      Text001@1000000007 : TextConst 'DEU=Webshop Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten;ENU=Webshop update dynamic data';
      Text002@1000000006 : TextConst 'DEU=Webshop kundenspezifische Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten;ENU=Webshop customized update dynamic data';
      WebshopUpdateBuffer@1000000008 : Record 5447314;
      JobQueueEntry@1000000009 : Record 472;
      ParameterPriority@1000000010 : Text[250];
      Text003@1000000012 : TextConst 'DEU=Bitte Verbindungsadresse eintragen;ENU=Please fill out the http address';

    PROCEDURE UpdateDynamicData@1000000049(ShopCodeFilter@1000000000 : Text);
    BEGIN
      WebshopSetup.GET;

      IF WebshopSetup."Server Synch. Endpoint URL" <> '' THEN BEGIN

        WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('','',TRUE,FALSE);

        // Kundenspezifische Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten
        CustWebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text002);
        CountRecords := TRUE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
          CustUpdate();
          CountRecords := FALSE;
        END;
        CustWebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorClose();


        // Allgemeine Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten
        WebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text001);
        CountRecords := TRUE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
          UpdateWithShopFilter(ShopCodeFilter);
          CountRecords := FALSE;
        END;
        WebshopUpdateManagement.StateIndicatorClose();


        // Marketplace Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplaces" THEN BEGIN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.StateIndicatorOpen(Text001);
          CountRecords := TRUE;
          FOR i := 1 TO 2 DO BEGIN
            MarketplaceUpdate();
            CountRecords := FALSE;
          END;
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.StateIndicatorClose();
        END;


        // Datum Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten in Webshop-Setup setzten
        WebshopSetup.GET;
        WebshopSetup."Time Last Update Dynamic Data" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
          WebshopSetup."Time Last Auto Upd. Dyn. Data" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        WebshopSetup.MODIFY;

        WebshopUpdateBuffer.SendRequest('','',TRUE,FALSE);

      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          ERROR(Text003);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateWithShopFilter@1000000004(ShopCodeFilter@1000000000 : Text);
    VAR
      WebshopShop@1000000001 : Record 5447301;
    BEGIN
      IF ShopCodeFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
        WebshopShop.SETFILTER(Code,ShopCodeFilter);
        IF WebshopShop.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN REPEAT
          IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Orders" THEN
            WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllSalesHeader(CountRecords,WebshopShop.Code);
        UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Update();
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE Update@1000000002();
    BEGIN
      // Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten

      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Orders" THEN
            WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllSalesHeader(CountRecords,'');
      END;

      IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Return Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllReturnOrder(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.ProcessAllInvoiceOnlinePayment(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.ProcessAllCrMemoOnlinePayment(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.ClearAllInvoiceOnlinePayment(CountRecords);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.ClearAllCrMemoOnlinePayment(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Sales Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesOrder(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Inventory" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopItemInventory(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Sales Prices" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopItemStdPrices(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Inventory" AND WebshopSetup."Update Item Variants" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllItemVariantInventory(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Invoices" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllInvoiceRequest(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Cr. Memos" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllCrMemoRequest(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Shipments" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllShipmentRequest(CountRecords);
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Item Reviews" THEN BEGIN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAllItemComments(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllWebshopItemComment(CountRecords);
      END;

      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllReturnReason(CountRecords);

      IF WebshopSetup."Create Subscription Orders" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.ManageSubscriptions(CountRecords);

      IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SendAllOrderConfirmMail(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SendAllOrderShippingMail(CountRecords);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SendAllOrderInvoiceMail(CountRecords);
      END;

      IF (WebshopSetup."Update Posted Sales Shipments") AND (WebshopSetup."Confirm Marketplace Orders") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateAllSalesShipmentHeader(CountRecords);

      IF WebshopSetup."Send Orders to Newsl. System" THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.TransferNewsletter(CountRecords);
      IF NOT CountRecords THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.GetAndSaveLastSolrUpdateDT();
    END;

    PROCEDURE CustUpdate@1000000003();
    BEGIN
      // Kundenspezifische Aktualisierung Bewegungsdaten
    END;

    PROCEDURE MarketplaceUpdate@1000000001();
    BEGIN
      // Marketplace aktualisierung
      WebshopSetup.GET;
      IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplaces" THEN BEGIN
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplace Prices" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplacePrice(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Update Marketplace Inventory" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplaceInventory(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Marketplace Orders" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplaceOrders(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Confirm Marketplace Orders" THEN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.UpdateMarketplaceOrderState(CountRecords);
        IF WebshopSetup."Fetch Marketplace Upd. Errors" THEN BEGIN
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.GetAllMarketplaceErrors(CountRecords);
          WebshopMarketplaceUpdate.GetAllMarketplaceItemErrors(CountRecords);
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ResetJobQueue@1000000000();
    BEGIN
      JobQueueEntry.SETFILTER("Object ID to Run",'5447304');
      JobQueueEntry.SETFILTER(Status,'%1',JobQueueEntry.Status::Error);
      IF JobQueueEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        JobQueueEntry.SetStatus(JobQueueEntry.Status::Ready);
        JobQueueEntry.MODIFY(TRUE);
        COMMIT;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }
}

OBJECT Codeunit 5447308 Webshop Frontend Link
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=30.06.17;
    Time=16:00:00;
    Version List=MYSW14.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            Customer@1000000000 : Record 18;
            Salesperson@1000000001 : Record 13;
          BEGIN
            // �ffnet den Webshop mit dem in der Einrichtung hinterlegten Debitor

            WebshopSetup.GET;

            IF STRLEN(gShopCode)>0 THEN
              Shop.GET(gShopCode)
            ELSE BEGIN
              DefaultNumber := 1;

              IF Shop.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
                i := 1;
                IF Shop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                  IF i <> 1 THEN
                    OptionString += ',';
                  OptionString += Shop.Description;
                  IF Shop.Code = WebshopSetup."Default Shop Code" THEN
                    DefaultNumber := i;
                  i += 1;
                UNTIL Shop.NEXT = 0;
                SelectedOption := DIALOG.STRMENU(OptionString,DefaultNumber,Text001);
              END ELSE BEGIN
                SelectedOption := 1;
              END;
              IF SelectedOption = 1 THEN
                Shop.FINDFIRST
              ELSE IF SelectedOption > 1 THEN BEGIN
                Shop.RESET;
                i := 1;
                IF Shop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                  i += 1;
                UNTIL (SelectedOption=i) OR (Shop.NEXT = 0);
              END ELSE
                EXIT;
            END;


            Shop.TESTFIELD("Webshop URL");
            CASE Shop."Shop Type" OF
              Shop."Shop Type"::b2b: BEGIN
                Shop.TESTFIELD("Default Customer No. Login");
                Customer.GET(Shop."Default Customer No. Login");
                WebshopUpdateManagement.OpenCustomerLogin(Customer);
              END;
              Shop."Shop Type"::b2c: BEGIN
                HYPERLINK(Shop."Webshop URL");
              END;
              Shop."Shop Type"::salesperson: BEGIN
                Shop.TESTFIELD("Default Salesperson Code");
                Salesperson.GET(Shop."Default Salesperson Code");
                WebshopUpdateManagement.OpenSalespersonLogin(Salesperson);
              END;
              Shop."Shop Type"::catalog: BEGIN
                HYPERLINK(Shop."Webshop URL");
              END;
            END;
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      WebshopManagement@1000000000 : Codeunit 5447300;
      WebshopUpdateManagement@1000000008 : Codeunit 5447301;
      WebshopSetup@1000000001 : Record 5447300;
      Shop@1000000002 : Record 5447301;
      OptionString@1000000003 : Text[1024];
      Text001@1000000004 : TextConst 'DEU=Welchen Webshop m�chten Sie �ffnen?;ENU=Which shop shall be opened?';
      DefaultNumber@1000000005 : Integer;
      SelectedOption@1000000006 : Integer;
      i@1000000007 : Integer;
      gShopCode@1000 : Code[10];

    PROCEDURE SetShopCode@1(ShopCode@1000 : Code[10]);
    BEGIN
      gShopCode := ShopCode;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.

      Text003@1000000002 : TextConst 'DEU=Ma�einheit: %1 | Zeitraum: %2..%3;ENU=Measure: %1 | Period: %2..%3';
      gCalendar@1000000003 : Record 2000000007;
      gDateArray@1000000004 : ARRAY [31] OF Date;
      gShopCodeArray@1000000005 : ARRAY [200] OF Code[20];

      gStartDate@1000000011 : Date;
      gEndDate@1000000012 : Date;
      gWorkdate@1000000013 : Date;
      gMeasure@1000000014 : 'Amount,AmountVAT,NoOfPostedInvoices,NoOfPostedCrMemos';
      gChartType@1000000015 : 'Point,,Bubble,Line,,StepLine,,,,,Column,StackedColumn,StackedColumn100,Area,,StackedArea,StackedArea100,Pie,Doughnut,,,Range,,,,Radar,,,,,,,,Funnel';

    PROCEDURE UpdateWebshopOrderSalesChart@1000000000(VAR BusinessChartBuffer@1000000000 : Record 485;MovePeriod@1000000001 : ' ,Next,Previous';PeriodLength@1000000002 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year');
    VAR
      WebshopShop@1000000003 : Record 5447301;
      Calendar@1000000004 : Record 2000000007;
      XIndex@1000000005 : Integer;
      YIndex@1000000012 : Integer;
      CalendarEntry@1000000006 : Record 99000757;
      Amount@1000000007 : ARRAY [200] OF Decimal;
      "Amount (incl. VAT)"@1000000008 : ARRAY [200] OF Decimal;
      WebshopCode@1000000009 : ARRAY [200] OF Code[20];
      ShopCounter@1000000010 : Integer;
      ShopCodeFilterString@1000000011 : Text;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@1000000013 : Record 112;
      SalesCrMemoHeader@1000000014 : Record 114;
      CurrColumnIndex@1000000017 : Integer;
      NoOfColumns@1000000018 : Integer;
      LocAmnt@1000000015 : Decimal;
      LocAmntVAT@1000000016 : Decimal;
      InvoiceCount@1000000019 : Integer;
      CrMemoCount@1000000020 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      WITH BusinessChartBuffer DO BEGIN
        Initialize;

      //  gWorkdate := GetEndDateForCurrInterval(gWorkdate,PeriodLength);

        //Generate the period to be displayed
        SetChartPeriod(PeriodLength, MovePeriod,gWorkdate);

        //Add Measures for Webshop
        ShopCounter := 0;
        ShopCodeFilterString := '';
        IF WebshopShop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          AddMeasure(WebshopShop.Code,1,"Data Type"::Decimal, gChartType);
          gShopCodeArray[ShopCounter + 1] := WebshopShop.Code;
          IF ShopCounter > 0 THEN
            ShopCodeFilterString += '|';
          ShopCodeFilterString += WebshopShop.Code;
          Amount[ShopCounter + 1] := 0;
          "Amount (incl. VAT)"[ShopCounter + 1] := 0;
          ShopCounter += 1;
        UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;

        //Set X-Axis  Value
        SetXAxis(Text004, "Data Type"::String);

        XIndex := 0;
        CurrStartDate := GetStartDateForPeriodLength(PeriodLength);
        CurrEndDate := GetEndDateForCurrInterval(CurrStartDate,PeriodLength);
        NoOfColumns := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
        gStartDate := GetStartDateForPeriodLength(PeriodLength);
        gEndDate :=  GetEndDateForPeriodLength(PeriodLength);
        FOR CurrColumnIndex := 1 TO NoOfColumns DO BEGIN

          gDateFilterArray[CurrColumnIndex] := FORMAT(CurrStartDate,0,'<Standard Format,5>')+'..'+FORMAT(CurrEndDate,0,'<Standard Format,5>');

          AddColumn(GetCurrPeriodName(CurrStartDate,PeriodLength));

          //Calculate Totals for All Webshops
          FOR YIndex := 0 TO ShopCounter - 1 DO BEGIN
            LocAmnt := 0;
            LocAmntVAT := 0;
            //Add Posted Sales Invoices
            SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("Posting Date",CurrStartDate,CurrEndDate);
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("Webshop Shop Code",gShopCodeArray[YIndex + 1]);
            InvoiceCount := 0;
            IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              InvoiceCount += 1;
              SalesInvoiceHeader.CALCFIELDS(Amount,"Amount Including VAT");
              LocAmnt += SalesInvoiceHeader.Amount;
              LocAmntVAT += SalesInvoiceHeader."Amount Including VAT";
            UNTIL SalesInvoiceHeader.NEXT = 0;

            //Subtract Posted Sales Cr Memos
            SalesCrMemoHeader.RESET;
            SalesCrMemoHeader.SETRANGE("Posting Date",CurrStartDate,CurrEndDate);
            SalesCrMemoHeader.SETRANGE("Webshop Shop Code",gShopCodeArray[YIndex + 1]);
            CrMemoCount := 0;
            IF SalesCrMemoHeader.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              CrMemoCount += 1;
              SalesCrMemoHeader.CALCFIELDS(Amount,"Amount Including VAT");
              LocAmnt -= SalesCrMemoHeader.Amount;
              LocAmntVAT -= SalesCrMemoHeader."Amount Including VAT";
            UNTIL SalesCrMemoHeader.NEXT = 0;

            // Set the values for each of the stacks
            CASE gMeasure OF
              gMeasure::Amount:
                SetValueByIndex(YIndex,XIndex,LocAmnt);
              gMeasure::AmountVAT:
                SetValueByIndex(YIndex,XIndex,LocAmntVAT);
              gMeasure::NoOfPostedInvoices:
                SetValueByIndex(YIndex,XIndex,InvoiceCount);
              gMeasure::NoOfPostedCrMemos:
                SetValueByIndex(YIndex,XIndex,CrMemoCount);
            END;
          END;

          CurrEndDate := GetEndDateForNextInterval(CurrStartDate,PeriodLength);
          CurrStartDate := GetStartDateForNextInterval(CurrStartDate,PeriodLength);

          XIndex += 1;

        END;


      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetEndDateForPeriodLength@1000000007(PeriodLength@1000000000 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year') : Date;
    VAR
      DateExprString@1000000001 : Text[250];
    BEGIN
      CASE PeriodLength OF
        PeriodLength::Day:
          DateExprString := '<+CD-1D>';
        PeriodLength::Week:
          DateExprString := '<+CW-1W>';
        PeriodLength::Month:
          DateExprString := '<+CM-1M>';
        PeriodLength::Quarter:
          DateExprString := '<+CQ-1Q>';
        ELSE
          DateExprString := '<+CY-1Y>';
      END;
      EXIT(CALCDATE(DateExprString,gWorkdate));
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetStartDateForPeriodLength@1000000012(PeriodLength@1000000000 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year') : Date;
    VAR
      DateExprString@1000000001 : Text[250];
      NoOfIntervalsBack@1000000002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CASE PeriodLength OF
        PeriodLength::Day:
          BEGIN
            NoOfIntervalsBack := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
            DateExprString := '<-CD-' + FORMAT(NoOfIntervalsBack) + 'D>';
          END;

        PeriodLength::Week:
          BEGIN
            NoOfIntervalsBack := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
            DateExprString := '<-CW-' + FORMAT(NoOfIntervalsBack) + 'W>';
          END;

        PeriodLength::Month:
          BEGIN
            NoOfIntervalsBack := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
            DateExprString := '<-CM-' + FORMAT(NoOfIntervalsBack) + 'M>';
          END;

        PeriodLength::Quarter:
          BEGIN
            NoOfIntervalsBack := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
            DateExprString := '<-CQ-' + FORMAT(NoOfIntervalsBack) + 'Q>';
          END;

        ELSE
          BEGIN
            NoOfIntervalsBack := GetNoOfColumnsForPeriod(PeriodLength);
            DateExprString := '<-CY-' + FORMAT(NoOfIntervalsBack) + 'Y>';
          END;

      END;
      EXIT(CALCDATE(DateExprString,gWorkdate));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCurrPeriodName@1000000020(PeriodStartDate@1000000000 : Date;PeriodLength@1000000001 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year') : Text[250];

      Text001@1000000002 : TextConst 'DEU="KW ";ENU="CW "';
    BEGIN
      CASE PeriodLength OF

        PeriodLength::Day:
          EXIT(FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Standard Format,0>'));

        PeriodLength::Week:
          EXIT(Text001+FORMAT(DATE2DWY(PeriodStartDate,2))+' '+FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Year>'));

        PeriodLength::Month:
          EXIT(FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Month Text,3>')+' '+FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Year>'));

        PeriodLength::Quarter:
          EXIT('Q'+FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Quarter>')+' '+FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Year>'));

        ELSE
          EXIT(FORMAT(PeriodStartDate,0,'<Year4>'));

      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetEndDateForCurrInterval@1000000023(CurrStartDate@1000000003 : Date;PeriodLength@1000000000 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year') : Date;
    VAR
      DateExprString@1000000001 : Text[250];
      NoOfIntervalsBack@1000000002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CASE PeriodLength OF
        PeriodLength::Day:
          DateExprString := '<+CD>';

        PeriodLength::Week:
          DateExprString := '<+CW>';

        PeriodLength::Month:
          DateExprString := '<+CM>';

        PeriodLength::Quarter:
          DateExprString := '<+CQ>';

        ELSE
          DateExprString := '<+CY>';
      END;
      EXIT(CALCDATE(DateExprString,CurrStartDate));
    END;

      WebshopCouponLine.DELETEALL(TRUE);

      WebshopCouponShippingLine.SETRANGE(Code,Rec.Code);
      WebshopCouponShippingLine.SETRANGE("Coupon Code",Rec."Coupon Code");
      WebshopCouponShippingLine.DELETEALL(TRUE);

      IF WebshopMgmt.ConnectionTest THEN
        WebshopUpdtMgmt.DeleteCouponLine(Rec);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Page,5447477,OnBeforeFinishAction,"",Skip,Skip)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnBeforeFinishAction@1000000034(CouponLine@1000000000 : Record 5447472;VAR SalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 36;VAR SalesLine@1000000002 : Record 37;CouponDiscountAmount@1000000003 : Decimal;VAR IsHandled@1000000004 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SalesLineAmount@1000000005 : Decimal;
      ShippingOptionsManagement@1000000006 : Codeunit 5447450;
      ShippingOption@1000000007 : Record 5447453;
      WebshopShippingOptionLink@1000000008 : Record 5447311;
      TempShippingOption@1000000009 : TEMPORARY Record 5447453;
      WebshopCouponShippingLine@1000000010 : Record 5447330;
      NewShippingCost@1000000011 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT IsHandled THEN BEGIN
        IF CouponLine."Value Type Shop" = CouponLine."Value Type Shop"::Sonderversand THEN BEGIN
          SalesLineAmount := ShippingOptionsManagement.SetShippingOptionsForSalesHeader(ShippingOption,SalesHeader);
          IF ShippingOption.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            TempShippingOption.INIT;
            TempShippingOption.TRANSFERFIELDS(ShippingOption);
            TempShippingOption.INSERT;

            IF WebshopCouponShippingLine.GET(CouponLine.Code,CouponLine."Coupon Code") THEN BEGIN
              IF (WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Type" = WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Type"::amount) AND (WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Value" > 0) THEN BEGIN
                TempShippingOption."Shipping Cost" := WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Value";
                TempShippingOption.MODIFY;
              END;
              IF (WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Type" = WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Type"::percent) AND (WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Value" > 0) THEN BEGIN
                NewShippingCost := TempShippingOption."Shipping Cost" - (TempShippingOption."Shipping Cost" / 100 * WebshopCouponShippingLine."Shipping Coupon Value");
                TempShippingOption."Shipping Cost" := NewShippingCost;
                TempShippingOption.MODIFY;
              END;
            END;
          UNTIL ShippingOption.NEXT = 0;
          IF ShippingOptionsManagement.SelectShippingOptionFromShippingOptions(TempShippingOption,SalesLineAmount) THEN BEGIN
            ShippingOptionsManagement.AddShippingOptionLineToSalesHeader(SalesHeader,TempShippingOption,SalesLine,SalesLineAmount);
          END;
          IsHandled := TRUE;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,5447470,OnBeforeCheckCouponIsvalid,"",Skip,Skip)]

    PROCEDURE AddVar@1000000041(VAR Data@1000000002 : Text[1024];VarName@1000000001 : Text[100];VarValue@1000000000 : Variant);

    PROCEDURE UpdateMarketplace@1000000001(WebshopShopCode@1000000003 : Code[10];WebshopLanguageCode@1000000000 : Code[10];Operation@1000000004 : Text[20];ParamKeys@1000000005 : ARRAY [20] OF Text[20];ParamValues@1000000001 : ARRAY [20] OF Text);
    VAR
      CurrRec@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      I@1000000006 : Integer;
      WebshopShop@1000000007 : Record 5447301;
      WebshopLanguage@1000000008 : Record 5447302;
    BEGIN

      IF (WebshopShop.GET(WebshopShopCode)) AND (WebshopLanguage.GET(WebshopShopCode,WebshopLanguageCode)) THEN BEGIN
        AddVar(CurrRec,'company',COMPANYNAME);
        AddVar(CurrRec,'shop_code',WebshopLanguage."Shop Code");
        AddVar(CurrRec,'language_code',WebshopLanguage.Code);
        IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'marketplace_type','1');
        IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
          AddVar(CurrRec,'marketplace_type','2');

        AddVar(CurrRec,'operation',Operation);

        FOR I := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(ParamKeys) DO BEGIN
          IF (ParamKeys[I] <> '') THEN BEGIN
            AddVar(CurrRec,'parameter[' + ParamKeys[I] + ']',ParamValues[I]);
          END;
        END;

        WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update_marketplace_queue',CurrRec);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateMarketplaceItems@1000000006(CountRecords@1000000003 : Boolean);
    VAR
      WebshopShop@1000000002 : Record 5447301;
      WebshopLanguage@1000000001 : Record 5447302;
      CurrRec@1000000000 : Text[1024];
      ParamKeys@1000000004 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
      ParamValues@1000000005 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
    BEGIN
      IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
        WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(WebshopShop.TABLECAPTION,WebshopShop.COUNT)
      END ELSE BEGIN
        WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(WebshopShop.TABLECAPTION,WebshopShop.COUNT);

        WebshopShop.SETFILTER(WebshopShop."Shop Type",'%1',WebshopShop."Shop Type"::marketplace);
        IF WebshopShop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          IF (WebshopShop."AWS Access Key ID" <> '') OR (WebshopShop."Ebay App Name" <> '') THEN BEGIN
            WebshopLanguage.SETFILTER(WebshopLanguage."Shop Code",WebshopShop.Code);
            IF WebshopLanguage.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
              UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopLanguage.Code,'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);
            UNTIL WebshopLanguage.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;

        WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateMarketplaceItem@1000000003(ParamWebshopItem@1000000000 : Record 5447304);
    VAR
      WebshopItem@1000000001 : Record 5447304;
      WebshopShop@1000000002 : Record 5447301;
      WebshopLanguage@1000000003 : Record 5447302;
      ParamKeys@1000000005 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
      ParamValues@1000000004 : ARRAY [20] OF Text;
    BEGIN
      WebshopItem.GET(ParamWebshopItem."Shop Code",ParamWebshopItem."Language Code",ParamWebshopItem."Item No.");

      WebshopShop.SETFILTER(WebshopShop."Shop Type",'%1',WebshopShop."Shop Type"::marketplace);
      IF WebshopShop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF (WebshopShop.Code = WebshopItem."Shop Code") OR (WebshopShop."Use Items from Shop Code" = WebshopItem."Shop Code") THEN BEGIN
          ParamKeys[1] := 'item_no';
          EVALUATE(ParamValues[1],WebshopItem."Item No.");
          //ParamKeys[2] := 'function';

          //ParamValues[2] := 'update_products';
          IF WebshopItem."Active on Marketplace" THEN
            UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues)
          ELSE
            UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'end_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);

          //ParamValues[2] := 'update_inventory';
          //UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);

          //ParamValues[2] := 'update_price';
          //UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);

          IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN BEGIN
            ParamValues[2] := 'update_images';
            UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);

            ParamValues[2] := 'update_relationship';
            UpdateMarketplace(WebshopShop.Code,WebshopItem."Language Code",'send_products',ParamKeys,ParamValues);
          END;
        END;
      UNTIL WebshopShop.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetAllFetchedMktplCategories@1000000207(ShopCode@1000000000 : Code[30];ShopLanguageCode@1000000007 : Code[10];CountRecords@1000000008 : Boolean;AboveLineNo@1000000011 : Integer);
    VAR
      NoOfRec@1000000006 : Integer;
      GetRec@1000000001 : Text[1024];
      ResponseText@1000000002 : Text[1024];
      i@1000000003 : Integer;
      CategoryFetched@1000000004 : Boolean;
      Error001@1000000005 : TextConst 'DEU=Ein Datensatz f�r eine Marketplace-Kategorie konnte nicht synchronisiert werden.;ENU=A Record for a Marketplace-Category could not be synchronized.';
      Text001@1000000009 : TextConst 'DEU=Ermittelte Marktplatz-Kategorien;ENU=Fetched Marketplace Categories';
      LineNoInterval@1000000010 : Integer;
      Category@1000000012 : Record 5447303;
    BEGIN
      AddVar(GetRec,'table','shop_marketplace_categories');
      IF AboveLineNo > 0 THEN BEGIN
        Category.GET(ShopCode,ShopLanguageCode,AboveLineNo);
        AddVar(GetRec,'filter[parent_category_code]',Category."Search Code");
      END ELSE BEGIN
        AddVar(GetRec,'filter[parent_category_code]','');
      END;
      AddVar(GetRec,'filter[update_insert]',TRUE);

      CLEAR(ResponseText);
      ResponseText := WebshopManagement.GetRequest('get_no_of_records',GetRec);

      IF EVALUATE(NoOfRec,WebshopManagement.GetRequest('get_no_of_records',GetRec)) THEN BEGIN
        IF CountRecords THEN BEGIN
          WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorRegisterTable(Text001,NoOfRec)
        END ELSE BEGIN
          //Verschiebe nachfolgende Kategorien
          LineNoInterval := 10000;
          MoveAllCategoriesBelowLineNo(ShopCode,ShopLanguageCode,AboveLineNo,(NoOfRec * LineNoInterval));

          WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorNewTable(Text001,NoOfRec);
          i := 1;
          WHILE (i <= NoOfRec) DO BEGIN
            CategoryFetched := GetNextFetchedMktplCategory(ShopCode,ShopLanguageCode,AboveLineNo);
            IF CategoryFetched THEN BEGIN
              i += 1;
              WebshopManagement.StateIndicatorUpdate;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              ERROR(Error001);
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetNextFetchedMktplCategory@1000000208(ShopCode@1000000013 : Code[30];ShopLanguageCode@1000000014 : Code[10];AboveLineNo@1000000018 : Integer) Success : Boolean;
    VAR

      GetRec@1000000007 : Text[1024];

      RecRootCode@1000000019 : Text[45];
      CategoryInsert@1000000015 : Boolean;
      SetRec@1000000016 : Text[1024];
      NewLineNo@1000000017 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      WITH Category DO BEGIN
        Delimiter := '-;-';
        CLEAR(GetRec);
        CLEAR(SendRec);
        AddVar(SendRec,'table','shop_marketplace_categories');
        AddVar(SendRec,'delimiter',Delimiter);

               'category_level,parent_category_code,root_category_code');
        IF AboveLineNo > 0 THEN BEGIN
          Category.RESET;
          Category.GET(ShopCode,ShopLanguageCode,AboveLineNo);
          AddVar(SendRec,'filter[parent_category_code]',Category."Search Code");
        END ELSE BEGIN
          AddVar(SendRec,'filter[parent_category_code]','');
        END;

        AddVar(SendRec,'filter[update_insert]',TRUE);

        IF STRPOS(GetRec,Delimiter) <> 0 THEN BEGIN

          EVALUATE(RecParentCode,WebshopManagement.Explode(GetRec,Delimiter));

          VALIDATE(Category."Search Code",RecCategoryCode);

          CategoryInsert := Category.INSERT;
          IF CategoryInsert THEN BEGIN
              CLEAR(SetRec);
              AddVar(SetRec,'table','shop_marketplace_categories');
              AddVar(SetRec,'primary[id]',RecID);
              AddVar(SetRec,'data[update_insert]',FALSE);
              WebshopManagement.SendRequest('update',SetRec);

              //FetchCategoryAttributes(Category,TRUE);

          END;
          COMMIT;
          EXIT(CategoryInsert);
        END ELSE BEGIN
          IF GetRec<>'0' THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT WebshopSetup."Catch & Log WebRequest Errors" THEN
              ERROR(GetRec)
            ELSE BEGIN
              IF STRLEN(WebshopSetup."Connection Log File Path")>0 THEN BEGIN

                END ELSE BEGIN

              END ELSE
                ERROR(Error003);
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE MoveAllCategoriesBelowLineNo@1000000129(ShopCode@1000000003 : Code[30];LanguageCode@1000000004 : Code[10];AboveLineNo@1000000000 : Integer;MoveByInterval@1000000001 : Integer);
    VAR
      Category@1000000002 : Record 5447303;
      NewLineNo@1000000005 : Integer;
      LineNoInterval@1000000006 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Category.SETRANGE("Shop Code",ShopCode);
      Category.SETRANGE("Language Code",LanguageCode);
      Category.SETFILTER("Line No.",'>%1',AboveLineNo);
      Category.ASCENDING(FALSE);
      IF Category.FINDFIRST THEN REPEAT
        NewLineNo := Category."Line No." + MoveByInterval;
        Category.RENAME(Category."Shop Code",Category."Language Code",NewLineNo);
      UNTIL Category.NEXT = 0;
      COMMIT;
    END;

            IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
              AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[category_code]',ParamCategory."Marketplace Root Category Code")
            ELSE IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
              AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[category_code]',ParamCategory."Search Code");

            AddVar(CurrRec,'filter[marketplace_type]',WebshopShop."Marketplace Type");

              EVALUATE(IsVariation,WebshopManagement.Explode(GetRec,Delimiter));
              EVALUATE(IsRequired,WebshopManagement.Explode(GetRec,Delimiter));
              CLEAR(WebshopAttribute);
              CLEAR(WebshopAttributeLink);
              WebshopAttribute.RESET;
              IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN BEGIN
                Prefix := Text001;
                AttributeType := 1;
              END ELSE IF WebshopShop."Marketplace Type" = WebshopShop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN BEGIN
                Prefix := Text002;
                AttributeType := 2;
              END ELSE BEGIN
                Prefix := '';
                AttributeType := 0;
              END;

              DescriptionCode := COPYSTR(Description,1,30-STRLEN(Prefix));

                WebshopAttributeLink."Language Code" := Category."Language Code";

                WebshopAttributeLink."Is Marketpl. Req. Attribute" := IsRequired;
                WebshopAttributeLink.INSERT;
              END;
              CLEAR(SetRec);
              AddVar(SetRec,'table','shop_marketplace_variant_attributes');
              AddVar(SetRec,'primary[id]',AttributeId);

            END;
          END;
        UNTIL NextWebshopAttribute = FALSE;

    PROCEDURE EditContent@1000000000();
    BEGIN
      IF ClientAddInType <> ClientAddInType::DynamicCommerce THEN
        ERROR(Text007);

      TESTFIELD(Code);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.SetSendNow(TRUE);
      WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateSalesperson(Rec);
      GET(Code);
      COMMIT;

      IF ClientAddInType = ClientAddInType::DynamicCommerce THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(WebshopWebform);
        //DynamicCommerceAddIn
        WebshopWebform.SetWebformType(WebformType::SalesPerson);
        WebshopWebform.SetRecordCode(Code);
        WebshopWebform.LOOKUPMODE(TRUE);
        WebshopWebform.RUNMODAL();
      END;

      GET(Code);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce ---

      STANDARD-VERSION 2017

        ELEMENTS (0):
        PAGE ACTIONS (3):

          NAME                            CAPTION                         TYPE                 SUBTYPE

          E-Commerce                      <E-Commerce>                    ActionGroup
          Webshop Send Login Data         Zugangsdaten versenden          Action
          Webshop Update Salesperson      Verk�ufer Aktualisieren         Action


        TRIGGERS (1):

          OnInit()


        GLOBAL VARIABLES (6):

          NAME                          DATATYPE        SUBTYPE                       LENGTH

          WebshopManagement             Codeunit        "Webshop Management"
          WebshopUpdateManagement       Codeunit        "Webshop Update Management"
          ClientAddInType              Option
          WebshopAssemblyResolver      Codeunit      Webshop Assembly Resolver
          WebshopWebform              Page          Webshop Webform
          WebformType                  Option


        TEXT CONSTANTS (2):

        NAME

        Text001
        Text007

        FUNCTIONS (1):

          EditContent()


      +++ dynamic commerce +++
    }
    END.

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetTotalSales@6() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      NoPostedInvoices := 0;
      NoPostedCrMemos := 0;
      NoOutstandingInvoices := 0;
      NoOutstandingCrMemos := 0;
      Totals := 0;

      AmountOnPostedInvoices := CustomerMgt.CalcAmountsOnPostedInvoices("No.",NoPostedInvoices);
      AmountOnPostedCrMemos := CustomerMgt.CalcAmountsOnPostedCrMemos("No.",NoPostedCrMemos);

      AmountOnOutstandingInvoices := CustomerMgt.CalculateAmountsOnUnpostedInvoices("No.",NoOutstandingInvoices);
      AmountOnOutstandingCrMemos := CustomerMgt.CalculateAmountsOnUnpostedCrMemos("No.",NoOutstandingCrMemos);

      Totals := AmountOnPostedInvoices + AmountOnPostedCrMemos + AmountOnOutstandingInvoices + AmountOnOutstandingCrMemos;

      CustomerMgt.CalculateStatistic(
        Rec,
        AdjmtCostLCY,AdjCustProfit,AdjProfitPct,
        CustInvDiscAmountLCY,CustPaymentsLCY,CustSalesLCY,
        CustProfit);
      EXIT(Totals)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAmountOnPostedInvoices@5() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(AmountOnPostedInvoices)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAmountOnCrMemo@8() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(AmountOnPostedCrMemos)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAmountOnOutstandingInvoices@9() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(AmountOnOutstandingInvoices)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAmountOnOutstandingCrMemos@10() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(AmountOnOutstandingCrMemos)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetMoneyOwedExpected@11() : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(CustomerMgt.CalculateAmountsWithVATOnUnpostedDocuments("No."))
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSalesPricesAndSalesLineDisc@24();
    BEGIN
      IF "No." <> CurrPage.PriceAndLineDisc.PAGE.GetLoadedCustNo THEN BEGIN
        CurrPage.PriceAndLineDisc.PAGE.LoadCustomer(Rec);
        CurrPage.PriceAndLineDisc.PAGE.UPDATE(FALSE);
      END;
    END;

      Customer@1001 : Record 18;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateCustomerFromTemplate@27();
    VAR
      MiniCustomerTemplate@1001 : Record 1300;
      Customer@1000 : Record 18;
      VATRegNoSrvConfig@1003 : Record 248;
      EUVATRegistrationNoCheck@1002 : Page 1339;
      CustomerRecRef@1004 : RecordRef;
    BEGIN
      OnBeforeCreateCustomerFromTemplate(NewMode);

      IF NewMode THEN BEGIN
        IF MiniCustomerTemplate.NewCustomerFromTemplate(Customer) THEN BEGIN
          IF VATRegNoSrvConfig.VATRegNoSrvIsEnabled THEN
            IF Customer."Validate EU Vat Reg. No." THEN BEGIN
              EUVATRegistrationNoCheck.SetRecordRef(Customer);
              COMMIT;
              EUVATRegistrationNoCheck.RUNMODAL;
              EUVATRegistrationNoCheck.GetRecordRef(CustomerRecRef);
              CustomerRecRef.SETTABLE(Customer);
            END;

          COPY(Customer);
          CurrPage.UPDATE;
        END;
        NewMode := FALSE;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EnableControls@6();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@1000 : Record 32;
      CRMIntegrationManagement@1001 : Codeunit 5330;
    BEGIN
      InventoryItemEditable := Type = Type::Inventory;
      IsService := (Type = Type::Service);

      IF Type = Type::Inventory THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.","No.");
        UnitCostEditable := ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY;
      END ELSE
        UnitCostEditable := TRUE;

      ProfitEditable := "Price/Profit Calculation" <> "Price/Profit Calculation"::"Profit=Price-Cost";
      PriceEditable := "Price/Profit Calculation" <> "Price/Profit Calculation"::"Price=Cost+Profit";

      EnablePlanningControls;
      EnableCostingControls;

      EnableShowStockOutWarning;

      SetSocialListeningFactboxVisibility;
      EnableShowShowEnforcePositivInventory;
      CRMIntegrationEnabled := CRMIntegrationManagement.IsCRMIntegrationEnabled;

      UpdateSpecialPricesAndDiscountsTxt;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnNewRec@16();
    VAR
      DocumentNoVisibility@1002 : Codeunit 1400;
    BEGIN
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        EnableControls;
        IF "No." = '' THEN
          IF DocumentNoVisibility.ItemNoSeriesIsDefault THEN
            NewMode := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EnableShowStockOutWarning@4();
    VAR
      SalesSetup@1000 : Record 311;
    BEGIN
      IF Type = Type::Service THEN
        "Stockout Warning" := "Stockout Warning"::No;

      SalesSetup.GET;
      ShowStockoutWarningDefaultYes := SalesSetup."Stockout Warning";
      ShowStockoutWarningDefaultNo := NOT ShowStockoutWarningDefaultYes;

      EnableShowShowEnforcePositivInventory;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertItemUnitOfMeasure@8();
    VAR
      ItemUnitOfMeasure@1000 : Record 5404;
    BEGIN
      IF "Base Unit of Measure" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        ItemUnitOfMeasure.INIT;
        ItemUnitOfMeasure."Item No." := "No.";
        ItemUnitOfMeasure.VALIDATE(Code,"Base Unit of Measure");
        ItemUnitOfMeasure."Qty. per Unit of Measure" := 1;
        ItemUnitOfMeasure.INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EnableShowShowEnforcePositivInventory@2();
    VAR
      InventorySetup@1000 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      InventorySetup.GET;
      ShowPreventNegInventoryDefaultYes := InventorySetup."Prevent Negative Inventory";
      ShowPreventNegInventoryDefaultNo := NOT ShowPreventNegInventoryDefaultYes;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateSpecialPricesAndDiscountsTxt@7();
    VAR
      TempSalesPriceAndLineDiscBuff@1000 : TEMPORARY Record 1304;
      TempPurchPriceLineDiscBuff@1001 : TEMPORARY Record 1315;
    BEGIN
      SpecialPricesAndDiscountsTxt := CreateNewTxt;
      IF TempSalesPriceAndLineDiscBuff.ItemHasLines(Rec) THEN
        SpecialPricesAndDiscountsTxt := ViewExistingTxt;

      SpecialPurchPricesAndDiscountsTxt := CreateNewTxt;
      IF TempPurchPriceLineDiscBuff.ItemHasLines(Rec) THEN
        SpecialPurchPricesAndDiscountsTxt := ViewExistingTxt;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateItemFromTemplate@11();
    VAR
      ItemTemplate@1001 : Record 1301;
      Item@1000 : Record 27;
      InventorySetup@1002 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      IF NewMode THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemTemplate.NewItemFromTemplate(Item) THEN BEGIN
          COPY(Item);
          CurrPage.UPDATE;
        END;

        IF ApplicationAreaSetup.IsFoundationEnabled THEN
          IF (Item."No." = '') AND InventorySetup.GET THEN
            VALIDATE("Costing Method",InventorySetup."Default Costing Method");

        NewMode := FALSE;
      END;
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE GetSelectionFilter@3() : Text;
    VAR
      Item@1001 : Record 27;
      SelectionFilterManagement@1002 : Codeunit 46;
    BEGIN
      CurrPage.SETSELECTIONFILTER(Item);
      EXIT(SelectionFilterManagement.GetSelectionFilterForItem(Item));
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE SetSelection@1(VAR Item@1000 : Record 27);
    BEGIN
      CurrPage.SETSELECTIONFILTER(Item);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetSocialListeningFactboxVisibility@2();
    VAR
      SocialListeningMgt@1000 : Codeunit 871;
    BEGIN
      SocialListeningMgt.GetItemFactboxVisibility(Rec,SocialListeningSetupVisible,SocialListeningVisible);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EnableControls@4();
    BEGIN
      IsService := (Type = Type::Service);
      InventoryItemEditable := Type = Type::Inventory;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetWorkflowManagementEnabledState@9();
    VAR
      WorkflowManagement@1001 : Codeunit 1501;
      WorkflowEventHandling@1000 : Codeunit 1520;
    BEGIN
      EventFilter := WorkflowEventHandling.RunWorkflowOnSendItemForApprovalCode + '|' +
        WorkflowEventHandling.RunWorkflowOnItemChangedCode;

      EnabledApprovalWorkflowsExist := WorkflowManagement.EnabledWorkflowExist(DATABASE::Item,EventFilter);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClearAttributesFilter@5();
    BEGIN
      CLEARMARKS;
      MARKEDONLY(FALSE);
      TempFilterItemAttributesBuffer.RESET;
      TempFilterItemAttributesBuffer.DELETEALL;
      FILTERGROUP(0);
      SETRANGE("No.");
    END;

                               ShipToOptions::"Custom Address":
                                 VALIDATE("Ship-to Code",'');
                             END;
                           END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClearSellToFilter@1100();
    BEGIN
      IF GETFILTER("Sell-to Customer No.") = xRec."Sell-to Customer No." THEN
        IF "Sell-to Customer No." <> xRec."Sell-to Customer No." THEN
          SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.");
      IF GETFILTER("Sell-to Contact No.") = xRec."Sell-to Contact No." THEN
        IF "Sell-to Contact No." <> xRec."Sell-to Contact No." THEN
          SETRANGE("Sell-to Contact No.");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetDocNoVisible@4();
    VAR
      DocumentNoVisibility@1000 : Codeunit 1400;
      DocType@1003 : 'Quote,Order,Invoice,Credit Memo,Blanket Order,Return Order,Reminder,FinChMemo';
    BEGIN
      DocNoVisible := DocumentNoVisibility.SalesDocumentNoIsVisible(DocType::Quote,"No.");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetControlAppearance@5();
    VAR
      ApprovalsMgmt@1002 : Codeunit 1535;
      WorkflowWebhookMgt@1000 : Codeunit 1543;
    BEGIN
      HasIncomingDocument := "Incoming Document Entry No." <> 0;

      OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUser := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntriesForCurrentUser(RECORDID);
      OpenApprovalEntriesExist := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntries(RECORDID);
      CanCancelApprovalForRecord := ApprovalsMgmt.CanCancelApprovalForRecord(RECORDID);
      IsCustomerOrContactNotEmpty := ("Sell-to Customer No." <> '') OR ("Sell-to Contact No." <> '');

      WorkflowWebhookMgt.GetCanRequestAndCanCancel(RECORDID,CanRequestApprovalForFlow,CanCancelApprovalForFlow);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckSalesCheckAllLinesHaveQuantityAssigned@6();
    VAR
      ApplicationAreaSetup@1000 : Record 9178;
      LinesInstructionMgt@1001 : Codeunit 1320;
    BEGIN
      IF ApplicationAreaSetup.IsFoundationEnabled THEN
        LinesInstructionMgt.SalesCheckAllLinesHaveQuantityAssigned(Rec);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Post@4(PostingCodeunitID@1000 : Integer;Navigate@1004 : Option);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@1001 : Record 36;
      LinesInstructionMgt@1002 : Codeunit 1320;
      InstructionMgt@1003 : Codeunit 1330;
      IsScheduledPosting@1005 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF ApplicationAreaSetup.IsFoundationEnabled THEN
        LinesInstructionMgt.SalesCheckAllLinesHaveQuantityAssigned(Rec);

      SendToPosting(PostingCodeunitID);

      IsScheduledPosting := "Job Queue Status" = "Job Queue Status"::"Scheduled for Posting";
      DocumentIsPosted := (NOT SalesHeader.GET("Document Type","No.")) OR IsScheduledPosting;

      IF IsScheduledPosting THEN
        CurrPage.CLOSE;
      CurrPage.UPDATE(FALSE);

      IF PostingCodeunitID <> CODEUNIT::"Sales-Post (Yes/No)" THEN
        EXIT;

      CASE Navigate OF
        NavigateAfterPost::"Posted Document":
          IF InstructionMgt.IsEnabled(InstructionMgt.ShowPostedConfirmationMessageCode) THEN
            ShowPostedConfirmationMessage;
        NavigateAfterPost::"New Document":
          IF DocumentIsPosted THEN BEGIN
            SalesHeader.INIT;
            SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
            SalesHeader.INSERT(TRUE);
            PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Sales Order",SalesHeader);
          END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetControlVisibility@7();

      ApprovalsMgmt@1002 : Codeunit 1535;
      WorkflowWebhookMgt@1000 : Codeunit 1543;
    BEGIN
      JobQueueVisible := "Job Queue Status" = "Job Queue Status"::"Scheduled for Posting";
      HasIncomingDocument := "Incoming Document Entry No." <> 0;
      SetExtDocNoMandatoryCondition;

      OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUser := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntriesForCurrentUser(RECORDID);
      OpenApprovalEntriesExist := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntries(RECORDID);
      CanCancelApprovalForRecord := ApprovalsMgmt.CanCancelApprovalForRecord(RECORDID);

      WorkflowWebhookMgt.GetCanRequestAndCanCancel(RECORDID,CanRequestApprovalForFlow,CanCancelApprovalForFlow);
      IsCustomerOrContactNotEmpty := ("Sell-to Customer No." <> '') OR ("Sell-to Contact No." <> '');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShowPostedConfirmationMessage@17();
    VAR
      OrderSalesHeader@1003 : Record 36;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@1000 : Record 112;
      InstructionMgt@1002 : Codeunit 1330;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT OrderSalesHeader.GET("Document Type","No.") THEN BEGIN
        SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("No.","Last Posting No.");
        IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
          IF InstructionMgt.ShowConfirm(OpenPostedSalesOrderQst,InstructionMgt.ShowPostedConfirmationMessageCode) THEN
            PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Posted Sales Invoice",SalesInvoiceHeader);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Post@4(PostingCodeunitID@1000 : Integer);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@1003 : Record 36;
      SalesCrMemoHeader@1004 : Record 114;
      OfficeMgt@1005 : Codeunit 1630;
      InstructionMgt@1006 : Codeunit 1330;
      PreAssignedNo@1001 : Code[20];
      IsScheduledPosting@1002 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      CheckSalesCheckAllLinesHaveQuantityAssigned;
      PreAssignedNo := "No.";

      SendToPosting(PostingCodeunitID);

      IsScheduledPosting := "Job Queue Status" = "Job Queue Status"::"Scheduled for Posting";
      DocumentIsPosted := (NOT SalesHeader.GET("Document Type","No.")) OR IsScheduledPosting;

      IF IsScheduledPosting THEN
        CurrPage.CLOSE;
      CurrPage.UPDATE(FALSE);

      IF PostingCodeunitID <> CODEUNIT::"Sales-Post (Yes/No)" THEN
        EXIT;

      IF OfficeMgt.IsAvailable THEN BEGIN
        SalesCrMemoHeader.SETRANGE("Pre-Assigned No.",PreAssignedNo);
        IF SalesCrMemoHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
          PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Posted Sales Credit Memo",SalesCrMemoHeader);
      END ELSE
        IF InstructionMgt.IsEnabled(InstructionMgt.ShowPostedConfirmationMessageCode) THEN
          ShowPostedConfirmationMessage(PreAssignedNo);
    END;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetControlAppearance@8();

      ApprovalsMgmt@1002 : Codeunit 1535;
      WorkflowWebhookMgt@1000 : Codeunit 1543;
    BEGIN
      JobQueueVisible := "Job Queue Status" = "Job Queue Status"::"Scheduled for Posting";

      SetExtDocNoMandatoryCondition;

      OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUser := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntriesForCurrentUser(RECORDID);
      OpenApprovalEntriesExist := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntries(RECORDID);
      CanCancelApprovalForRecord := ApprovalsMgmt.CanCancelApprovalForRecord(RECORDID);

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShowPostedConfirmationMessage@7(PreAssignedNo@1001 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      SalesCrMemoHeader@1000 : Record 114;
      InstructionMgt@1002 : Codeunit 1330;
    BEGIN
      SalesCrMemoHeader.SETRANGE("Pre-Assigned No.",PreAssignedNo);
      IF SalesCrMemoHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        IF InstructionMgt.ShowConfirm(OpenPostedSalesCrMemoQst,InstructionMgt.ShowPostedConfirmationMessageCode) THEN
          PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Posted Sales Credit Memo",SalesCrMemoHeader);
    END;

                                 i@1000000003 : Integer;
                                 Shop@1000000004 : Record 5447301;
                                 OptionString@1000000005 : Text;
                                 SelectedOption@1000000006 : Integer;
                                 Text5447301@1000000007 : TextConst 'DEU=Mit welchem Webshop sollen die Kontakte verkn�pft werden?;ENU=With what Shop should the contacts be synced?';
                                 WebshopUpdateMgmt@1000000008 : Codeunit 5447301;
                               BEGIN
                                 //--- dynamic commerce ---
                                 IF Rec."Webshop Shop Code" = '' THEN BEGIN
                                   WebshopSetup.GET;
                                   DefaultNumber := 1;

                                   IF Shop.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
                                     i := 1;
                                     IF Shop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                                       IF i <> 1 THEN
                                         OptionString += ',';
                                       OptionString += Shop.Description;
                                       IF Shop.Code = WebshopSetup."Default Shop Code" THEN
                                         DefaultNumber := i;
                                       i += 1;
                                     UNTIL Shop.NEXT = 0;
                                     SelectedOption := DIALOG.STRMENU(OptionString,DefaultNumber,Text5447301);
                                   END ELSE BEGIN
                                     SelectedOption := 1;
                                   END;
                                   IF SelectedOption > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                     IF SelectedOption = 1 THEN
                                       Shop.FINDFIRST
                                     ELSE BEGIN
                                       Shop.RESET;
                                       i := 1;
                                       IF Shop.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                                         i += 1;
                                       UNTIL (SelectedOption=i) OR (Shop.NEXT = 0);
                                     END;
                                   END;
                                 END ELSE
                                   Shop.GET("Webshop Shop Code");

                                 IF (Rec."Webshop Shop Code" = '') OR (SelectedOption > 0) THEN BEGIN
                                   WebshopUpdateMgmt.StateIndicatorOpen(Text5447300);
                                     WebshopUpdateMgmt.NewsletterSegmentLineSyncAll(Rec,TRUE,Shop);
                                   WebshopUpdateMgmt.NewsletterSegmentLineSyncAll(Rec,FALSE,Shop);
                                   WebshopUpdateMgmt.StateIndicatorClose;
                                 END;
                               END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckUseOnlineOrderNo@1000000000();
    BEGIN
      UseOnlineOrderNoPossible := FALSE;
      UseOnlineOrderNoError := '';
      SalesSetup.GET;

      IF "Create Webshop Orders As" = "Create Webshop Orders As"::Quotes THEN BEGIN
        IF "Code No. Series Quotes" <> '' THEN BEGIN
          IF NoSeries.GET("Code No. Series Quotes") THEN BEGIN
            IF NoSeries."Manual Nos." THEN
              UseOnlineOrderNoPossible := TRUE
            ELSE
              UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text001,FORMAT("Code No. Series Quotes"));
          END ELSE
            UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text002,FORMAT("Code No. Series Quotes"));
        END ELSE BEGIN
          NoSeries.SETRANGE(NoSeries.Code,SalesSetup."Quote Nos.");
          IF NoSeries.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
            IF NoSeries."Manual Nos." THEN
              UseOnlineOrderNoPossible := TRUE
            ELSE
              UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text003,FORMAT(SalesSetup."Quote Nos."));
          END ELSE
            UseOnlineOrderNoError := Text004;
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF "Code No. Series Orders" <> '' THEN BEGIN
          IF NoSeries.GET("Code No. Series Orders") THEN BEGIN
            IF NoSeries."Manual Nos." THEN
              UseOnlineOrderNoPossible := TRUE
            ELSE
              UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text001,FORMAT("Code No. Series Orders"));
          END ELSE
            UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text002,FORMAT("Code No. Series Orders"));
        END ELSE BEGIN
          NoSeries.SETRANGE(NoSeries.Code,SalesSetup."Order Nos.");
          IF NoSeries.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
            IF NoSeries."Manual Nos." THEN
              UseOnlineOrderNoPossible := TRUE
            ELSE
              UseOnlineOrderNoError := STRSUBSTNO(Text003,FORMAT(SalesSetup."Order Nos."));
          END ELSE
            UseOnlineOrderNoError := Text004;
        END;
      END;

      IF (NOT (UseOnlineOrderNoPossible)) AND ("Use Online Order No.") THEN
        ERROR(UseOnlineOrderNoError);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }
}

    PROCEDURE OnFetchMarketplaceAttributes@1000000000();
    VAR
      Window@1000000004 : Dialog;
      Factor@1000000003 : Decimal;
      Counter@1000000002 : Decimal;
      ExitLoop@1000000001 : Boolean;
      EntryId@1000000000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF Shop.GET("Shop Code") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateShop(Shop);

      IF Language.GET("Shop Code","Language Code") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateLanguage(Language);

      Factor := 9999 / 100;
      ExitLoop := FALSE;
      Counter := 0;
      IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
        EntryId := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.QueueMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Marketplace Root Category Code")
      ELSE IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
        EntryId := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.QueueMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Search Code")
      ELSE
        EXIT;
      Window.OPEN(
        '#1#################################\\' +
        '@2@@@@@@@@');
      Window.UPDATE(1, Text008);

      REPEAT
        Counter += 100;
        Window.UPDATE(2, Counter);
        IF Counter = 10000 THEN BEGIN
          Counter := 0;
          Window.UPDATE(2, Counter);
        END;
        IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
          ExitLoop := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.CheckMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Marketplace Root Category Code",EntryId)
        ELSE IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
          ExitLoop := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.CheckMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Search Code",EntryId);
      UNTIL ExitLoop = TRUE;
      Window.CLOSE;
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text010);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.FetchCategoryAttributes(Rec,TRUE);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.FetchCategoryAttributes(Rec,FALSE);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.StateIndicatorClose();
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FormatName@19039177();
    VAR
      TempLevel@1000000000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      FormatedName := '';
      NameEmphasize := Level = 1;
      IF Level > 1 THEN BEGIN
        TempLevel := 2;
        REPEAT
          FormatedName += '   ';
          TempLevel := TempLevel + 1;
        UNTIL TempLevel > (Level);
      END;
      FormatedName += Name;
    END;

    PROCEDURE SwapCategory@1000000004(ToCategory@1000000001 : Record 5447303);
    VAR
      TempCategory@1000000008 : Record 5447303;
      TempItemCategory@1000000006 : Record 5447305;
      SwapToCategory@1000000005 : TEMPORARY Record 5447303;
      SwapFromCategory@1000000004 : TEMPORARY Record 5447303;
      SwapToItemCategory@1000000003 : TEMPORARY Record 5447305;
      SwapFromItemCategory@1000000002 : TEMPORARY Record 5447305;
      SwapFromWebshopItem@1000000009 : TEMPORARY Record 5447304;
      SwapToWebshopItem@1000000010 : TEMPORARY Record 5447304;
      WebshopItem@1000000011 : Record 5447304;
      SwapFromAttributeLink@1000000012 : TEMPORARY Record 5447321;
      SwapToAttributeLink@1000000013 : TEMPORARY Record 5447321;
      AttributeLink@1000000014 : Record 5447321;
      SwapToLineNoChildren@1000000015 : Integer;
      SwapFromLineNoChildren@1000000007 : Integer;
      SwapToLineNo@1000000000 : Integer;
      SwapFromLineNo@1000000016 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // Kategorien nach oben oder unter verschieben

      SwapFromLineNo := "Line No.";
      SwapToLineNo := ToCategory."Line No.";

      //Artikel-Hauptkategorien �ndern
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Main Category Line No.",SwapFromLineNo);
      IF WebshopItem.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        SwapFromWebshopItem.INIT;
        SwapFromWebshopItem.TRANSFERFIELDS(WebshopItem);
        SwapFromWebshopItem."Main Category Line No." := SwapToLineNo;
        SwapFromWebshopItem.INSERT(FALSE);
      UNTIL WebshopItem.NEXT = 0;

      WebshopItem.INIT;
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
      WebshopItem.SETRANGE("Main Category Line No.",SwapToLineNo);
      IF WebshopItem.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        SwapToWebshopItem.INIT;
        SwapToWebshopItem.TRANSFERFIELDS(WebshopItem);
        SwapToWebshopItem."Main Category Line No." := SwapFromLineNo;
        SwapToWebshopItem.INSERT(FALSE);
      UNTIL WebshopItem.NEXT = 0;

      IF SwapFromWebshopItem.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
      IF WebshopItem.GET(SwapFromWebshopItem."Shop Code",SwapFromWebshopItem."Language Code",SwapFromWebshopItem."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
        WebshopItem."Main Category Line No." := SwapFromWebshopItem."Main Category Line No.";
        WebshopItem.MODIFY(TRUE);
      END;
      UNTIL SwapFromWebshopItem.NEXT = 0;

      IF SwapToWebshopItem.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
      IF WebshopItem.GET(SwapToWebshopItem."Shop Code",SwapToWebshopItem."Language Code",SwapToWebshopItem."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
        WebshopItem."Main Category Line No." := SwapToWebshopItem."Main Category Line No.";
        WebshopItem.MODIFY(TRUE);
      END;
      UNTIL SwapToWebshopItem.NEXT = 0;


      // Kateogorie-Attribute �ber temp. Tabellen verschieben
      AttributeLink.RESET;
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeLink.Type::Category);
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",SwapFromLineNo);
      IF AttributeLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        SwapFromAttributeLink.INIT;
        SwapFromAttributeLink.TRANSFERFIELDS(AttributeLink);
        SwapFromAttributeLink."Category Line No." := SwapToLineNo;
        SwapFromAttributeLink.INSERT;
      UNTIL AttributeLink.NEXT = 0;

      AttributeLink.RESET;
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeLink.Type::Category);
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",SwapToLineNo);
      IF AttributeLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        SwapToAttributeLink.INIT;
        SwapToAttributeLink.TRANSFERFIELDS(AttributeLink);
        SwapToAttributeLink."Category Line No." := SwapFromLineNo;
        SwapToAttributeLink.INSERT;
      UNTIL AttributeLink.NEXT = 0;

      AttributeLink.RESET;
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE(Type,AttributeLink.Type::Category);
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Shop Code","Shop Code");
      AttributeLink.SETRANGE("Language Code","Language Code");
      AttributeLink.SETFILTER("Category Line No.",'%1|%2',SwapFromLineNo,SwapToLineNo);
      AttributeLink.DELETEALL(FALSE);

      AttributeLink.RESET;
      IF SwapFromAttributeLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        AttributeLink.INIT;
        AttributeLink.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapFromAttributeLink);
        AttributeLink.INSERT;
      UNTIL SwapFromAttributeLink.NEXT = 0;

      AttributeLink.RESET;
      IF SwapToAttributeLink.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        AttributeLink.INIT;
        AttributeLink.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapToAttributeLink);
        AttributeLink.INSERT;
      UNTIL SwapToAttributeLink.NEXT = 0;


      // Gew�hlte Kategorie in tempor�re Tabelle schreiben und l�schen
      SwapFromCategory.INIT;
      SwapFromCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(Rec);
      SwapFromCategory."Line No." := SwapToLineNo;
      SwapFromCategory.INSERT(FALSE);

      IF Shop.GET("Shop Code") THEN BEGIN

        IF Shop."Use Items from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code",Shop."Use Items from Shop Code")
        ELSE
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");

        IF Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code",Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code")
        ELSE
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code","Shop Code");

        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Language Code","Language Code");
        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",SwapFromLineNo);
        IF TempItemCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          SwapFromItemCategory.INIT;
          SwapFromItemCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(TempItemCategory);
          SwapFromItemCategory."Category Line No." := SwapToLineNo;
          SwapFromItemCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
          TempItemCategory.DELETE(FALSE);
        UNTIL TempItemCategory.NEXT = 0;
        DELETE(FALSE);

        // Zu tauschende Kategorie in tempor�re Tabelle schreiben und l�schen
        SwapToCategory.INIT;
        SwapToCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(ToCategory);
        SwapToCategory."Line No." := SwapFromLineNo;
        SwapToCategory.INSERT(FALSE);

        IF Shop."Use Items from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code",Shop."Use Items from Shop Code")
        ELSE
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Shop Code","Shop Code");

        IF Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code" <> '' THEN
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code",Shop."Use Categories from Shop Code")
        ELSE
          TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Shop Code","Shop Code");


        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Item Language Code","Language Code");
        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Language Code","Language Code");
        TempItemCategory.SETRANGE("Category Line No.",SwapToLineNo);
        IF TempItemCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          SwapToItemCategory.INIT;
          SwapToItemCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(TempItemCategory);
          SwapToItemCategory."Category Line No." := SwapFromLineNo;
          SwapToItemCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
          TempItemCategory.DELETE(FALSE);
        UNTIL TempItemCategory.NEXT = 0;
        ToCategory.DELETE(FALSE);

        // Gew�hlte Kategorie mit neuer Zeilennr. anlegen
        TempCategory.INIT;
        TempCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapFromCategory);
        TempCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
        IF SwapFromItemCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          TempItemCategory.INIT;
          TempItemCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapFromItemCategory);
          TempItemCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
        UNTIL SwapFromItemCategory.NEXT = 0;

        TempCategory.ModifyChildren;

        // Zu tauschende Kategorie mit neuer Zeilennr. anlegen
        TempCategory.INIT;
        TempCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapToCategory);
        TempCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
        IF SwapToItemCategory.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          TempItemCategory.INIT;
          TempItemCategory.TRANSFERFIELDS(SwapToItemCategory);
          TempItemCategory.INSERT(FALSE);
        UNTIL SwapToItemCategory.NEXT = 0;

        TempCategory.ModifyChildren;

        // Datens�tze im Web tauschen
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SetSendNow(TRUE);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SwapCategory("Shop Code","Language Code",SwapFromLineNo,SwapToLineNo);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SetSendNow(FALSE);

        //Berechtigungen NAV und WEB tauschen
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SetSendNow(TRUE);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SwapCategoryPermissions("Shop Code","Language Code",SwapFromLineNo,SwapToLineNo);
        WebshopUpdateManagement.SetSendNow(FALSE);

        COMMIT;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE OnFetchMarketplaceAttributes@1000000000();
    VAR
      Window@1000000004 : Dialog;
      Factor@1000000003 : Decimal;
      Counter@1000000002 : Decimal;
      ExitLoop@1000000001 : Boolean;
      EntryId@1000000000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF Shop.GET("Shop Code") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateShop(Shop);

      IF Language.GET("Shop Code","Language Code") THEN
        WebshopUpdateManagement.UpdateLanguage(Language);

      Factor := 9999 / 100;
      ExitLoop := FALSE;
      Counter := 0;
      IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
        EntryId := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.QueueMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Marketplace Root Category Code")
      ELSE IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
        EntryId := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.QueueMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Search Code")
      ELSE
        EXIT;
      Window.OPEN(
        '#1#################################\\' +
        '@2@@@@@@@@');
      Window.UPDATE(1, Text008);

      REPEAT
        Counter += 100;
        Window.UPDATE(2, Counter);
        IF Counter = 10000 THEN BEGIN
          Counter := 0;
          Window.UPDATE(2, Counter);
        END;
        IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::Amazon THEN
          ExitLoop := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.CheckMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Marketplace Root Category Code",EntryId)
        ELSE IF Shop."Marketplace Type" = Shop."Marketplace Type"::eBay THEN
          ExitLoop := WebshopMarketplaceManagement.CheckMktplAttributesFetch("Shop Code","Language Code",Shop."Marketplace Type","Search Code",EntryId);
      UNTIL ExitLoop = TRUE;
      Window.CLOSE;
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.StateIndicatorOpen(Text010);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.FetchCategoryAttributes(Rec,TRUE);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.FetchCategoryAttributes(Rec,FALSE);
      WebshopMarketplaceManagement.StateIndicatorClose();
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      --- dynamic commerce - dynamic commerce GmbH - www.dc-solution.de ---
    }
    END.
  }
